![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058938476/original/vyrtAQYYaTlWHTHlJSSZdcqI83g8lMQCYg.png?1763725704)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What happens after a customer clicks the review link?**

The repeat schedule stops for that channel once the click is detected, preventing additional retries for that contact.

**Q: What’s the difference between Review Balancing and a Custom Link?**

**Balancing** distributes traffic across connected review sites (e.g., Google). **Custom Link** sends everyone to a single destination you choose.

**Q: Which token should I use in SMS for the review URL?**

Use {{reputation.review\_link}}. It automatically uses the Review Link you configured under **Reputation → Settings → Review Link**.

**Q: Can emails include more than one review destination?**

Yes. In the Email builder, you can use the **Review Link** element and, in some templates, configure multiple review buttons if supported by your design.

**Q: How many retries should I set?**

Most teams start with 2–3 retries. The right number depends on engagement, industry norms, and compliance requirements.

**Q: Does adding an image to an SMS change costs?**

It may send as MMS, which can have different carrier pricing. Check your messaging provider’s rates.

**Q: Do I need Google Business Profile connected?**

Only if you want to route reviews to Google using Balancing. If you prefer another site or your own page, set a **Custom Link** instead.

**Q: Can I automate requests without manual sending?**

Yes. Add the **Review Request** action in a Workflow to trigger sends automatically (e.g., after “check‑in”).

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Reputation - Breaking Down the Reviews Tab](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001222826)
- [Getting Started with Reviews AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005156)
- [Reputation Management - Video Testimonials](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007009)
- [How to send Review Request via Whatsapp](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004326)

title_en: How to Manage A2P Registrations Across Sub-Accounts Using the Agency Trust Center
source_md:
Monitor and manage A2P 10DLC Brand and Campaign registrations for every sub-account from one place. This article explains how to use the Agency Trust Center to manage A2P registrations efficiently.

```
Plan and User Availability: The Agency Trust Center (A2P) is currently available exclusively to agencies subscribed to HighLevel's $497/month plan. This feature is accessible only to Agency Owners and Agency Admins. Other agency users and sub-account users will not have access to the agency-level A2P management console.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Agency Trust Center (A2P)?](#What-is-the-Agency-Trust-Center-(A2P)?)
  - [How to Access the Agency Trust Center](#How-to-Access-the-Agency-Trust-Center)
  - [Understanding the Overview Dashboard](#Understanding-the-Overview-Dashboard)
  - [Reviewing Brand and Campaign Rejection Reasons](#Reviewing-Brand-and-Campaign-Rejection-Reasons)
  - [Understanding Chat Widget vs. Self-Serve Registration](#Understanding-Chat-Widget-vs.-Self-Serve-Registration)
  - [Managing Brand Registrations](#Managing-Brand-Registrations)
  - [Managing Campaign Registrations](#Managing-Campaign-Registrations)
  - [Registering a New A2P Submission](#Registering-a-New-A2P-Submission)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Agency Trust Center (A2P)?**

The **Agency Trust Center (A2P)** in HighLevel allows agencies to monitor and manage A2P 10DLC registrations across all their sub-accounts from one centralized location. Instead of navigating into each sub-account individually, agency administrators can track registration approvals, identify rejected Brands and Campaigns, understand rejection reasons, and initiate registrations directly from the agency level.

A2P 10DLC is the registration process required by US carriers for businesses sending application-to-person text messages using US 10-digit long code phone numbers. To complete A2P registration, each sub-account must have an approved Brand and a verified Campaign.

The Agency Trust Center includes three main tabs:

- **Overview:** Monitor A2P approval status, identify rejection reasons, and compare registration methods across sub-accounts.
- **Brands:** View and manage Brand registrations, track their statuses, and initiate new registrations.
- **Campaigns:** View and manage Campaign registrations, identify issues, and create Campaigns for approved Brands.

```
Note: The Agency Trust Center complements the existing sub-account Trust Center, allowing agencies to manage registrations without repeatedly switching between sub-accounts.
```

---

## **How to Access the Agency Trust Center**

1. Log in to your HighLevel agency account.
2. Navigate to **Settings → Phone Integration**.
3. Open the **Trust Center (A2P)** section.
4. Choose from the three available tabs: **Overview**, **Brands**, and **Campaigns**.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083795569/original/0eT3v8Jc8n0KtJe5B0HLmWEKPPjFEUrX1A.png?1792515628)**

---

## **Understanding the Overview Dashboard**

The Overview tab provides a consolidated view of A2P registration health across your agency. It helps you quickly understand how many sub-accounts have completed registration, how many are awaiting approval, and which registrations require corrective action.

### **Registration Status Overview**

At the top of the dashboard, you will see three summary cards.

1. **F****ully Approved:**Displays the number and percentage of sub-accounts that have completed A2P registration. A sub-account is considered fully approved only when both its Brand and Campaign are approved or verified.
2. **In Review:**Displays the number of sub-accounts whose registrations are currently being reviewed, with a breakdown of Brands and Campaigns under review.
3. **Rejected:**Displays the number of sub-accounts with rejected registrations, with separate counts for rejected Brands and Campaigns. Click the Brand or Campaign rejection count to navigate to the corresponding registrations and review the issues.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083795643/original/kvW7z-p2YGeomoAGnh29QklJmea4GedT-A.png?1792515735)

```
Important: These metrics represent sub-accounts rather than individual registration attempts. A sub-account must have both its Brand and Campaign approved to be considered fully approved.
```

### **Filter by Date Range**

Use the **Date Range** selector in the upper-right corner of the Overview dashboard to view registration activity for a selected period. For example, you can select **Last 30 Days** to review recent A2P registration performance.

Click the refresh icon to reload the dashboard with the latest available information.

---

## **Reviewing Brand and Campaign Rejection Reasons**

The Overview dashboard provides separate sections for Brand Rejection Reasons and Campaign Rejection Reasons. These sections help agencies understand common registration failures and identify where corrective action is required.

### **Brand Rejection Reasons**

The Brand Rejection Reasons section displays common reasons why Brand registrations were rejected. Examples include:

- **Business name does not match EIN:** The submitted business name does not match the information associated with the Employer Identification Number.
- **Opt-in consent not properly evidenced:** The submitted registration does not adequately demonstrate how customers provide consent to receive messages.
- **Business category not eligible for 10DLC:** The business category or activity does not meet applicable A2P registration requirements.

Each rejection reason displays the number of sub-accounts that failed due to that reason. Click the arrow next to a rejection reason to navigate to the relevant registration records.

### **Campaign Rejection Reasons**

The Campaign Rejection Reasons section displays common reasons Campaign registrations were rejected. Examples include:

- **Description does not match use case:** The Campaign description does not accurately represent the selected messaging use case.
- **Opt-in consent not properly evidenced:** The submitted consent collection process is incomplete or insufficient.
- **Website could not be verified:** The website provided during registration could not be successfully verified.

Each reason displays the number of sub-accounts that failed due to that reason. Click the arrow next to a rejection reason to review the affected registrations.

---

## **Understanding Chat Widget vs. Self-Serve Registration**

The **How your sub-accounts are registering** section helps agencies understand which registration methods their sub-accounts use and how successfully those methods perform.

A2P Campaign registration requires businesses to demonstrate how customers consent to receive messages, and HighLevel supports two registration approaches.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083795794/original/A8Spa_rTInfPQwtLtQnOAKHXyIkDUZOheA.png?1792515945)

### **Chat Widget**

The Chat Widget method uses a website-based consent collection experience. Customer consent is captured through the website Chat Widget and stored automatically, helping businesses demonstrate their opt-in process.

The dashboard displays:

- **Sub-accounts submitted:** Number of registered sub-accounts using the Chat Widget method.
- **Approved, of those submitted:** Percentage of registrations using this method that received approval among registrations with a final decision.

### **Self-Serve Registration**

With the Self-Serve method, businesses provide their own proof of how customers consent to receive messages. This may involve submitting information about their opt-in forms, website, or other consent collection methods.

The dashboard displays:

- **Sub-accounts submitted:** Number of registered sub-accounts using the Self-Serve method.
- **Approved, of those submitted:** Percentage of registrations using this method that received approval among registrations with a final decision.

### **How to Interpret the Comparison**

For example, suppose the dashboard shows:

**Chat Widget**

- Sub-accounts using it: 15 of 22 registered
- Approval rate: 90%

**Self-Serve**

- Sub-accounts using it: 7 of 22 registered
- Approval rate: 29%

This indicates that 15 registered sub-accounts are using the Chat Widget method, while 7 are using Self-Serve. Among registrations that have received a final decision, 90% of Chat Widget registrations were approved compared with 29% of Self-Serve registrations.

```
Pro Tip: This comparison can help agencies identify which registration method is performing better across their portfolio.
```

---

## **Managing Brand Registrations**

The Brands tab provides a centralized view of Brand registrations across your agency's sub-accounts.

### **View Brand Registrations**

1. Open the **Agency Trust Center (A2P)**.
2. Select the **Brands** tab.
3. Review the Brand registrations associated with your sub-accounts.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083795803/original/5AJ0-dvM56MbGqwoYQ0k9jA82ULdFtDK9g.png?1792515972)**

### **Understanding the Brands Table**

The Brands table contains the following information:

- **Brand SID:** Unique identifier assigned to the Brand registration.
- **Sub-Account:** Name of the sub-account associated with the Brand.
- **Brand Status:** Current approval or registration status.
- **Brand Type:** Type of Brand registration.
- **Attempts left:** Number of Brand registration attempts left.
- **Rejection Reason:** Most recent issue or rejection information.
- **Actions (⋮):** Available action based on the Brand's current status.

### **Finding Registrations That Need Attention**

Use the available filters to locate Brand registrations:

- **All:** View all Brands.
- **In Progress:** View Brands currently undergoing processing.
- **Rejected:** View rejected Brands.
- **Approved:** View approved Brands.

You can also search for a specific sub-account or use additional filters.

### **Taking Action on a Brand**

Click the **Actions (⋮)** menu next to a Brand registration. Depending on the current status, you may be able to select **Fix and Resubmit**.

---

## **Managing Campaign Registrations**

The Campaigns tab allows agencies to monitor and manage Campaign registrations across their sub-accounts.

### **View Campaign Registrations**

1. Open the **Agency Trust Center (A2P)**.
2. Select the **Campaigns** tab.
3. Review the Campaign registrations associated with your sub-accounts.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083795840/original/9tk4BkCxO1yvF7w-HYyPLHo5FDsv7FBFLQ.png?1792516063)**

### **Understanding the Campaigns Table**

The Campaigns table contains the following information:

- **Messaging Service:** Messaging Service associated with the Campaign.
- **Sub-Account:** Sub-account associated with the Campaign.
- **Campaign Status:** Current Campaign approval status.
- **Connected Brand:** Brand associated with the Campaign.
- **Use Case:** Registered messaging use case.
- **Rejection Reasons:** Most recent Campaign issue or rejection reason.
- **Actions (⋮):** Available action based on Campaign status.

### 

### **Filter Campaign Registrations**

Use the available status filters:

- **All:** View all Campaign records.
- **In Progress:** View Campaigns currently under review.
- **Rejected:** View rejected Campaigns.
- **Verified:** View verified Campaigns.

### 

### **Taking Action on a Campaign**

Click the **Actions (⋮)** menu next to a Campaign registration. Depending on the current status, you may be able to select **Fix and Resubmit**.

---

## **Registering a New A2P Submission**

Agency administrators can initiate registrations directly from the agency-level Trust Center.

### **Register an A2P Submission**

1. Open the **Agency Trust Center (A2P)**.
2. Select the **Brands** tab.
3. Click **Start registration**.
4. Select the sub-account for which you want to register the Brand.
5. Complete the required business and registration information.
6. Review the details for accuracy.
7. Submit the registration.

Once submitted, you can track its status from the Brands and Campaigns tabs.

```
Important: The submitted business information must match official business registration records. Incorrect business names, EINs, addresses, or other identity details can result in rejection. For more information, refer to 10DLC Brand and Campaign Registration.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I manage A2P registrations across multiple sub-accounts?**

Yes. The Agency Trust Center allows you to view and manage Brand and Campaign registrations across all your agency's sub-accounts without switching between them.

**Q: What does Fully Approved mean?**

Fully Approved means that both the Brand and Campaign associated with a sub-account have received the required approvals.

**Q: Why does the Overview show separate Brand and Campaign rejection counts?**

Brand and Campaign registrations are evaluated separately. Displaying both counts helps you identify which stage of the registration process requires attention.

**Q: Can I see why a Brand or Campaign was rejected?**

Yes. The Overview dashboard displays common rejection reasons. You can also review the latest issue associated with individual registrations in the Brands and Campaigns tabs.

**Q: Why are Chat Widget and Self-Serve approval rates different?**

The two registration methods use different approaches to demonstrating customer consent. The Chat Widget method captures and stores consent information through the website, while Self-Serve requires businesses to provide their own evidence. Approval outcomes can vary depending on the completeness and accuracy of the information submitted.

**Q: Does using the Chat Widget guarantee Campaign approval?**

No. Although the Chat Widget is recommended, all registrations remain subject to applicable carrier and registration requirements.

**Q: Can I create a Campaign before my Brand is approved?**

No. Campaign creation requires an approved Brand.

**Q: Can I start registrations on behalf of my sub-accounts?**

Yes. Agency administrators and owners can initiate Brand and Campaign registrations directly from the Agency Trust Center by selecting the appropriate sub-account.

**Q: Does the Agency Trust Center replace the sub-account Trust Center?**

No. The existing sub-account Trust Center remains available. The Agency Trust Center provides an additional centralized management experience.

**Q: Can I export registration data?**

CSV export is not available in the initial version of the Agency Trust Center.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Registering Your A2P Brand](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000008140)
- [What is A2P 10 DLC: Brand and Campaign Registration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002380)

title_en: Using AskAI for Ad Manager
source_md:
Ad Manager

# Using AskAI for Ad Manager

Create, manage, and optimize advertising campaigns through natural-language conversations with AskAI.

What You'll Learn

This article explains how to use AskAI to handle advertising workflows across Meta and Google Ads. You'll learn how to create campaigns conversationally, manage existing campaigns, build audiences, access campaign resources, review performance data, and connect advertising accounts.

AskAI makes Ad Manager capabilities available through guided conversations, allowing you to describe your advertising goals and receive actionable campaign recommendations without navigating multiple screens.

## What is AskAI for Ad Manager?

AskAI for Ad Manager brings advertising capabilities into HighLevel's conversational AI interface. You can describe what you want to achieve in plain language, and AskAI guides you through campaign creation, audience setup, performance analysis, and account management across Meta and Google Ads.

Instead of navigating multiple screens and menus, you interact with AskAI using natural-language requests. AskAI collects the necessary details, configures supported settings, and presents drafts or recommendations for your review before any changes are published.

This integration establishes the foundation for a dedicated Ad Manager sub-agent that will support more complex and proactive advertising workflows in future releases.

## Key Benefits

Using AskAI for Ad Manager delivers measurable improvements across your advertising workflow:

**Faster Campaign Creation** — Move from an advertising goal to a campaign draft through a guided conversation, eliminating manual navigation across multiple setup screens.

**Simpler Setup** — Configure audiences, conversions, targeting, and assets without switching between interfaces or memorizing resource IDs.

**Unified Assistance** — Create, manage, report on, and improve campaigns from one conversational experience instead of separate tools.

**Safer Execution** — Draft-first creation and approval-based actions keep you in control. Publishing and destructive actions always require explicit confirmation.

**Foundation for Agentic Advertising** — Establishes the capabilities required for a specialized Ad Manager sub-agent that will support broader advertising outcomes.

## Creating Campaigns with AskAI

AskAI can collect campaign requirements, configure supported settings, and create campaigns for your review. All campaigns are saved as drafts and published only after you provide explicit approval.

How AskAI Guides Campaign Creation

AskAI uses a structured question flow to gather all required campaign details. After you describe your goal, AskAI asks targeted questions to capture campaign configuration, displays what it has captured with checkmarks, and confirms details before creating the draft.

Example: Google Search Campaign

Creating a Campaign for a Fitness Website

**User request:** "Let's create a Google Search campaign for my website https://www.anytimefitness.com/en-in/locations/mumbai-maharashtra-in-1221 running from tomorrow to next Saturday for budget 10$ per day. Target all genders, language Hindi Marathi and English with age range 20 - 45"

**AskAI verifies integration:** "Ad Manager is active. Let me check your Google integration and set up the campaign steps."

**Confirms connection:** "Google is connected. Let me mark that done and kick off Task 1 — Campaign Basics."

**Displays captured details:** Landing URL (carra.co.in), Network (Search only), Daily Budget ($10/day), Schedule (Aug 1 → Aug 8, 2026), Gender (All genders), Languages (Hindi, Marathi & English), Age Range (20–45).

**Asks follow-up questions:** "What should we call this campaign?" → User: "Anytime fitness mumbai"

**Asks bidding strategy:** "Which bidding strategy should we use?" → User: "Maximize Clicks (recommended)"

**Asks targeting confirmation:** "Should ads target Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (city - 1.3M reach)?" → User confirms location.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077600173/original/5l-dzh0dU8SI8mRhqsU10vecznBnVEuvYQ.png?1785851481)

Example: Meta Lead Generation Campaign

Creating a Campaign with Ad Copy

**User request:** "Create a campaign with headlines 'Fresh cakes every day', 'We bake what you want', 'Flavour in every bite' and descriptions 'Delicious hand crafted cakes', 'Instagrammable cakes'"

**AskAI confirms approval:** "Everything looks great! Let me put together your campaign summary for review before we create it."

**Shows approval status:** "APPROVED — Create Google Search Campaign — Sweet Crumbs Cake Shop"

**Confirms draft creation:** "Please review the details above and approve to save the campaign as a draft. You'll then be able to publish it live to Google Ads!"

**Saves draft successfully:** "Your campaign draft has been saved successfully!" with a summary table showing Campaign Name, Status (Draft), Daily Budget ($10/day), and Locations (Thane, Bandra West).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077600388/original/sWSsjO-H8XMnUBZo9TXLW8BexO2iEGKpFg.png?1785851524)

Supported Campaign Types

Meta Campaigns

Lead Generation, Website Traffic, Engagement, and Sales

AskAI supports Meta's primary campaign objectives. Describe your advertising goal, and AskAI will guide you through the required configuration steps.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077600585/original/lr1gshXZFj1-QrElAUeoh9fy912XZ3qvgA.png?1785851584)

Google Campaigns

Search and Demand Gen

Create Google Search campaigns to appear in search results or Demand Gen campaigns to reach users across YouTube, Discover, and Gmail.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077600674/original/C_intYr1qRrjbGbCe3-rQJ-CW_FiNYqNaA.png?1785851626)

Draft-First Creation

All campaigns created through AskAI are saved as drafts. Publishing requires explicit approval, ensuring you maintain full control over when campaigns go live.

## Managing Existing Campaigns

AskAI can help you manage campaigns that have already been created. You can list campaigns, review details, edit settings, and perform campaign actions through natural-language requests.

Available Campaign Management Actions

**List and Filter Campaigns** — View campaigns across Meta and Google Ads with filtering options by platform, status, or performance criteria.

**Review Campaign Details** — Access campaign configuration, targeting settings, and current performance metrics through conversational queries.

**Edit Campaign Settings** — Modify supported campaign settings such as budgets, targeting parameters, and optimization goals.

**Clone Campaigns** — Duplicate existing campaigns to create similar campaigns with modified settings.

**Pause, Resume, or Delete** — Control campaign status or remove campaigns entirely with confirmation required before execution.

**Republish After Changes** — Apply campaign modifications and publish updated versions after reviewing proposed changes.

Note

Publishing campaigns and performing destructive actions (such as deleting campaigns or disconnecting accounts) require confirmation. AskAI will prompt you to approve these actions before executing them.

## Creating and Managing Audiences

AskAI supports key audience workflows for both Meta and Google Ads. You can create custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and platform-specific audience types without manually locating resource IDs or navigating audience setup interfaces.

Meta Audience Types

Supported Audience Types

AskAI can create Custom audiences, Lookalike audiences, Website audiences, Page engagement audiences, Lead-form audiences, and Smart List-based audiences for Meta campaigns.

Google Audience Types

Supported Audience Segments

For Google Ads, AskAI supports Customer Match audiences, Website visitor audiences, Lookalike audiences, Interest audiences, Custom audiences, and Demand Gen audience segments.

Simplified Audience Setup

AskAI can retrieve available audience sources and help you select the right option without manually locating IDs. Describe the audience you want to create, and AskAI will guide you through the configuration process.

Conversational Advertising

Create and Optimize Campaigns Through Natural Language

AskAI brings the full power of Ad Manager into a conversational interface, eliminating manual navigation and streamlining advertising workflows.

## Accessing Campaign Resources

AskAI can retrieve supporting resources required during campaign setup. Instead of manually navigating to different sections of Ad Manager to find resource IDs, you can request these resources through AskAI.

Meta Resources

**Meta Pages and Instagram Accounts** — Retrieve connected Pages and Instagram accounts available for campaign promotion.

**Tracking Resources** — Access datasets, pixels, lead forms, and conversation forms configured in your Meta advertising account.

Google Resources

**Conversion Tracking** — Retrieve conversion actions and conversion goals configured in Google Ads.

**Campaign Assets** — Access images, videos, and other creative assets available for use in campaigns.

Targeting Options

**Keywords and Interests** — Search available keywords and interest categories for targeting configuration.

**Locations and Languages** — Retrieve geographic targeting options and language settings.

**Demographics** — Access demographic targeting options including age ranges, gender, and household income.

## Understanding Campaign Performance

AskAI can retrieve and present performance data for campaigns, ad groups or ad sets, ads, and keywords. You can request data for specific date ranges and receive results in multiple formats including visual trend charts.

Example: Meta Click Analysis

Analyzing Campaign Performance Over Time

**User request:** "Can you create a line for Meta Ad Manager platform for clicks in the last year"

**AskAI confirms subscription:** "Subscription confirmed. Now fetching monthly click data in parallel across all 12 months."

**Displays monthly breakdown:** Shows click totals for each month (Aug 2025: 48, Sep 2025: 7, Oct 2025 through May 2026: 0, Jun 2026: 0, Jul 2026: 16)

**Renders trend chart:** AskAI generates a line graph showing Meta Ad Manager Monthly Clicks (Aug 2025 - Jul 2026) with clear visualization of click trends over time.

Performance Data Types

Performance Level

Campaigns, Ad Groups, Ad Sets, Ads, and Keywords

Request performance data at any supported level. AskAI can show results for entire campaigns or drill down into individual ads and keywords.

Presentation Formats

**Performance Summaries** — High-level overview of key metrics including impressions, clicks, conversions, and cost data.

**Metric Breakdowns** — Detailed metric analysis comparing performance across campaigns, ad sets, or time periods.

**Trend Graphs** — Visual line charts showing performance trends over the selected date range with monthly or daily breakdowns.

**Campaign Improvement Suggestions** — Recommendations for optimizing campaign performance based on current data.

Custom Date Ranges

Specify any date range when requesting performance data. Examples include "last 7 days", "this month", "last 30 days", "last year", or custom start and end dates.

## Connecting Advertising Accounts

AskAI can guide you through the Ad Manager account-connection and authorization flow for Meta and Google Ads. The connection process follows the same security and compliance requirements as connecting accounts directly through Ad Manager.

Existing Ad Manager permissions, subscription rules, account access controls, and platform compliance requirements continue to apply when connecting accounts through AskAI.

Note

Disconnecting advertising accounts requires confirmation before execution. AskAI will prompt you to approve this action to prevent accidental disconnections.

## User Control and Safeguards

AskAI is designed to assist users without making critical advertising decisions independently. Multiple safeguards ensure you maintain full control over your advertising activities.

Built-In Safeguards

**Draft-First Creation** — All campaigns are saved as drafts by default. Publishing requires explicit user approval.

**Approval-Based Publishing** — Campaign publication always requires explicit approval, preventing accidental or premature launches.

**Destructive Action Confirmation** — Deleting campaigns, removing Pages, and disconnecting accounts require confirmation before execution.

**Meta Special Ad Category Enforcement** — Meta's Special Ad Category requirements are enforced during campaign creation for campaigns targeting housing, employment, credit, or social issues.

**Existing Permission Checks** — All role and permission checks from Ad Manager continue to apply. AskAI respects existing account access controls.

**Redirects for Unsupported Actions** — When you request an action not yet supported by AskAI, it will redirect you to the relevant Ad Manager interface.

User Control Priority

AskAI is designed as an assistant tool. You maintain full control over all advertising decisions, campaign launches, and account-level actions. No critical advertising action executes without your explicit approval.

## How to Use AskAI for Ad Manager

Follow these steps to create or manage campaigns using AskAI:

Step 1

Open AskAI

Access AskAI from your HighLevel account. The AskAI interface is available from the main navigation or quick access menu.

Step 2

Describe Your Advertising Task

Use natural language to describe what you want to accomplish. Examples include "Create a Meta lead generation campaign," "Show my active campaigns," or "Build a Google Search campaign using my website."

Step 3

Provide Additional Details

Answer any follow-up questions from AskAI. For campaign creation, this may include budget, targeting preferences, conversion goals, or asset selection.

Step 4

Review the Generated Campaign or Proposed Action

AskAI presents a draft campaign or action summary for your review. Verify all settings, targeting parameters, and configuration details before proceeding.

Step 5

Approve the Action

When prompted, provide explicit approval to publish the campaign or execute the requested action. AskAI will not publish campaigns or perform destructive actions without your confirmation.

Example Requests

| Task Type | Example Request |
| --- | --- |
| Meta Lead Campaign | "Create a Meta lead generation campaign" |
| Google Search Campaign | "Let's create a Google Search campaign for my website https://www.anytimefitness.com running from tomorrow to next Saturday for budget 10$ per day" |
| Campaign with Ad Copy | "Create a campaign with headlines 'Fresh cakes every day', 'We bake what you want' and descriptions 'Delicious hand crafted cakes'" |
| Campaign Listing | "Show my active campaigns" |
|

title_en: AI Studio Cloud Backend
source_md:
Cloud in AI Studio gives your apps a built-in backend to store data, manage user accounts, and handle file uploads without connecting a separate backend service. Each project gets its own managed Cloud environment that can be configured directly within AI Studio. This article covers how to enable Cloud and manage its database, authentication, storage, security, and advanced settings.

[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/aPGT2nWNrOiTGVPQe0Xl)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Cloud in AI Studio?](#What-is-Cloud-in-AI-Studio?)
- [How to Enable Cloud in AI Studio](#How-to-Enable-Cloud-in-AI-Studio)
- [Cloud Overview Dashboard](#Cloud-Overview-Dashboard)
- [Database](#Database)
- [Users and Authentication](#Users-and-Authentication)
- [Storage](#Storage)
- [Advanced Settings](#Advanced-Settings)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Cloud in AI Studio?**

Cloud is a managed backend for apps built in HighLevel AI Studio. It provides a database for saving information, authentication for managing app users, and file storage for uploads such as images and documents.

Cloud is created specifically for your project and can be managed from the AI Studio builder. You can view stored information, configure access, manage resources, and ask AI Studio to create database tables or policies without setting up a separate backend.

AI Studio also asks for your confirmation before building features that use Cloud.

---

## **How to Enable Cloud in AI Studio**

Cloud can be enabled directly from your AI Studio project. Once activated, HighLevel provisions the backend services required for your application, which typically takes about a minute.

```
Prerequisite: Cloud supports projects built on TanStack Start. If you have an existing React project, go to Project Settings → Migrate to SSR first. Migration creates an upgraded copy while leaving your original live project unchanged. You must enable Cloud separately after migration.
```

1. Log in to your account.
2. Select **AI Studio** from the left-hand navigation menu.
3. Create a new project by entering a prompt describing your app, or open an existing project.
4. Once the project is ready, click **More → Cloud** in the AI Studio builder.
5. Open **Overview** and click **Enable Cloud**.
6. Wait for Cloud to finish provisioning. You can continue working on your project while setup runs.
7. Once connected, the Cloud dashboard becomes available with the **Database**, **Users**, **Storage**, and **Secrets** options.

**Note:** If Cloud setup fails, your existing app remains unchanged. Click **Try again** to resume setup.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/xTITJTHyOFRkA8GF2jIK+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-09+at+19.39.36.gif)

---

## **Cloud Overview Dashboard**

The Cloud Overview dashboard provides a central location to monitor your project's backend and access its services. It displays the current connection status, database instance, and resource usage so you can quickly check the backend's condition.

Once Cloud is enabled, go to **Cloud → Overview** to access:

- **Connection Status:** Displays whether your Cloud instance is connected.
- **Database:** Shows existing tables and their record counts.
- **Users:** Displays registered user counts and authentication settings.
- **Storage:** Shows storage buckets used by your application.
- **Secrets:** Provides access to the project's Secrets area.

Click on a section to access its detailed management page.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/x0N00LOjymtDTn1MbqMO+/Screen+Shot+2026-10-09+at+19.47.59.png)

---

## **Database**

The Database feature stores your application's structured data, such as user profiles, orders, and other records. It lets you manage the information saved by your app while using row-level security (RLS) policies to control which records users can access.

To manage your database, go to **Cloud → Database**.

#### **Optimize the Database**

Click **Optimize** on the Database page to send a database health-check request to AI Studio chat. This helps identify potential performance or efficiency improvements.

```
Note: Database optimization uses AI Studio credits, like other chat requests.
```

#### **Manage Database Tables and Records**

The Database page lists tables in your project's public schema, their approximate row counts, and their RLS policy status.

- **View records:** Select a table to open its data.
- **Add records:** Open a table and add new rows.
- **Edit records:** Double-click a cell to modify its value.
- **Delete records:** Select the rows you want to remove and delete them.
- **Update the schema:** Ask AI Studio in chat to create or modify tables and policies. Schema changes are handled through AI Studio rather than direct schema editing in the database browser.

#### **Manage Row-Level Security (RLS) Policies**

RLS policies control which database records different users can access or modify. For example, a policy can allow signed-in users to view or update only their own orders.

1. Open **Cloud → Database**.
2. Click **RLS policies**.
3. Review the policies associated with each table, including the policy name, command, applicable user role, and rule expression.
4. To change a policy, describe the required access behavior to AI Studio in chat.

#### **Manage Database Backups**

Cloud automatically creates daily backups of your database schema and records.

1. Go to **Cloud → Database → Backups**.
2. Review the available database snapshots.
3. Select the required snapshot and use **Restore** when you need to recover an earlier database state.

```
Important: Restoring a backup replaces the current live database with the selected snapshot. Database access is temporarily interrupted for a few minutes during restoration. Backups do not include uploaded storage files or application code. If the restored schema no longer matches your app, ask AI Studio to update the code.
```

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/IIIXNcPSJsFSh2m34Pov+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-09+at+20.13.41.gif)

---

## **Users and Authentication**

Cloud includes user management and authentication settings for controlling how people access your application. You can monitor registrations, manage individual accounts, and configure security requirements for sign-ins and passwords.

#### **Manage App Users**

Go to **Cloud → Users** to access the user management dashboard.

- **Monitor signups:** View registration activity using the Signups chart and its date-range filter.
- **Search users:** Find registered users by email address.
- **Add users:** Click **Add user** to create an already-confirmed account without sending an email.
- **Invite users:** Use **Send invitation** to email a user a link to set their password.
- **View user details:** Select a user to review their sign-in methods and account information.
- **Delete users:** Open a user account and select **Delete user** to remove it permanently.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/XLTo5fwkWhs3Iv7hOsku+/image+%286%29+%281%29.png)

#### **Configure Authentication Settings**

Go to **Cloud → Users → Auth settings** to control how users sign in and register.

| Setting | Function |
| --- | --- |
| Sign-in methods | Configure supported authentication methods. The initial release supports email and password. |
| Allow new sign-ups | Enable or disable new registrations without signing out existing users. |
| Anonymous users | Allow anonymous user authentication when enabled. |
| Advanced | Access additional authentication configuration options. |

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/4MO5tTLLFpB9v8Ey5qHA+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-09+at+20.19.31.gif)

#### **Configure Email and Password Security**

Under **Auth settings → Email**, you can configure the following options:

- **Minimum password length:** Set the required password length (minimum 6 characters; 8 or more recommended).
- **Required password characters:** Define which character groups passwords must contain.
- **Check against known breaches:** Reject passwords found in publicly known data breaches.
- **Re-authenticate to change password:** Require the current password before a user sets a new one.
- **Auto-confirm email:** Skip email verification for testing purposes only.
- **Secure email change:** Require confirmation through both the old and new email addresses.
- **Advanced:** Configure available one-time code expiration and length settings.

```
Important: Email confirmation is required by default. Keep Auto-confirm email disabled for production applications.
```

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Or6fqH0DZhMdArpYDdut+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-09+at+20.22.30.gif)

#### **Configure Authentication URLs**

Authentication URLs determine where users are directed during login, registration, and account recovery.

- **Site URL:** Set the primary URL for your application.
- **Redirect URLs:** Add the URLs users can return to after authentication, including supported mobile deep links such as `myapp://callback`.

AI Studio handles preview URLs automatically. Ensure your configured URLs match the application URLs, as mismatches can cause authentication failures.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/pxqmoAGzGHl0dGLGVWmI+/Screen+Shot+2026-10-09+at+20.23.57.png)

---

## **Storage**

Cloud Storage manages files uploaded and used by your application, including images and documents. Files are organized into buckets, with access controlled by bucket visibility and row-level security policies.

#### **Create and Manage Storage Buckets**

1. Go to **Cloud → Storage**.
2. Click **New bucket**.
3. Enter a bucket name containing 3–63 characters, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
4. Choose the bucket's visibility:

   - **Public:** Files can be accessed by anyone with the file link.
   - **Private:** Files are restricted to signed-in users, subject to access policies.
5. Create the bucket to begin storing files.

**Note:** Bucket names cannot be changed after creation.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/QcUof19XbzX89Jughwps+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-09+at+20.25.28.gif)

#### **Manage Files**

Open an existing bucket to perform the following actions:

- Upload files and media.
- Create folders to organize stored files.
- Download or delete files.
- Rename files.
- Copy file URLs for use in your application.

```
Important: Renaming a file changes its URL. Update any references that use the previous URL.
```

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/IwD0LTFTxcqqFQcgTvQt+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-09+at+20.27.12.gif)

#### **Configure Upload Limits and Access**

On the Storage page:

- Use **Upload size limit** to define the largest file a bucket can accept. The default is 2 GB, with a maximum of 5 GB.
- Click **Save** after updating the limit.
- Open **RLS policies** to review the rules that control storage access.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/oUwMX7WmM9ceBbqPsb02+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-09+at+20.28.21.gif)

---

## **Advanced Settings**

Advanced settings let you control the resources allocated to your Cloud backend. You can increase database capacity, manage storage, pause unused resources, or permanently remove Cloud from a project.

Go to **Cloud → Overview → Advanced settings** to access these controls.

#### **Manage Database Size**

Cloud starts with the free **Tiny** database instance. You can change the instance size depending on your application's resource requirements.

Available sizes include:

- Tiny
- Mini
- Small
- Medium
- Large
- X-Large

Click **Manage** next to **Database size** to review available options and their hourly pricing.

Database size can be increased or decreased once per hour. Changes take a few minutes and briefly restart the application.

#### **Manage Database Storage**

Click **Manage** next to **Database storage** to increase allocated database space.

- Database storage can be increased up to four times per day.
- Allocated database storage cannot be decreased.
- Charges are based on the allocated space and continue even when Cloud is paused.

File storage is billed differently: its usage increases or decreases with the files stored, and charges are based on the amount actually stored.

#### **Pause or Wake Up Cloud**

Click **Pause** under **Pause Cloud** to stop access to the Cloud backend while preserving its data.

To reactivate a paused Cloud instance, open the project's **Cloud** tab and click **Wake up**.

If your wallet balance is insufficient to cover Cloud charges, Cloud may be paused automatically without deleting your data. Once your wallet balance is sufficient again, Cloud wakes up automatically, although this may take some time. 

You can also open the project's **Cloud** tab and click **Wake up** to restore access instead of waiting for automatic recovery.

#### **Remove Cloud**

Click **Remove** under **Remove Cloud** to permanently delete the project's Cloud backend.

```
Warning: Removing Cloud permanently deletes the project's database, users, and stored files. Export database tables as CSV files and download any required files before removal. Other AI Studio projects are not affected.
```

*![](https://jumpshare.com/share/eKFAVskwS7YKAXdNeRfS+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-09+at+20.29.55.gif)*

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

#### **Q: Does enabling Cloud automatically update my published application?**

No. Your existing published application remains unchanged until you publish the updated project again.

**Q: What happens to Cloud data when I share or remix an AI Studio project?**

When you share or remix an AI Studio project, the copy is disconnected from the original project's Cloud backend and does not send requests to it. If you enable Cloud on the copied project, a new backend is created with the same database table structure, but without any existing records, users, or files from the original project.

#### **Q: Are submissions from AI Studio forms connected to the HighLevel CRM automatically stored in Cloud?**

No. Submissions from AI Studio forms connected to the HighLevel CRM are sent to the connected sub-account's CRM. Cloud database storage is a separate capability.

#### **Q: Where are authentication emails sent from?**

Signup confirmation, invitation, and password reset emails are sent through your account's email configuration. The links in these emails direct users back to your application.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [AI Studio in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007587)
- [AI Studio: SSR, Server Functions, REST APIs, and Secrets](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008701-ai-studio-ssr-server-functions-rest-apis-and-secrets)
- [Code Editor in the AI Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007652-code-editor-in-the-ai-studio)
- [AI Studio - Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008322-ai-studio-pricing)

title_en: AI Usage Dashboard
source_md:
The AI Usage Dashboard in HighLevel gives Agency Admins a centralized place to monitor AI activity, usage, and billing across their agency. From AI Suite, admins can review transaction totals, wallet charges, token consumption, usage trends, billing coverage, product-level activity, and individual AI transactions. Filters and reporting controls make it easier to move from an agency-wide overview to the specific location, reporting period, product, or transaction that needs attention.

**Note:** The AI Usage Dashboard is available at the **Agency level for Agency Admins**. Agency Admins can review activity across all locations or narrow the dashboard to an individual sub-account.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the AI Usage Dashboard?](#what-is-ai-usage-dashboard)
- [Key Benefits of AI Usage Dashboard](#key-benefits)
- [Filter AI Usage by Location and Date Range](#filter-location-date)
- [Summary Cards](#summary-cards)
- [Expanded Usage Details](#expanded-usage-details)
- [Usage Over Time](#usage-over-time)
- [Transactions Table](#transactions-table)
- [Transaction Details](#transaction-details)
- [Supported AI Products](#supported-products)
- [How To Setup AI Usage Dashboard](#how-to-setup)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#frequently-asked-questions)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

# **What is the AI Usage Dashboard?**

The AI Usage Dashboard is the reporting area within **AI Suite** for understanding how AI products are being used and billed across an agency. It combines high-level usage totals, trend reporting, billing details, product activity, and individual transaction records so Agency Admins can begin with an overall view and investigate specific activity when needed.

From **Agency View**, select **AI Suite**, then select the **Usage Dashboard** tab.

At the top of the dashboard, you can:

1. Choose the location or sub-account you want to review.
2. Choose the reporting period.
3. Review Total Transactions, Charged to Wallet, and Total Tokens Used.
4. Select **Show More Details** for additional billing and product information.
5. Review the Usage over time chart.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079963707/original/6dI1Ugt6UbrVH4DwgJO2Ns4T3To61rAH_Q.png?1788408704)**

---

## **Key Benefits of AI Usage Dashboard**

Centralized AI reporting helps agencies understand both overall AI consumption and the individual events behind that activity. Agency Admins can use one dashboard to review usage trends, understand billing coverage, compare products, and investigate specific transactions without moving between multiple AI product areas.

- **Centralized visibility:** Review AI usage, transactions, tokens, and billing information from AI Suite.
- **Agency-wide monitoring:** Review all locations together or focus on one specific sub-account.
- **Billing transparency:** Understand how AI activity is divided between wallet charges, subscriptions, promotions, and free or zero-charge usage.
- **Flexible trend analysis:** Compare Cost, Tokens, and Events using different chart, grouping, and interval options.
- **Product-level insights:** Identify which AI products are generating activity within the selected reporting period.
- **Transaction-level investigation:** Open individual AI events to review billing, usage, processing components, and identifiers.

---

## **Filter AI Usage by Location and Date Range**

Filtering the dashboard before investigating activity ensures that every summary card, chart, breakdown, and transaction reflects the business and reporting period you actually want to review. This is especially useful for agencies managing AI usage across multiple sub-accounts.

To filter the dashboard:

1. Go to **Agency View → AI Suite → Usage Dashboard**.
2. Select **All Locations**.
3. Choose the sub-account you want to review, or leave **All Locations** selected for an agency-wide view.
4. Choose **1d, 7d, 30d, 90d, Month,** or **Custom**.
5. If you select **Custom**, choose the start and end dates.
6. Allow the dashboard to refresh with the selected data.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079963482/original/xdG8_Ra0FFwneJ0G755xioJQq9N1zBdS3A.gif?1788407918)**

After the dashboard refreshes, the selected Location and reporting period apply across the summary cards, Usage over time chart, expanded details, and Transactions Table.

---

## **Summary Cards**

The summary cards provide a quick snapshot of AI activity within the currently selected Location and reporting period. Reviewing these totals first gives Agency Admins a baseline before they investigate billing coverage, product usage, trends, or individual transactions.

- **Total Transactions:** Displays the number of AI transactions included in the selected reporting scope.
- **Charged to Wallet:** Displays the amount charged to the agency wallet and the number of charged events.
- **Total Tokens Used:** Displays total token consumption, including input and output tokens.

Changing the Location or date range updates these totals along with the rest of the dashboard.

---

## **Expanded Usage Details**

Expanded Usage Details help explain how overall AI activity is being covered or charged and which products are contributing to usage. This is useful when the summary cards show activity that you want to investigate in greater detail.

To open the expanded view:

1. Confirm that the correct Location and reporting period are selected.
2. Select **Show More Details** below the summary cards.
3. Review the additional Billing Coverage, Cost Breakdown, and Usage by Product areas that appear.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079963470/original/3wYbR0Hy6XsNqImLclfmKMiBoljX3RpYiw.gif?1788407873)**

### **Billing Coverage**

Billing Coverage explains how gross AI usage is distributed across different coverage types. This helps Agency Admins understand why Total Gross Usage may be different from the amount actually charged to the wallet.

- Total Gross Usage
- Charged to Wallet
- Covered by Promo
- Covered by Subscription
- Free / Zero Charge

### **Cost Breakdown**

Cost Breakdown separates AI usage according to the underlying services generating costs. This helps identify whether activity is primarily associated with language models, voice services, generated media, web searches, or other billable components.

- LLM Cost
- Text-to-Speech
- Image Generation
- Video Generation
- Call Duration
- Web Search
- Flat Product

### **Usage by Product**

Usage by Product shows which AI products generated activity within the selected Location and reporting period. Product cards can include usage totals, event counts, token consumption, and applicable billing coverage.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079963771/original/WJPHO-BEi5ShEtGf2dwq-rebXPmYdhu3_Q.png?1788408850)**

---

## **Usage Over Time**

The Usage over time chart helps Agency Admins identify when AI activity occurred and how usage changes across the selected reporting period. The chart can be adjusted by metric, visualization type, grouping, and time interval so the same activity can be analyzed from different perspectives.

Configure the chart from left to right:

1. **Choose what to measure:** Select **Cost**, **Tokens**, or **Events**.
2. **Choose the chart type:** Select **Bar** or **Line**.
3. **Choose how the data is grouped:** Select **None**, **Product**, **Model**, or **Billing**.
4. **Choose the time interval:** Select **Hourly**, **Daily**, **Weekly**, or **Monthly**.

For example, selecting **Cost → Bar → Product → Daily** lets you compare daily AI costs grouped by product.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079963793/original/hI50htAt8cBo9_H8z7hRz2NQhPSw3P1u6w.png?1788408964)**

---

## **Transactions Table**

The Transactions Table provides the individual AI events behind the dashboard totals and charts. Reviewing this table is useful when you need to locate a specific charge, compare transactions across products or locations, or identify the event responsible for a particular usage record.

Scroll below the Usage over time chart until the Transactions Table appears.

Use the controls above the table to work with the displayed records:

1. Select **Add Filter** to narrow the transaction list.
2. Select **Sort: Date** to change the transaction order.
3. Select **Group by** to organize related transactions.
4. Select any transaction row to open its detailed record.

The Transactions Table can display:

- Location
- Product
- Sub Product
- Plan Type
- Billing Mode
- Gross Charge
- Call Min
- Date

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079963830/original/i_CZlJUG-3IMnBtjnqEa_grUvZoV0T3GIw.png?1788409096)**

---

## **Transaction Details**

Transaction Details provide the most granular information available for an individual AI event. This view helps Agency Admins understand what product generated the event, how it was billed, what usage was recorded, and which components contributed to the transaction.

To open a transaction:

1. Scroll to the **Transactions Table**.
2. Locate the transaction you want to investigate.
3. Select the transaction row.
4. Review the Transaction Detail panel that opens on the right.
5. Scroll through the panel when additional information is available.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079963433/original/bHkf0AWFk9ZbWR9zj4uJ3E5eJBQ72iyQdg.gif?1788407740)**

Depending on the transaction type, the detail panel can include:

- Product
- Sub Product
- Model
- Billing Mode
- Created At
- Input Tokens
- Output Tokens
- Total Tokens
- Call Duration
- Gross Charge
- Location charged
- Agency charged
- Components
- Trace
- Entry ID
- Transaction ID

The information available can vary depending on the AI product. For example, a Voice AI transaction can display call duration and voice-processing components even when input and output token usage is zero.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079963861/original/1efUPdSZECx4F8S2b1qlwQptldx2XzDKKA.png?1788409226)**

---

## **Supported AI Products**

Usage by Product helps Agency Admins identify which HighLevel AI products generated reportable activity within the selected Location and reporting period. Because the dashboard reflects actual usage, the products displayed can vary between agencies and date ranges.

Products visible in the current dashboard can include:

- Ask AI
- Managed Agents
- Voice AI
- Conversations AI
- AI Studio
- Performance AI
- Agent Studio
- Commerce
- Content AI Image
- Content AI Text
- Reviews AI
- Business Card Scanner AI

A product may not appear if it did not generate reportable activity within the selected Location and reporting period.

For current product-specific pricing and usage information, refer to [AI Product Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006652-ai-product-pricing).

---

## **How To Setup AI Usage Dashboard**

The AI Usage Dashboard does not require a separate setup or configuration process before Agency Admins can begin reviewing activity. Using the dashboard effectively means selecting the appropriate reporting scope and moving from high-level usage totals to detailed transaction records when additional investigation is needed.

With your Agency View open, follow this complete workflow:

1. Go to **Agency View → AI Suite**.
2. Select **Usage Dashboard**.
3. Choose **All Locations** or select the specific sub-account you want to review.
4. Choose **1d, 7d, 30d, 90d, Month,** or **Custom** for the reporting period.
5. Review **Total Transactions**, **Charged to Wallet**, and **Total Tokens Used**.
6. Select **Show More Details** to review Billing Coverage, Cost Breakdown, and Usage by Product.
7. Use **Usage over time** to select a metric, chart type, grouping option, and time interval.
8. Scroll to the Transactions Table.
9. Use **Add Filter**, **Sort: Date**, or **Group by** when you need to narrow or organize the records.
10. Select an individual transaction to review its detailed usage and billing information.

**Note:** Use **AI Suite → Plans & Limits** when you need to configure or review AI usage limits rather than investigate usage activity. For additional guidance, refer to [AI Usage Limits](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007813-ai-usage-limits).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can sub-account users open the AI Usage Dashboard from their location?**  
No. The dashboard is accessed from the Agency level. Agency Admins can use the Location selector to review individual sub-account activity within the Agency-level dashboard.

**Q: Why can Total Gross Usage be higher than Charged to Wallet?**  
Total Gross Usage represents usage before billing coverage is applied. Some activity may be covered by a subscription, promotion, or free/zero-charge billing instead of being charged directly to the agency wallet.

**Q: Why do the products under Usage by Product change when I change the reporting period?**  
Usage by Product reflects reportable activity within the selected Location and reporting period. Products without activity in the selected scope may not appear.

**Q: Why are some transaction fields blank?**  
The information available depends on the type of AI event. A field that does not apply to the selected transaction may not contain a value.

**Q: Why might a transaction display Free charge?**  
Some AI activity can occur without a corresponding wallet charge. Review the transaction's billing information and the Billing Coverage area for additional context.

**Q: Why might a Voice AI transaction show zero tokens?**  
Some Voice AI activity is represented through call duration and voice-related components rather than input and output token usage.

**Q: What are Entry ID and Transaction ID used for?**  
These identifiers distinguish individual AI events and can help when reviewing or troubleshooting a specific transaction.

**Q: Can I compare AI usage by model instead of product?**  
Yes. In the Usage over time chart, select **Model** from the grouping controls.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [AI Product Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006652-ai-product-pricing)
- [AI Usage Limits](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007813-ai-usage-limits)
- [AI Employee: Access, Rebilling and Reselling](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003906)

This feature allows you to streamline notifications to suit your business needs, ensuring effective communication with your customers

# **What are Customizable Calendar Notifications?**

With customizable calendar notifications, you can send In-App and tailored emails, SMS and WhatsApp messages when appointments are booked, canceled, rescheduled, or need reminders or follow-ups. Notifications can be configured for Contacts, Guests, Users, and any additional email addresses/phone numbers you specify. This feature allows you to streamline notifications to suit your business needs, ensuring effective communication with your

---

## **Available Notification Options**

You now have the option to set up six different types of appointment notifications. These notifications can be either email notifications and/or in-app notifications.

1. **Appointment Booked (Unconfirmed Status):** Sent immediately when an appointment is booked with the unconfirmed status.
2. **Appointment Booked (Confirmed Status):** Sent immediately when an appointment is booked with the confirmed status confirmed or when an appointment's status is updated to confirmed.
3. **Cancellation Email:** Sent when an appointment is canceled, marked as no-show, or deemed invalid.
4. **Reschedule Email:** Sent when the appointment date or time is changed.
5. **Reminder Email:** Sent before the appointment based on the timing you configure.
6. **Follow-Up Email:** Sent after the appointment based on the timing you configure.

```
Note: To prevent missed meetings, staff can enable internal alerts/notifications for appointments booked without a meeting link/location. Configure it in Settings → My Staff → [Staff] → Notification Settings → Calendar Notifications → Notify when meeting link/location is missing.
```

---

## **How to Set Up Appointment Notifications**

You can manage email notifications at the individual calendar level. Follow these steps to configure your settings.

#### **Step 1:**Navigate to the Notifications Tab

1. Go to **Calendar > Calendar Settings.**
2. Select the calendar you wish to configure.
3. Click on the **Notifications** tab.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035031766/original/2Eh8_NnR43k9hinolLwSiDBf0I_Gjc1lWA.png?1729411994)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035031794/original/OriLlXqHvzaahnlfEpp8phkWon6jlLhZXA.png?1729412089)

#### 

#### **Step 2:**Customize Your Notifications

You have several options to customize each notification type to give you, your team, and your customers the best experience possible!

- **Customize Content** for each receiver type: Contact, Guest, User, or Additional Emails/Phone Numbers.
- **Disable Notifications** for certain receiver types if you do not want them to receive a specific notification

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035031826/original/-7fpip6tM60KitNDVaoKz4VKHTtnBp1MrA.png?1729412151)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035032450/original/53hyQmVM-1KH6oFCbp--zcAF6qg6nsYn-g.png?1729413848)

---

## **Localized Default Notification Templates**

Default Email, SMS, and WhatsApp notification templates use the **Business Profile Platform Language**, wherever supported.

- New calendars: No action required. Default templates are automatically localized.
- Existing calendars: Go to Calendar Settings → Notifications for the relevant calendar and select Reset to default on the template to load the localized version.

Customized templates remain unchanged unless manually reset.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083350547/original/D-ScTWVDHbE8zte5_OYXvC8wOb-iFN1p8A.png?1792003991)

---

## **Email Appointment Notifications**

- You will see a list of all notification types. Click on the one you'd like to configure, then go to the **Email** tab. Ensure the toggle is turned on.
- Choose an existing email template or directly customize the subject line and email body. To remove the selected template, click on the first option (**None**) in the email dropdown list.
- Optionally, send a test email to see how the notification looks.
- For **Reminders** and **Follow-Up Emails**, configure when the email should be triggered:  
    
  - For **Reminders**, set how far in advance the email should be sent before the appointment.
  - For **Follow-Up Emails**, set how long after the appointment the email should be sent. You can also add multiple trigger timings if needed.
- **Save Your Settings** once you’ve configured the email notifications for each type and receiver.

```
Note: Applicable Calendar notification emails can bypass Email DND so important appointment information can still reach the recipient. Marketing and promotional emails continue to honor DND preferences.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035032459/original/anFgWVLiBtBMC0XcAukQYxBHNmM-DEcDPw.png?1729413889)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035032461/original/o4XMVxWwBy_1ObK8tidcsO8ZdLWcYoX30g.png?1729413929)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035032502/original/AuLaU6lj5UVJ3aMspU7m_cTdNJt2DX5qdA.png?1729414031)

---

## **Using Custom Values in Notifications**

You can use Custom Values to personalize your email, SMS, and WhatsApp notifications.

When editing a message, click the \*\*{ } merge field icon\*\* and select from the \*\*Custom Values\*\* section in the dropdown.

This allows you to insert your own data into notifications, such as custom links, internal notes, or personalized details, without manual edits.

---

## **In-App Appointment Notifications**

- From the list of notification types, Go to the **In-App** tab.
- **Choose the Users to Notify**
  - Ensure that the toggle is turned on
  - Here, you can choose which users should receive the notification.
- **Configure Time Triggers for Reminders and Follow-Up Notifications**
  - For **Reminders** and **Follow-Up**notifications, you can set when the notification should be triggered.  
      
    - **Reminders:** Specify how far in advance the notification should be sent before the appointment.
    - **Follow-Up:** Specify how long after the appointment the notification should be sent.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035100808/original/4XoUVr48_78ANGSSTYayjbrfBB2fq6gPiQ.jpeg?1729515498)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035100807/original/lAWIre6EQlpCy4KsJfBSKD1AgZSwDTtroA.jpeg?1729515498)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035100806/original/4thA0IDfxl8oi8rklr9leGUsilDTeNYAKg.jpeg?1729515497)

---

## **SMS Appointment Notifications**

- From the list of notification types, Go to the **SMS** tab.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055789705/original/0au_6FutB_2nlfZYN4gpDKZCtlZwV8MFDQ.png?1760254786)
- Choose recipients: **Contact**, **Assigned User**, or **Additional Phone Numbers**.
- Choose an existing SMS template, edit the SMS template if needed or create a new one.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055789719/original/2RIfs_5c3bJrrts5XM0JAK3PmMUlKxRo8w.png?1760254823)
- Optionally, send a test SMS to see how the notification looks.
- For **Reminders** and **Follow-Up SMS**, configure when the SMS should be triggered:  
    
  - For **Reminders**, set how far in advance the SMS should be sent before the appointment.
  - For **Follow-Up Emails**, set how long after the appointment the SMS should be sent. You can also add multiple trigger timings if needed.
- **Save Your Settings** once you’ve configured the SMS notifications for each type and receiver.

---

## **Whatsapp Appointment Notifications**

- Select a notification type and go to the **WhatsApp** tab. Turn the toggle **on** to enable it.
- Choose recipients: **Contact**, **Assigned User**, or **Additional Numbers**.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055789851/original/fWhaSZyrxs2YOvJjdzFU2sJ-dsuTxot2rQ.png?1760255357)
- Choose or create an **approved template** for the desired notification type.
- Use **Send Test WhatsApp Notification** to preview how the message will appear.
- Click **Save** to activate WhatsApp notifications.

---

## **Troubleshooting Blank Reschedule or Cancellation Links**

If `{{appointment.reschedule_link}}` or `{{appointment.cancellation_link}}` is blank, check the following:

- **Confirm the message is connected to an appointment.** Appointment merge fields need appointment data to populate.
- **Check the workflow trigger.** If the message is being sent from a workflow, use an appointment-based trigger.
- **Use appointment triggers when needed.** Examples include **Appointment Status** and **Customer Booked Appointment**.
- **Test with a real appointment.** Book a test appointment before checking whether appointment merge fields are working correctly.

---

## **Important Notes**

### **In-App Notifications:**

1. The in-app notification configuration is customisable - for example, you can turn on the confirmation notification for the calendar but keep all other types turned off.
2. For **Event Calendars**, the default setting is that account admins will receive the notifications.
3. For other calendar types, the **assigned user** will be selected by default to receive notifications.

### **Email Notifications:**

1. **Additional Emails** refers to any extra recipients you want to notify. Simply add their email addresses, and they’ll receive the notifications as well.
2. You can create your email templates through the **Email Builder** in **Marketing module > Emails > Templates.**
3. Ensure you have added a **subject line in your email template** for successful delivery.
4. If you have enabled the **Add Guest** function and have included a custom form, you can send that custom form to the guest as well. Enabling this option will send a system-generated email to guests with a link to the custom form once their appointment is confirmed. To prevent duplicate emails, ensure a separate confirmation email is not already set up for guests (verify this in the Notifications tab under **Confirmation Notification**).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035032671/original/Up1CxEOC_oYOM58FlvH7NEfVlAIsXFo7pw.png?1729414374)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035032756/original/V1TQkBpZWYzwkB236ewFSTy0JMbEoRWZ5g.png?1729414555)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155035032605/original/UTF4J5t2VTKju0R2OggFKs-jgTErVjD_SA.png?1729414264)

### **SMS Notifications:**

1. **Additional Phone Numbers** refers to any extra recipients you want to notify. Simply add their phone number(s), and they’ll receive the notifications as well.
2. Phone numbers must**include country codes** for successful delivery.
3. SMS messages are billed per segments and are subject to charges. Keep them concise to manage costs.

### **Whatsapp Notifications:**

1. Ensure your **WhatsApp Business Account** is connected and verified.
2. Only **approved WhatsApp templates** can be used.
3. Use **Fetch New Templates** to refresh available templates.
4. Always test templates for formatting and content before enabling.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why is my reschedule link blank?**

The reschedule link requires appointment data. If the message or workflow does not have access to an appointment record, the link may appear blank.

**Q: Why is my cancellation link blank?**

The cancellation link also requires appointment data. Confirm that the message is associated with an appointment and that any workflow sending the message uses an appointment-based trigger.

**Q: Which workflow triggers can provide appointment context?**

Common appointment-based triggers include **Appointment Status** and **Customer Booked Appointment**.

**Q: Why does an appointment merge field work after a real booking but not during a test?**

Some tests may not include appointment information. Booking a real test appointment gives HighLevel the appointment data needed to populate appointment merge fields.

**Q: Can I use appointment details in SMS and email notifications?**

Yes. You can add supported Custom Values and merge fields to appointment

---

## **Related Articles**
