## 

Digital Product Delivery lets HighLevel store owners sell downloadable products, such as ebooks, audio files, videos, documents, images, and ZIP files, through ecommerce stores. Customers can access eligible digital downloads from the Order Confirmation Email, the Thank You page download button when enabled, or the Customer Access Center after verifying their identity with an OTP sent to the checkout email address. Digital downloads appear only when at least one valid file has been uploaded to the purchased digital product or variant.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Digital Product Delivery for E-commerce Stores?](#What-is-Digital-Product-Delivery-for-E-commerce-Stores?)
- [Key Benefits of Digital Product Delivery](#Key-Benefits-of-Digital-Product-Delivery)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [Digital Product File Requirements and Limits](#Digital-Product-File-Requirements-and-Limits)
- [Customer Download Experience](#Customer-Download-Experience)
- [Enable the Download Button on the Thank You Page](#Enable-the-Download-Button-on-the-Thank-You-Page)
- [Payment, Shipping, and Fulfillment Behavior](#Payment,-Shipping,-and-Fulfillment-Behavior)
- [How To Setup Digital Product Delivery](#How-To-Setup-Digital-Product-Delivery)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Digital Product Delivery for E-commerce Stores?**

Digital product delivery helps businesses sell non-physical products without manual fulfillment. Once configured, HighLevel securely provides customers with access to their files after purchase while keeping order details and download access protected through the Customer Access Center.

---

## **Key Benefits of Digital Product Delivery**

Digital products make it easier to sell downloadable content directly from your HighLevel ecommerce store. Secure access, automatic fulfillment, and variant-level setup give store owners more control over how each product is sold and delivered.

- **Secure Customer Access:** Customers access digital files through the Customer Access Center using OTP verification sent to the email address used at checkout.
- **Automatic Digital Fulfillment:** Digital products are automatically fulfilled because no physical shipment is required.
- **Flexible Product Variants:** Store owners can configure different variants of the same product as Physical or Digital, such as Ebook, Audiobook, and Physical Book.
- **No Shipping Fees for Digital Products:** Shipping fees do not apply to digital products. When an order includes both physical and digital products, shipping is calculated only for the physical items.
- **Customer Self-Service Downloads:** Customers can return to the Customer Access Center to view current orders, past orders, and digital downloads when applicable.

---

## **Before You Begin**

Proper setup ensures customers receive download access after checkout and can securely retrieve their digital files. Before selling digital products, confirm that your store, product, variant, and notification settings are ready.

Before configuring digital product delivery, make sure you have:

- An ecommerce store created in HighLevel.
- A product created under **Payments > Products**.
- Product pricing or variants configured.
- Digital files ready to upload.
- **Order Confirmation Email for Stores** enabled under **Payments > Settings > Notifications**. If this setting is disabled, customers will not receive access emails.

For ecommerce store setup, refer to [How to Set Up an E-Commerce Online Store (Websites)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001157). For product creation, refer to [Getting Started - Create & Sell Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005071).

---

## **Digital Product File Requirements and Limits**

Digital files are attached to the product price or variant that customers purchase. This helps ensure the correct downloadable files are shown for each product option.

Digital product uploads follow these requirements:

- You can upload up to **10 files** for a digital product or variant.
- Each file can be up to **100 MB**.
- Supported file types include images, audio, video, documents, and ZIP files.
- If you need to bundle additional files together, create a ZIP file and keep it under **100 MB**.
- Store owners must save the product variant after uploading files.
- Files download as separate files, not as one automatically generated ZIP file.

---

## **Customer Download Experience**

Customers receive secure access to digital downloads after completing checkout. The Customer Access Center protects the download experience by requiring OTP login through the same email address used during checkout.

After a customer purchases a digital product:

1. The customer completes checkout in the ecommerce store.
2. The customer receives an Order Confirmation Email.
3. The email displays an **Access Downloads** or **View Order** button when the purchased digital product has at least one uploaded file.  
     
   ![image](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074313118/original/o1nG01Ar7Tndyy_r-Bj5_2-VNCT1lgcJyg.jpeg?1782219628)
4. The customer clicks the button and is redirected to the Customer Access Center.
5. The customer logs in using the OTP sent to the checkout email address.
6. The customer views the order and downloads the available digital files.

Customers can also access orders directly from:

`<storeurl>/store/account/orders`  
  
`Eg. myawesomestore.com/products/store/account/orders`

The Download button appears only when at least one valid digital file has been uploaded. If no files are uploaded, the  
Download button remains hidden, and the Customer Access Center may display **“No downloads available yet.”**

---

## **Enable the Download Button on the Thank You Page**

The Thank You page download button gives customers a faster way to access digital purchases immediately after checkout. When enabled, the button redirects customers to the Customer Access Center, where they can securely access their downloads.

To enable the Download button on the Thank You page:

1. Go to **Stores > Select Store > Edit Page Details**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074310474/original/Mn4D7u9bNTCRKeZDBZDruvLqYhKJdN8OLg.png?1782218251)
2. Select the **Thank You Page** element.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074310584/original/kK3-0VCdymCNQ2NOlPi4vFj8nv8osi6N3g.png?1782218314)
3. In the right-side panel, enable the **Download Digital Products** toggle.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074310346/original/KIV7q_mF-QO9hhcnyzTXhgJr2X1LAlJQ6Q.png?1782218196)
4. Customize the Download button text and colors.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074310843/original/NUqXr9kxf6lYGYYUnGHw3SXu-G1vRmTsZg.png?1782218446)
5. Save and publish your changes.

When customers click the Download button, they are redirected to the Customer Access Center to access eligible digital product downloads. The button remains hidden when the purchased digital product or variant does not have uploaded files.

---

## **Payment, Shipping, and Fulfillment Behavior**

Digital products follow different fulfillment and shipping behavior than physical products. Understanding these rules helps store owners set the right payment options and avoid confusion when carts include both digital and physical products.

**Important Behavior to Know:**

- Digital product delivery is available only for orders placed through ecommerce stores.
- Cash on Delivery (COD) is not available when any product in the order is digital.
- Shipping fees do not apply to digital products.
- If the cart contains both physical and digital products, standard shipping charges are calculated for the physical products only.
- If a physical product is purchased using COD, any digital upsell products must be paid for using an alternate online payment method.
- Digital products are automatically fulfilled, with fulfillment details left empty because no shipment is required.
- Physical products never display a Download button.
- In mixed orders, only digital products with uploaded files display a Download option.

---

## **How To Setup Digital Product Delivery**

Accurate setup ensures customers receive the correct download access after purchase. Digital files should be uploaded to the correct product variant, and store notifications should be enabled before customers begin purchasing.

To set up digital product delivery:

1. Go to **Payments > Products**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074311022/original/bmbLc4eWQSCOosBFd2c787Fp_7nfwc_uAg.png?1782218530)
2. Select an existing product or create a new product.
3. Open the Inventory option available under the Products.
4. Go to **Shipping and Delivery**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074312478/original/QTbIKFzV245L1DhwNHL6acgfWKtUf4xhMA.gif?1782219349)
5. Set the product or variant type to **Digital**.
6. Upload the digital files for that product or variant.
7. Confirm each uploaded file meets the file limit requirements.
8. Save the product variant after uploading files.
9. Go to **Payments > Settings > Notifications**. Enable **Order Confirmation Email for Stores**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074312799/original/e5pIWxmQU4dcXp6jWJkKFsqCqglr74bCxQ.jpeg?1782219497)
10. Save your notification settings.
11. Test the checkout experience to confirm that the customer receives the Order Confirmation Email and can access downloads through the Customer Access Center.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why is the Download button not showing after purchase?**  
The Download button appears only when at least one valid digital file has been uploaded to the purchased digital product or variant. If no files are uploaded, the button remains hidden.

**Q: Why does the Customer Access Center show “No downloads available yet”?**  
This message appears when the purchased digital product does not have uploaded files assigned to it.

**Q: What happens if I upload digital files after a customer has already purchased?**  
The Customer Access Center updates automatically. Once files are uploaded, eligible customers can access the download.

**Q: What happens if I delete uploaded digital files?**  
If all digital files are removed from a product or variant, the Download button disappears from the Thank You page and the Customer Access Center.

**Q: Can I sell both physical and digital versions of the same product?**  
Yes. You can configure separate product variants as Physical or Digital. For example, one product can include Ebook, Audiobook, and Physical Book variants.

**Q: Can customers download files without logging in?**  
No. Customers must access downloads through the Customer Access Center and verify access using the OTP sent to the checkout email address.

**Q: Can I use Cash on Delivery for digital products?**  
No. COD is not available when any product in the order is digital.

**Q: What happens when an order contains both physical and digital products?**  
The digital product is delivered through the Customer Access Center, and shipping is calculated only for the physical product.

**Q: Are digital products automatically fulfilled?**  
Yes. Digital products are automatically fulfilled because there is no physical shipment required.

**Q: Do digital files download as a ZIP file?**  
No. Files download as separate files unless the store owner uploads a ZIP file as one of the digital files.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started - Create & Sell Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005071)
- [Customer Access Center to View Current and Past Order Details](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004100)
- [Customer Login for Ecommerce Stores](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005125)
- [How to Send Confirmations After a Purchase/Order](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001437)
- [How to Set Up an E-Commerce Online Store (Websites)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001157)
- [How to Add Product Weights, Dimension, and SKU Information in Your Ecom Store](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002825)

title_en: Free AI for Agency Users
source_md:
Free AI gives your whole agency team (agency users and admins) access to HighLevel's AI Assistants. It's on automatically from Level Up, with fair-use limits that reset every month. Free AI is designed to cover your team’s everyday building and setup work. Each agency plan includes a fair-use allowance that grows with your plan.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Free AI?](#What-is-Free-AI?)
  - [Key Benefits of Free AI](#Key-Benefits-of-Free-AI)
  - [Prerequisites and Limitations](#Prerequisites-and-Limitations)
  - [Eligibility and Fair Use](#Eligibility-and-Fair-Use)
  - [How To Setup Extra Usage](#How-To-Setup-Extra-Usage)
  - [How Free AI Limits Work](#How-Free-AI-Limits-Work)
  - [What Happens When a Limit Is Reached](#What-Happens-When-a-Limit-Is-Reached)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Free AI?**

Free AI is AI usage included with your HighLevel agency plan ($97, $297 or $497) for agency admins and users. 

1. **AI Assistants (Included for Agency Users):**Tools that help users create, build, and manage their business, such as Ask AI and AI Studio. These are included at no additional cost, subject to fair-use limits.
2. **AI Agents:**Tools that perform ongoing tasks on behalf of a business, such as handling customer conversations, answering calls, and managing reviews. These remain [paid products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006652-ai-product-pricing) and may be billed through subscriptions or pay-per-use pricing.

The table below compares which AI features are included without purchasing an additional AI Employee subscription.

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AI Feature | Agency Users ($97/$297/$497 Plans) | Sub-Account Users |
| Ask AI | Free\* | Paid |
| AI Studio | Free\* | Paid |
| Creator Studio | Free\* | Paid |
| Content AI | Free\* | Paid |
| Funnel & Website AI | Free\* | Free\* |
| Email AI | Free\* | Free\* |
| Calendar AI | Free\* | Free\* |
| Layout AI | Free\* | Free\* |
| Knowledge Base | Free\* | Free\* |
| Workflow AI Builder | Free\* | Free\* |
| AI Agents (Conversation AI, Conversation AI Prompt Optimizer, Voice AI, Voice AI Prompt Optimizer, Reviews AI, Managed Agents, Workflow AI Actions) | Paid | Paid |

```
*Fair Usage Policy: Free AI features are subject to fair-use limits. Agency users on higher-tier plans receive increased allowances, and the $497 agency plan includes access to advanced Creator Studio models.
```

---

## **Key Benefits of Free AI**

Free AI removes the cost of building with AI, so you & your team can use it to setup your business without extra spend.

- **No cost to build:**AI Assistants usage by agency users and admins is included in your agency plan, subject to fair use limits.
- **Nothing to set up:**Free AI is on for every agency automatically, without additional purchase..
- **No surprise charges:**When a limit is reached, AI pauses until it resets. You're only charged if you choose to turn on Extra Usage or the sub-account where you are using AI product is subscribed to an AI Employee Subscription.
- **Clear visibility:** AI Suite page shows how much of each limit your team has used and when it resets.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

Free AI is built for your agency team and included on every agency plan. Here’s who it covers, how fair use works, and how it fits alongside the AI your clients use in their sub-accounts.

To use Free AI, make sure:

- Your agency is on the **$97, $297 or $497** HighLevel plan.
- The person using AI is an a**gency owner, admin or agency user.**

---

## **Eligibility and Fair Use**

- Each agency plan includes a fair-use allowance that grows with your plan: the $297 plan includes higher limits than the $97 plan, and the $497 Founder’s plan includes the highest limits plus access to advanced models.
- Sub-account users aren't covered. Their AI usage is billed through an AI Employee plan or [pay-per-use](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006652-ai-product-pricing).
- Free AI can't be resold or transferred to sub-accounts or sub-account users.
- One shared monthly allowance per agency. Limits aren't split per user or per sub-account.
- Some products stop at their limit. Funnel & Website AI, Email AI, Workflow AI Builder and Memberships AI have no pay-per-use option, so they pause until reset even with Extra Usage on.
- AI Studio hosting is billed separately. Nano hosting is free; Micro and above are charged. Refer to [AI Studio Cloud Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000009207) for more details.

```
*Fair Usage Policy: Free AI features are subject to fair-use limits. Agency users on higher-tier plans receive increased allowances, and the $497 agency plan includes access to advanced Creator Studio models.
```

---

## **How To Setup Extra Usage**

Extra Usage starts only when a Free AI limit (5-hour or monthly) is reached and there's no AI Employee subscription to draw usage from: in a sub-account without a subscription, or once a sub-account's plan (AI Employee Starter/AI Employee Growth/AI Employee Unlimited) has used up its included usage.   
  
Extra Usage lets your team keep working when a limit is reached instead of waiting for it to reset. **It's off by default**, and when it's on, usage past any 5-hour or monthly limit is billed at standard pay-per-use rates.

1. From the agency view, select **AI Suite** in the left-hand menu.
2. Select the [Usage Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007742-ai-usage-dashboard) tab.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084770611/original/XBpxVAXZt9JZFVrOOvDUY81vF7buFm_4lw.png?1793637042)
3. On the **Free AI**card, select **Free AI details**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084770624/original/aRWzzgNaDCs3dwoLB51f038Z6aGvY9aLjA.png?1793637063)
4. In the side panel, select the **Extra usage** tab, Turn on the **Extra****usage** toggle.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084772048/original/98dWzJBjy5OnDZvEqEcr20_XsICD8jgfvA.png?1793638069)
5. Optionally, set a monthly spending cap for your team's paid usage, and choose whether AI stops or keeps working  when the cap is reached. The cap counts all paid usage by your agency team and never counts usage by sub-account users.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084772097/original/OzXWTx3Jt6QoX3iwjQGyZyJC-Hr4SiwOyQ.png?1793638115)
6. Select **Save**.

---

## **How Free AI Limits Work**

Understanding the two layers, 5-hour windows and monthly limits, explains why AI might pause and when it will be back.

- **5-hour windows:** Ask AI, AI Studio and Creator Studio each have their own window, shared by your whole agency team. A window starts with the first request in that product and resets 5 hours later.
- **Monthly limits:** One monthly limit covers Ask AI, AI Studio and Creator Studio and Content AI together. It resets on the 1st of each month, at 00:00 UTC.

5 Hour & Monthly allowances increase with higher agency plans. Agency users on higher-tier plans receive increased allowances, and the $497 agency plan includes access to advanced models.

---

## **What Happens When a Limit Is Reached**

When your team reaches a 5-hour or monthly Free AI limit, what happens next depends on where the agency user is working:

- Inside a sub-account with an AI Employee subscription: usage draws from that sub-account's plan ([Starter](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000009501), Growth or Unlimited). Once the plan's included usage runs out, usage moves to Extra Usage.
- Inside a sub-account without a subscription: usage moves straight to Extra Usage.
- Inside the agency view: usage moves straight to Extra Usage.

With Extra Usage off, there's no paid usage at all, and AI pauses until the limit resets. With Extra Usage on, usage continues at pay-per-use rates, and who pays depends on where the agency user is working and [your rebilling settings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003906-ai-employee-access-rebilling-and-reselling):

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Where the agency user is working | Rebilling setting | Who pays |
| Inside the agency view (Ask AI only) | — | Agency wallet |
| Inside a sub-account | Off | Agency wallet |
| Inside a sub-account | On | The sub-account |
| Inside a sub-account | On, with "Charge agency user usage to agency" on | Agency wallet |

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is the Free AI allowance per agency user, per sub-account, or for the whole agency?**   
For the whole agency team including the agency owner, admins and agency users. All  share one allowance per month. It isn't split per user or per sub-account, and sub-account users aren't covered.

**Q: What are the exact Free AI limits on my plan?**

Free AI limits are fair-use allowances, not fixed quotas, and they’re sized for everyday building and setup work. Higher plans get larger allowances: $97 includes standard limits, $297 high limits, and $497 the highest limits plus advanced models. To see how much your team has used, and when each limit resets, open AI Suite → Usage Dashboard. You’ll also get alerts at 75% and 90% of your monthly limit.

**Q: Which products have a 5-hour limit, and which have a monthly limit?**  
Ask AI, AI Studio and Creator Studio each have their own 5-hour limit. Ask AI, AI Studio, Creator Studio and Content AI share one monthly limit. 

**Q: Do Creator Studio, AI Studio and other AI tools count toward the same allowance?**  
Partly. Each of Ask AI, AI Studio and Creator Studio has its own 5-hour window, so using one doesn't use up another's window. All of them, plus Content AI, draw from the same monthly limits.

**Q: Where can I check how much Free AI my team has used and how much is left?**  
From the agency view, go to AI Suite, then [Usage Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007742-ai-usage-dashboard). The Free AI card shows the percentage used for each limit and when it resets, and Free AI details show more. 

**Q: Will I be warned before my team reaches a limit?**  
Yes. Agency owners and admins get email and in-app alerts at 75% and 90% of the monthly limits, and again when a monthly limit runs out. They’re also alerted when the 5-hour limit runs out for Ask AI, AI Studio or Creator Studio.

**Q: When do the limits reset? Is Free AI a one-time allowance?**  
Free AI isn't a one-time allowance. Each 5-hour window resets 5 hours after the first request in that product, and the monthly limit resets on the 1st of every month.

**Q: What happens when the Free AI allowance runs out? Will my agency be charged automatically?**  
Not automatically. If the agency user is working inside a sub-account with an AI Employee subscription, usage continues on that plan's included usage. Otherwise, AI pauses until the limit resets, unless an admin has turned on Extra Usage. With Extra Usage on, usage is billed at pay-per-use rates according to your rebilling settings.

**Q: How can my team keep using AI past the 5-hour limit, not only the monthly limit?**  
Turn on Extra Usage. One setting covers both the 5-hour and monthly limits, so usage continues at pay-per-use rates past either one. See How To Setup Extra Usage.

**Q: Can I resell Free AI to my clients?**  
No. Free AI can't be resold, transferred or shared with sub-account users. You can resell [AI Employee plans](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003906-ai-employee-access-rebilling-and-reselling) (Starter, Growth or Unlimited) at your own price, or rebill pay-per-use AI with your markup.

**Q: If I turn off rebilling, can my clients still use pay-per-use AI?**  
Yes. Their usage continues at pay-per-use rates and is charged to your agency wallet instead of the sub-account.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [AI Product Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006652-ai-product-pricing)
- [AI Usage Limits](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007813)
- [AI Usage Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007742-ai-usage-dashboard)
- [AI Employee: Access, Rebilling and Reselling](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003906-ai-employee-access-rebilling-and-reselling)
- [How to Upgrade a Sub-Account to the AI Employee Starter Plan](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000009501)
- [AI Studio Cloud Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000009207)

title_en: Email Domain Warm-Up: Automated Email Warm-Up
source_md:
Email Deliverability · Beta

Email Domain Warm-Up: Automated Email Warm-Up

Build a trusted sender reputation for your dedicated domain automatically and improve inbox placement safely.

**Note:** Email Domain Warm-Up is currently free for approved beta users. Pricing after the beta period has not yet been announced.

What You'll Learn

This guide explains how the platform's automated domain warm-up works, how to request beta access, how to enable it on your dedicated sending domain, how to read the warm-up reports, and how to pause or stop warm-up.

Domain warm-up is the process of gradually increasing your daily email volume to build a trusted sender reputation with inbox providers like Gmail, Outlook, and Yahoo.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Why Domain Warm-Up Matters](#Why-Domain-Warm-Up-Matters)
- [How Automated Email Warm-Up Works](#How-Automated-Email-Warm-Up-Works)
- [Who Can Use It and When Warm-Up Starts](#Who-Can-Use-It-and-When-Warm-Up-Starts)
- [How to Access Email Warm-Up (Beta)](#How-to-Access-Email-Warm-Up-(Beta))
- [How to Enable Domain Warm-Up](#How-to-Enable-Domain-Warm-Up)
- [Domain Warm-Up Report](#Domain-Warm-Up-Report)
- [Understanding Your Warm-Up Performance](#Understanding-Your-Warm-Up-Performance)
- [How to Pause or Stop Domain Warm-Up](#How-to-Pause-or-Stop-Domain-Warm-Up)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

Video Walkthrough

[동영상](https://watchclueso.com/embed/me8k6nabve19ssa4)

## Why Domain Warm-Up Matters

Inbox providers are cautious with domains that suddenly start sending large volumes. Without proper warm-up, new domains are more likely to:

- Be flagged as spam
- Experience high bounce or complaint rates
- Face email delivery blocks or delays

Good to Know

The platform automates this entire process so you can build trust with inbox providers and maximize deliverability without manually managing send volumes.

## How Automated Email Warm-Up Works

Email Domain Warm-Up is fully automated. Instead of manually sending emails and increasing volume yourself, the platform uses dedicated warm-up mailboxes on your domain that:

**Gradually increase daily sending volume** — ramping up toward your selected daily goal.

**Simulate natural conversations** — emails look and behave like real correspondence.

**Send replies in threads** — building authentic back-and-forth engagement.

**Mark emails as important** — sending positive signals to inbox providers.

**Remove emails from Spam** — rescuing warm-up emails that land in spam ("Saved from spam").

**Maintain ongoing engagement** — keeping your reputation healthy over time.

Together, these signals build a strong sender reputation with providers like Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, and others — improving inbox placement over time ?

## Who Can Use It and When Warm-Up Starts

Availability

Agencies and sub-accounts with dedicated domains

Email warm-up is available for both agency and sub-account **dedicated sending domains**.

Existing Domains

Warm-up must be enabled manually

When you enable warm-up on an existing domain, the system automatically analyzes past email activity and Google Postmaster reputation data (if integrated) to plan the warm-up.

Prerequisite

The domain must be **verified** and its SSL certificate must be **issued** before you can start warm-up. Unverified domains show "Verify the domain and wait for its SSL certificate before starting warm-up" instead of the Start warm-up button.

## How to Access Email Warm-Up (Beta)

Email Warm-Up is currently in **beta**. To get access, submit a request using the form below. Once your request is approved and the feature is enabled on your account, the **Start warm-up** option will appear on your dedicated domain cards.

[Request Email Warm-Up Access →](https://api.leadconnectorhq.com/widget/form/IXjYTSgn4H9KZzPFwstY?notrack=true)

Note

Once Email Warm-Up is enabled on your account, the **daily sending limit ramp** currently shown on your dedicated domain will be **removed**. Automated warm-up takes over building your sender reputation instead.

Setup Guide

Start warm-up in a few clicks

Pick a daily goal and the platform handles mailboxes, volume ramp-up, and engagement for you.

## How to Enable Domain Warm-Up

Step 1

Open your Dedicated Domain settings

Go to **Agency Settings** or **Sub-Account Settings** → **Email Services** → **SMTP Service**, then open the **Dedicated Domain and IP** tab. (Email Warm-Up must first be enabled on your account — see [How to Access Email Warm-Up](#section-access).)

Step 2

Click Start warm-up on your domain

Find your domain card and, under **Domain Warm-Up**, click **Start warm-up**. A "Warm up <your domain>" popup opens.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083160527/original/LVU4JZIsPaxp298YykTonGcUUhOo1GtD8Q.png?1791874404)

Step 3

Select your daily goal

Under **Daily goal**, click **Change** and pick a volume from the **Daily warm-up limit** dropdown (for example, 10,000 or 25,000 emails a day), then click **Done**. Sending increases gradually up to this amount — it is not a guaranteed daily volume.

**Note:** The daily warm-up goal is the maximum target volume for automated warm-up emails, not a limit on your regular campaign emails. Warm-up volume increases gradually toward your selected goal and is not guaranteed to reach that amount every day.

You can continue sending campaigns and workflow emails while warm-up runs, subject to applicable sending limits.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083160579/original/wkCf7cBmCfu9OX-rQYsi17IiMU49g6pdOQ.png?1791874438)

Step 4

Review your warm-up mailboxes

Based on the volume you select, the platform creates the required number of warm-up mailboxes (for example, a 25,000/day goal uses **5 mailboxes**, each with a 5,000/day sending cap). We create and manage these mailboxes for warm-up — they are **not** your customers' inboxes.

Step 5

Click Start warm-up

Click **Start warm-up** to confirm. The domain card's Domain Warm-Up badge changes to **Warming up**.

Keep Sending as Usual

You can continue sending emails as usual while warm-up is running. Warm-up continues in parallel until you pause or stop it.

Heads up

If the domain is already enrolled, you'll see a **"Warm-Up is already set up"** message. Click **Done** and open its report from the domain card instead.

## Domain Warm-Up Report

At a Glance

Domain card summary

Once warm-up is enabled, each domain card shows warm-up performance at a glance: **Health score** (0–100), **Deliverability** (inbox placement rate), and **Sent today** against your daily goal.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083160641/original/r2bqfn1pqIwR_bHyd4jPg03L5rMxG1wzDQ.png?1791874501)

Detailed Report

Click View report

Click **View report** on the domain card to open the full Domain warm-up page.

| Report Item | What It Shows |
| --- | --- |
| Domain health score | Overall health of this domain on a 0–100 scale. |
| Deliverability | Inbox placement rate of warm-up emails. |
| Sent today | Warm-up emails sent today, with progress toward your daily goal. |
| DNS records | Status of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and MX records (green = configured, red = missing or invalid). |
| Warm-Up performance | "Landed in inbox" chart comparing emails delivered to **Inbox** vs **Saved from spam**, filterable by time period (e.g. Week). |
| Warm-Up mailboxes | Each warm-up mailbox with its from name, status, deliverability, and sent today vs daily cap. |

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083160622/original/wIs-TFonm4OmqOHS2_6oWJ-ulzsTUmlWDw.png?1791874476)

Mailbox Report

Drill into a single warm-up mailbox

To change a warm-up mailbox's sender name, click **View report** next to the mailbox, then select **Update mailbox**. Currently, only the sender name can be edited. Additional mailbox configuration options are planned for a future release.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083160674/original/ZJwmgBBufwUObVoldz6K634cObqc3zdfrA.png?1791874529)

### 

## **Understanding Your Warm-Up Performance**

Warm-up reports help you monitor how your dedicated domain is performing and identify issues that may affect email deliverability. Reviewing these metrics regularly helps you understand whether warm-up activity is improving inbox placement and whether your domain authentication is configured correctly.

- **Domain Health Score**: A score from 0–100 based on deliverability, sender reputation, and DNS configuration.
- **Deliverability**: The percentage of warm-up emails placed in recipients' inboxes.
- **Sent Today**: The number of warm-up emails sent today compared with the selected daily warm-up goal.
- **Saved from Spam**: Warm-up emails that were moved out of spam folders as part of automated engagement.
- **DNS Records**: The configuration status of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and MX records. Missing or invalid records can negatively affect domain health and deliverability.

```
Note: Warm-up results may take one or two days to appear after activation. A newly activated domain showing zero emails sent or no deliverability data does not necessarily indicate a problem.
```

## How to Pause or Stop Domain Warm-Up

1. Click the **three dots (…)** on the domain card.
2. Select **Pause warm-up** or **Stop warm-up**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083160695/original/cPOrMHXP5VG6wH216HZ7QSn-jMxA5Dny9Q.png?1791874556)

Note

Use **Pause** for a temporary break and **Stop** when you want to end warm-up for the domain. Stopping early can slow down reputation building, especially on newer domains.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I send campaign emails while domain warm-up is running?

Yes. You can continue sending campaigns, workflows, and other emails as usual. Warm-up runs in parallel until you pause or stop it.

Q: Are the warm-up mailboxes my customers' inboxes?

No. Warm-up mailboxes (e.g. team1@yourdomain.com) are synthetic identities that the platform creates and manages only for warm-up. Your contacts do not receive warm-up emails.

Q: Who can use domain warm-up?

Both agencies and sub-accounts can enable warm-up on their **dedicated sending domains** from **Settings → Email Services → SMTP Service → Dedicated Domain and IP**.

Q: How do I get access to Email Warm-Up?

Email Warm-Up is in beta. Request access using the [Email Warm-Up access request form](https://api.leadconnectorhq.com/widget/form/IXjYTSgn4H9KZzPFwstY?notrack=true). Once it's enabled, you'll see **Start warm-up** on your dedicated domain cards.

Q: What happens to my current daily sending limit ramp?

Once Email Warm-Up is enabled on your account, the daily sending limit ramp currently shown on your dedicated domain is removed.

Q: Why don't I see the Start warm-up button on my domain?

The domain must be verified and have an issued SSL certificate first. Use **Verify Now** on the domain card (or **Verify domain** from the three-dot menu), wait for SSL to show **SSL Issued**, and then start warm-up.

Q: Will warm-up send my full daily goal from day one?

No. Sending starts small and increases gradually up to your selected daily goal. The goal is a ceiling, not a guaranteed daily volume.

Q: How many warm-up mailboxes will be created?

It depends on the daily goal you select. The popup shows the mailbox count before you confirm — for example, a 25,000 emails/day goal uses 5 mailboxes with a 5,000/day cap each.

Q: My report shows 0% deliverability and 0 sent today. Is something wrong?

Not necessarily. Right after warm-up starts — or early in the day — metrics may still be at zero. Data fills in as warm-up emails are sent and engagement is recorded. Check back after a day or two.

Q: What does "Warm-Up is already set up" mean?

The domain is already enrolled in warm-up. Click **Done** and open its report from the domain card using **View report**.

Q: Some DNS records show in red in the report. What should I do?

Red records (for example DMARC or MX) are missing or not configured correctly. Add or fix them with your DNS provider. Complete SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and MX setup improves your domain health score and deliverability.

Q: Can I change a warm-up mailbox's sender name?

Yes. Open the mailbox from the domain warm-up report via **View report**, then click **Update mailbox** to edit its details.

Q: Do I need Google Postmaster Tools to use warm-up?

No, but it's recommended. When connected, the system uses Postmaster reputation data when enabling warm-up on existing domains and gives you extra visibility into spam rates, authentication, and delivery errors.

title_en: How to Assign Twilio Numbers to Voice AI Agents
source_md:
Twilio number support allows Voice AI agents to use Twilio-connected phone numbers or number pools for call handling. Once a Twilio number is available in the sub-account, it can be assigned to a Voice AI agent from the agent's **Deploy** tab. This article explains how to assign Twilio numbers, review Call Routing and Working Hours, and test inbound call behavior.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Twilio Number Support for Voice AI Agents?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Twilio-Number-Support-for-Voice-AI-Agents?)
- [Key Benefits of Twilio Numbers for Voice AI Agents](#Key-Benefits-of-Twilio-Numbers-for-Voice-AI-Agents)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin)
- [Individual Twilio Numbers vs. Number Pools](#Individual-Twilio-Numbers-vs.-Number-Pools)
- [How To Assign Twilio Numbers to Voice AI Agents](#How-To-Assign-Twilio-Numbers-to-Voice-AI-Agents)
- [Call Routing and AI Backup Behavior](#Call-Routing-and-AI-Backup-Behavior)
- [Working Hours](#Working-Hours)
- [Inbound vs. Outbound Voice AI Setup](#Inbound-vs.-Outbound-Voice-AI-Setup)
- [Testing Twilio Number Assignment](#Testing-Twilio-Number-Assignment)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Twilio Number Support for Voice AI Agents?**

Twilio number support lets Voice AI agents handle calls through Twilio-connected phone numbers or number pools. This allows businesses using Twilio numbers in HighLevel to connect those numbers to selected Voice AI agents for call handling.

Phone numbers are assigned per agent from the Deploy tab. If you manage multiple Voice AI agents, review each agent’s assigned numbers, routing, and availability separately.

---

## **Key Benefits of Twilio Numbers for Voice AI Agents**

Twilio number support helps connect existing phone infrastructure to Voice AI agents. By assigning the correct number or number pool, you can control which calls reach each agent and how those calls are handled.

- **Use existing Twilio numbers:** Connect available Twilio numbers in the sub-account to Voice AI agents.

- **Support number pools:** Assign a number pool when your routing setup uses multiple numbers.

- **Control call availability:** Use working hours to define when the agent should be available.

- **Improve call routing:** Review call routing and backup behavior so calls reach the right destination.

- **Test before launch:** Call the assigned number to confirm the agent answers as expected.

---

## **Before You Begin**

A successful Twilio number setup depends on the number being available in the sub-account and the user having access to edit Voice AI deployment settings. Review these requirements before assigning a number to an agent.

Before assigning a Twilio number, confirm the following:

- An active AI Employee or Voice AI subscription is available.

- A Voice AI agent already exists.

- A Twilio number or number pool is already available in the sub-account.

- You have permission to edit Voice AI agents and deployment settings.

- You know which number or number pool should route calls to the selected agent.

- You plan to test the assigned number after saving.

---

## **Individual Twilio Numbers vs. Number Pools**

Voice AI agents can be assigned to an individual Twilio number or an available number pool, depending on how your call routing is set up. Choosing the right option helps ensure calls reach the correct agent.

Use an **individual Twilio number** when one specific number should connect to the selected Voice AI agent.

Use a **number pool** when your setup routes calls through a group of numbers or when multiple numbers should follow the same availability and routing behavior.

If you are unsure which option to use, review how the number or number pool is configured in the sub-account before assigning it to the agent.

---

## **How To Assign Twilio Numbers to Voice AI Agents**

Twilio numbers are assigned from the selected Voice AI agent's **Deploy** tab. From Deploy, you can manage phone assignment, Call Routing, and Working Hours for the selected agent.

### 

### **Go to AI Agents > Voice AI**

Open **AI Agents**, then select **Voice AI**. This is where Voice AI agents are created, edited, deployed, and reviewed.

### 

### **Open Agents**

Select **Agents** to view the Voice AI agents available in the sub-account. The agent list helps you choose which agent should be connected to the Twilio number or number pool.

Choose the agent that should receive calls from the Twilio number or number pool. Number assignment is configured per agent, so changes made here apply only to the selected agent.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155073869605/original/Hc95GNf1hkHStrrRLIgvBesNLzSVWRyqyg.png?1781695823)**

### **Open the Deploy tab**

Select **Deploy** to access the agent’s deployment settings. This area controls how the selected Voice AI agent is made available for calls.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079264635/original/XaOwhEUkcooOCYb63ZNBezCvBfDfZYT1KA.png?1787667277)

### **Select a Twilio number or number pool**

Choose the Twilio number or available number pool that should route calls to the selected Voice AI agent. Confirm that you are selecting the correct number for the intended call flow.

### 

### **Buy a new phone number**

If you need a new phone number, you can purchase one without leaving the agent's **Deploy** tab.

1. In the **Phone** section, click **Buy new number** below **Numbers & number pool**.
2. Complete the phone-number purchase.
3. After the purchase is complete, choose whether to assign the new number to the Voice AI agent.
4. Confirm the correct number appears under **Numbers & number pool** before continuing with Call Routing and Working Hours.

You can also click **Manage numbers** from the Phone section to manage existing phone numbers.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079270706/original/g1g44iFp6evmPeqJNLLWFyBysO5lBmht-Q.png?1787670988)

### **Review call routing and AI backup behavior**

Choose how the Voice AI agent should handle incoming calls:

- **Answer Calls Directly:** Use this mode when the Voice AI agent should answer incoming calls directly.
- **Use as Backup:** Use this mode when the Voice AI agent should act as a backup for the primary call path.

Review the selected mode carefully so calls follow the intended routing behavior.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079270346/original/tbYHtUdAO96gGtR0aHgQ9Qke4W2r0QU84Q.png?1787670654)

### **Configure working hours, if needed**

Use **Working Hours** to control when the Voice AI agent is available.

Choose **All Hours** for unrestricted availability, or choose **Custom Schedule** to configure specific active days and time ranges.

### 

### **Save your changes**

Click **Save** to apply the number assignment, routing, and availability changes to the selected agent. Unsaved changes may not apply to live calls.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079270441/original/5GVyM9-kSxYhwAiIwbR3XgYp7kBOwnsanA.png?1787670734)

### 

### **Test the assigned number**

Call the selected Twilio number to confirm the Voice AI agent answers as expected. Test during working hours and, if configured, outside working hours to confirm routing and availability behavior.

---

## **Call Routing Modes**

Call Routing controls how the Voice AI agent handles incoming calls through the assigned number or number pool.

Choose the mode that matches the intended call flow:

- **Answer Calls Directly:** The Voice AI agent answers incoming calls directly.
- **Use as Backup:** The Voice AI agent acts as a backup when the primary call path does not answer.

Assigning a number alone does not guarantee that every call reaches Voice AI. Call Routing, Working Hours, and the phone number's broader call-flow configuration can affect how incoming calls are handled.

---

## **Working Hours**

Working Hours define when the selected Voice AI agent should be available to handle calls. This helps prevent the agent from answering outside the intended schedule or allows different agents to support different availability windows.

Use Working Hours when:

- The agent should only answer during business hours.

- Different agents support different schedules.

- Calls outside working hours should follow another route.

- You want to test how availability affects call handling.

When configuring working hours, review each day and time block carefully. If the agent does not answer when expected, working hours should be one of the first settings to check.

---

## **Inbound vs. Outbound Voice AI Setup**

Assigning a number from the agent's Deploy tab controls how the selected agent is available for calls through that number or number pool. This is especially important for inbound call handling.

Outbound Voice AI calls configured through workflows may use separate outbound call settings. If you are configuring outbound Voice AI, review the outbound-specific setup resources instead of relying only on the agent's Deploy settings.

---

## **Testing Twilio Number Assignment**

Testing confirms that the selected Twilio number or number pool reaches the intended Voice AI agent. Always test after changing number assignment, routing, backup behavior, or working hours.

Recommended testing checks:

- Call the selected Twilio number.

- Confirm the intended Voice AI agent answers.

- Test during configured working hours.

- Test outside working hours if availability rules are configured.

- Confirm the selected Call Routing mode behaves as expected.

- Confirm the wrong agent does not answer the call.

- Review call logs if the call does not reach the expected agent.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What does Twilio number support mean for Voice AI?**  
It means Twilio-connected numbers or number pools available in the sub-account can be assigned to Voice AI agents for call handling.

**Q: Where do I assign a Twilio number to a Voice AI agent?**  
Go to **AI Agents > Voice AI > Agents**, select the agent, then open **Deploy > Phone.**

**Q: Can I assign a number pool instead of a single number?**  
Yes. If a number pool is available in the sub-account, you can select it depending on your routing setup.

**Q: Why does my Twilio number not appear?**  
Confirm the number is connected to the sub-account and available in phone number settings.

**Q: Does assigning a number guarantee Voice AI will answer every call?**  
Not always. Call Routing, Working Hours, and the phone number's call-flow configuration can affect whether Voice AI receives the call.

**Q: What does Use as Backup do?**

**Use as Backup** configures the Voice AI agent to act as a backup when the primary call path does not answer.

**Q: Do working hours affect whether the agent answers?**  
Yes. Working hours define when the selected Voice AI agent is available to handle calls.

**Q: Can multiple agents use the same number?**  
Number assignment behavior may depend on the account’s routing and availability configuration. Review the selected number or number pool carefully before assigning it to multiple agents.

**Q: How do I test the assigned number?**  
Call the selected Twilio number and confirm the intended Voice AI agent answers. Review logs if the call does not reach the expected agent.

**Q: Is outbound Voice AI configured here?**

Not fully. The **Deploy** tab manages deployment settings for assigned numbers or number pools. Outbound Voice AI calls configured through workflows may use separate outbound settings.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Complete Guide to Creating Voice AI Agents in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004107-how-to-create-voice-ai-agents)⁠

- [Number Pool Support in Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005221-number-pool-support-in-voice-ai-agents)⁠

- [Inbound Call Flow for Voice AI Calls](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003431-inbound-call-flow-for-voice-ai-calls)⁠

- [Inbound Calls: IVR, AI, Routing & Call Flow Explained](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007498-inbound-calls-ivr-ai-routing-call-flow-explained)⁠

- [Testing Voice AI Agents in HighLevel: Calls and Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004108-testing-voice-ai-agents)⁠

- [Managing Granular Permissions for Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005680-managing-granular-permissions-for-voice-ai-agents)⁠
