- Use[Facebook Sharing Debugger](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/) or [Twitter Card Validator](https://cards-dev.twitter.com/validator) to confirm Open Graph tags are being served.

---

## **Generate Sitemap**

Generate Sitemap helps search engines discover the important pages on your site more efficiently. In AI Studio, the **Generate sitemap** action uses a **Copy prompt** workflow to create sitemap support for the project.

Rendered output refreshes automatically when the site is published, updated, or moved to a different domain, which helps keep the sitemap aligned with the latest site content and structure.

To generate a sitemap:

1. Open the AI Studio project you want to update.
2. Click **More** at the top of the builder, then open **SEO & AI search**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079918693/original/e5fIvAe1HlX4qA_AWKmvZsyVArwwRHrRcA.jpeg?1788355982)
3. Find **Generate sitemap**and click **Copy prompt**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069332162/original/ETkb4VGmYgZ5_niWHwrgfTqBh33hY5M7OA.png?1776366055)
4. Paste the copied prompt into the AI Studio chat.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069335739/original/H765GV75hozWe6QqsIDj65ViWVSasPdHcA.png?1776373064)
5. Review the returned update summary in the builder, then publish your project to apply the updates. Click **Details**to view your sitemap.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069335827/original/98shH1SJJWIus2bAC1SvgqF39h0mgkeTEw.png?1776373260)
6. Submit your sitemap to Google Search Console to help Google discover your URLs and monitor sitemap processing.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069335797/original/Wd88q0mIPDw939R8w8tQTAsl9x7Eb7FIVQ.png?1776373179)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to publish the project before enabling Advanced SEO Support?**  
Yes. Publishing is required before completing the custom domain and SEO setup flow.

**Q: Does pre-rendering change how my site looks or behaves for regular visitors?**

No. Human visitors still receive the same fast, interactive SPA experience. Only bots and crawlers are served the pre-rendered HTML snapshots.

**Q: Does Advanced SEO Support include automated schema markup injection?**  
No. Schema markup is not added automatically by Advanced SEO Support itself. If you add schema through an AI Studio prompt and it is generated in the page code, supported bots can receive that schema as part of the rendered HTML when pre-rendering is enabled.

**Q: How does the cache refresh work?**  
The cache refreshes automatically when you publish the project, change the connected domain, or update the site and re-publish.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [AI Studio in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007587)
- [Connect Forms and Calendars in AI Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007599)
- [AI Product Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006652)
- [Code Editor in AI Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007652)

title_en: Skills in the AI Agent Action
source_md:
## Overview

Skills are reusable procedures that your AI Agent loads only when a situation needs them. Use skills for rules that apply to some runs but not all, such as how to write a cold email, how to write a text message, or what to do when a lead reports an emergency.

The AI Agent Instructions describe the job of one action and go into every run. A skill sits in your skills library, can be attached to any AI Agent action, and stays out of the way until it is relevant. The agent reads a short description of every attached skill on each run, and loads the full instructions of a skill only when the situation matches that description.

## Key Benefits

- **Shorter, focused Instructions:** Move situational rules out of the Instructions box so each action only describes its own job.
- **Write once, reuse everywhere:** A skill lives in your library and can be attached to any AI Agent action in the sub-account.
- **Lower cost per run:** Only the skill description goes into every run. The full instructions load only when the skill is used.
- **Ready to use:** Every sub-account includes four built-in writing skills that you can attach, edit, or delete.
- **Easy to set up:** Create a skill with the AI Assistant, write it yourself, or attach one from your library.

## Skill Details

Every skill has three fields.

|  |  |  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Field** | **Description** | **Mandatory** |
| **Name** | A short name for the skill, such as "Emergency service requests". This is how the skill appears in the action and in your library. | Yes |
| **When should the agent use this?** | One or two sentences that describe when the agent should use the skill. The agent reads this field on every run to decide whether to load the skill, so name concrete situations, keywords, or conditions. | Yes |
| **Instructions** | The procedure the agent follows when it uses the skill. Write numbered steps, decision rules, and anything the agent must never do. The agent reads this field only when it uses the skill. | Yes |

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084497290/original/H1xAZo57p_LuZ8RRjncBi889ffzOd6p_0A.png?1793273480)

*Hover over the info icon next to Skills to see what a skill is.*

## Built-in Skills

Every sub-account includes four built-in skills, marked with a **Built-in** tag in your library. They work like any other skill: you can attach them to any AI Agent action, edit them, or delete them.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Skill** | **When the agent uses it** |
| **Humanizer** | When it writes any message or text, on any channel. Removes the known signs of AI-generated writing. |
| **Write-well** | When it writes any message or text, on any channel. Removes AI writing patterns and keeps the writing clear, simple, and direct. |
| **Cold-email** | When it sends a first-touch or follow-up email to a lead who has not replied or spoken to you before, such as outreach, prospecting, or re-engagement. |
| **Sms-writer** | When it sends an SMS to a contact, such as reminders, follow-ups, confirmations, win-backs, or promotional texts. |

## How to Add a Skill

1. Open a workflow and add or select an **AI Agent** action.
2. In the action panel, scroll down and expand the **Skills** section.
3. Click **+ Add skill**. If the action already has skills, click **+ Add** next to the Skills title.
4. Choose one of the three options described below.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084496960/original/wUKTGFCu9hB-Cu_1dcC-EQkZ5clLBUhEQA.png?1793273351)

*The Skills section before any skill is added.*

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084497243/original/tZhRacvqK-7voxUZwEs024GlDI3rnxbrfw.png?1793273455)

*The three ways to add a skill.*

### Option 1: Create with AI

The AI Assistant opens on the left and asks what the skill should do, when it should be used, and what it must never do. Answer in your own words. The assistant asks a short follow-up only if something is missing, then drafts the skill.

Review the draft in the skill form, make any changes, and click **Create & attach**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084497360/original/UwyUc0PrEovYTtBh-XXP89Z_lX1xDYdusg.png?1793273550)

*Create with AI starts a short conversation in the AI Assistant.*

### Option 2: Write skill instructions

1. Enter a **Name**.
2. Fill in **When should the agent use this?** with the situations that should load the skill.
3. Write the **Instructions**. Use the toolbar to add lists and headings. Click **Enhance prompt** to let AI improve the wording.
4. Click **Create & attach**. The skill is saved to your library and attached to this action.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084497379/original/HgJhIi39akmeSvqs47NAf_rvdQUiev0fpA.png?1793273554)

*The skill form with all three fields filled in.*

### Option 3: Add existing skill

1. Search or scroll your library. Built-in skills show a **Built-in** tag.
2. Click a skill row to read its full description and instructions before you attach it.
3. Click **Attach**. Attached skills move to the **Attached** group at the top of the list.
4. Click **Done** when you finish.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084497382/original/Jc44ASrc-KDD_Te5APlvxL80Ob9ydj_YJQ.png?1793273559)

*Your skills library, with the four built-in skills.*

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084497400/original/NpHKABzVjvHfpDPzil3PDgU7CxEpmXOlsw.png?1793273573)

*Click a skill to read it before you attach it.*

## Manage Skills

- **Edit a skill:** Hover over a skill row in the action and click the pencil icon. You can also open the skill from **Add existing skill** and choose **Edit** from the options menu.
- **Detach a skill:** Hover over a skill row and click the **X** icon. The skill is removed from this action but stays in your library.
- **Delete a skill:** Open the skill from **Add existing skill** and choose **Delete** from the options menu. Deleting removes the skill from your library and from every action that uses it.

**Note:** A skill is shared by every action it is attached to. When you edit a skill, the change applies to all of those actions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084497407/original/gO0f7__elK75z4nhWnrPNvN-qvkDKpEc9A.png?1793273578)

*Hover over a skill to edit or detach it.*

## Example: Lead Follow-up Agent

A heating and cooling company wants to follow up with every lead who submits a quote request. Most leads need a friendly email and text. A few report emergencies, such as a gas smell or no heat, and those need a different response.

### Setup

- **Trigger:** Form Submitted (Request a quote form).
- **Action Name:** Lead follow-up agent.
- **Instructions:** "You follow up with new leads for Apex Heating and Cooling. A lead just submitted the Request a quote form. Send the lead one email and one SMS that thank them, restate their request, and offer a time to talk."
- **Tools:** Send email and Send SMS, with **Let AI decide all field values** turned on.
- **Skills:** Cold-email (built-in), Sms-writer (built-in), and a custom skill called Emergency service requests.

### The custom skill

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Field** | **Value** |
| **Name** | Emergency service requests |
| **When should the agent use this?** | Use when a lead reports no heat, no cooling, a gas smell, or a water leak, or says the request is urgent. |
| **Instructions** | If the lead reports a gas smell, tell them to leave the building and call the gas company first. Never book a visit for a gas smell. For no heat, no cooling, or a water leak, offer the next same-day emergency slot. Keep the first reply to two short sentences. Never quote a price. Say that the technician confirms the cost on site. |

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084497412/original/l_8SxeAjWjBKJSf6lsIAVQ2Xz5LkdPN1Wg.png?1793273582)

*The finished action with two tools and three skills.*

### What happens on a run

- **A routine quote request:** The agent loads Cold-email to write the email and Sms-writer to write the text. Emergency service requests stays unloaded.
- **A lead who writes "no heat since last night":** The agent loads Emergency service requests along with Cold-email and Sms-writer, and offers a same-day slot without quoting a price.
- **A lead who reports a gas smell:** Emergency service requests tells the agent to send safety instructions first and not to book a visit.

## How the Agent Uses Skills

- **More than one skill can apply:** When a situation matches several skills, the agent loads all of them and follows them together.
- **Action Instructions come first:** If a skill and the action Instructions disagree, the agent follows the action Instructions.
- **Specific rules win over general rules:** A rule such as "keep the subject under five words" wins over a general rule such as "write short".
- **"Never" rules win:** If one skill says to do something and another skill says never to do it, the agent does not do it.

## Tips for Writing Good Skills

- **Name concrete triggers:** Write "Use when a lead reports no heat or a gas smell" instead of "Handles emergencies". The agent decides from this field alone.
- **Keep one purpose per skill:** Two small skills are easier to manage than one large skill that covers many situations.
- **Put prohibitions last:** End the instructions with clear "Never" lines.
- **Do not repeat the action's job:** The job of one action belongs in its Instructions. Rules you reuse across actions, or that apply only sometimes, belong in a skill.

## FAQs

**What is the difference between Instructions and a skill?**

Instructions describe the job of one AI Agent action and are sent on every run. A skill is a reusable procedure that lives in your library, can be attached to many actions, and is loaded only when its description matches the situation.

**Does a skill run every time the action runs?**

No. The agent reads the name and description of every attached skill on each run, and loads a skill's instructions only when the situation matches its description.

**What happens if two skills apply at the same time?**

The agent loads both and follows them together. If they disagree, the action Instructions win first, then the more specific rule, and a "Never" rule wins over a rule that says to do something.

**Can I use the same skill in more than one workflow?**

Yes. Skills are saved to the sub-account library. Attach the same skill to any AI Agent action in any workflow.

**If I edit a skill, does it change everywhere?**

Yes. A skill is shared by every action it is attached to, so an edit applies to all of them.

**What is the difference between detaching and deleting a skill?**

Detaching removes the skill from one action only. Deleting removes it from your library and from every action that uses it.

**Can I edit or delete the built-in skills?**

Yes. Built-in skills work like any other skill in your library.

**Can a skill use a knowledge base?**

Yes. Name the knowledge base in the skill instructions, for example "Search the Service policies knowledge base for warranty terms." Make sure the action has the **Knowledge base search** tool added.

**Can a skill send messages or update contacts by itself?**

No. A skill tells the agent how to do something. The agent still needs the right tools on the action, such as Send email or Send SMS, to act.

**Do I need skills to use the AI Agent action?**

No. Skills are optional. Many users start with Instructions and tools, then add skills later as patterns repeat.

title_en: Getting Started - Setup Social Planner
source_md:
Social Planner helps you connect social accounts, create content, and schedule posts from one calendar. This guide covers the essential setup, including account connections, templates, custom posts, media, scheduling, and performance tracking.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is Social Planner?](#What-Is-Social-Planner?%E2%80%8B)
- [Key Benefits of Social Planner](#Key-Benefits-of-Social-Planner%E2%80%8B)
- [Before You Begin](#Before-You-Begin%E2%80%8B)
- [Explore Social Planner](#Explore-Social-Planner%E2%80%8B)
- [How To Set Up and Use Social Planner](#How-To-Set-Up-and-Use-Social-Planner%E2%80%8B)
- [Monitor Posts and Social Performance](#Monitor-Posts-and-Social-Performance%E2%80%8B)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions%E2%80%8B)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is Social Planner?**

Social Planner is HighLevel's centralized tool for drafting, scheduling, publishing, and tracking social content. You can manage Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, HighLevel Community, and Bluesky from one location. Available post types, media options, and analytics vary by platform.

---

## **Key Benefits of Social Planner**

Managing social content from one calendar reduces manual work and helps maintain a consistent publishing schedule.

- **Centralized publishing:** Manage multiple social platforms without switching between separate applications.
- **Flexible scheduling:** Publish immediately, schedule for later, save drafts, request approval, or create recurring  
   content.
- **Reusable content:** Start with templates, bulk uploads, RSS feeds, recurring posts, or Category Queues.
- **Platform-specific posts:** Customize captions and media for each selected social channel.
- **Performance tracking:** Review publishing activity and available engagement metrics.

---

## **Before You Begin**

Social platforms require the correct permissions before HighLevel can publish on their behalf. Preparing your access and content first helps prevent missing accounts and failed posts.

- Confirm that you can sign in to each social platform you want to connect.
- Verify that you have admin or publishing access to the required page, profile, channel, board, or location.
- Prepare the captions, links, images, or videos you plan to publish.
- Confirm that your media meets the selected platform's requirements.
- Review the location timezone before scheduling posts.

**Important:** You can explore Social Planner and prepare content without connecting an account, but an active social connection is required to publish or schedule content to that channel.

---

## **Explore Social Planner**

The Social Planner welcome screen provides direct access to the most common content-planning tools.

- **Schedule Now:** Create a single custom post.
- **Bulk Scheduling:** Upload up to 90 posts using a supported CSV or XLSX file.
- **Evergreen Queue Post:** Build a reusable Category Queue. You can later edit, reorder, view, or reschedule the queue.
- **Recurring Post:** Repeat a post on a selected schedule.
- **RSS Post:** Turn new RSS feed items into social posts.

![Social Planner welcome screen showing social platforms and content-planning options.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065399888/original/8vketQGOfOn0mmxEhrjt0nBymS7uF-uwaQ.png?1771640321=)

---

## **How To Set Up and Use Social Planner**

A reliable Social Planner workflow follows five steps: connect an account, choose how to create the post, review the content, schedule or publish it, and monitor the connection.

### **1. Connect Your First Social Account**

Connecting an account authorizes HighLevel to publish to the selected page, profile, channel, board, or location.

1. Go to **Marketing → Social Planner**.
2. Select the social platform you want to connect.
3. Sign in and approve the requested permissions.
4. Select the page, profile, channel, board, or location you want to manage.
5. Complete the authorization process.
6. Confirm that the account appears in Social Planner.

**Facebook Pages:** Sign in with a Facebook profile that has admin access to every Page you want to connect.

![Connected Facebook Pages displayed in Social Planner.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046650149/original/-elmob_B-i2n4m1uEXIc827ngW-BesLKIw.png?1747265065=)

### **2. Create Posts From Social Planner Templates**

Templates provide ready-to-use content that you can customize and schedule for connected social accounts.

1. Go to **Marketing → Social Planner**.
2. Click **+ New Post**.
3. Select **Social Planner Templates**.
4. Search, browse, or filter the available templates.
5. Select a template and click **Continue**.

![New Post menu with Social Planner Templates highlighted.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046650170/original/OtRuWjuR_imzb--UrEpilgcEAMIMXLNtpA.png?1747265181=)

6. Open **Content → Template Library** when prompted.
7. Find the selected template and click **Select Socials**, represented by the plus icon.

![Template Library showing the Select Socials icon.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046650180/original/7K9J0uIJYti3PrZAVCt3k5WW63fgNMfeuQ.png?1747265353=)

8. Select the social accounts that should receive the posts.
9. Choose the posting days, number of posts, and time range.
10. Confirm the timezone shown in the scheduling window.
11. Click **Schedule Posts**.

![Schedule Post window showing social account, posting days, post count, time range, and Schedule Posts button.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046650190/original/8YYuTzgpdEz0ojRfwue_VbAYbh2yIDxSBw.png?1747265422=)

12. Open **Review & Schedule** after the template is processed.
13. Review the captions, media, accounts, and scheduled times.
14. Correct any flagged errors.
15. Click **Import** to add the approved posts to the planner.

**Final review required:** Template posts are not added to the publishing calendar until you complete Review & Schedule and click Import.

### **3. Create a Custom Post**

Custom posts give you full control over the caption, media, selected accounts, and publishing method.

1. Go to **Marketing → Social Planner**.
2. Click **+ New Post → Create New Post**.
3. Select the social accounts that should receive the post.
4. Enter the caption, links, hashtags, and other content.
5. When posting to multiple platforms, enable **Customize for Each Channel** to use different captions or media by platform.
6. Review each platform in the **Post Preview** panel.
7. Choose to publish now, schedule for later, save as a draft, send for approval, or create a recurring post.

### **4. Add Media and Edit a Video Thumbnail**

Reviewing media before scheduling helps prevent cropping, format, and compatibility issues.

1. Use the **Image** or **Video** icon in the post composer to add media.
2. Wait for the upload to finish before switching accounts or enabling channel-specific customization.
3. Review the media in the **Post Preview** panel.
4. Leave **Media Optimization** enabled when you want HighLevel to adjust supported media for platform requirements.

![Post composer showing uploaded video media and the Post Preview panel.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064535499/original/3U-FILqZwZsOLe9Vdkn9t-Z_UNcY3QR09A.png?1770689786=)

To edit a supported video thumbnail:

1. Hover over the uploaded video.
2. Click the **pencil** icon.
3. Select **Edit Video Thumbnail**.
4. Upload or select the thumbnail.
5. Review the updated preview.

![Video edit menu with Edit Video Thumbnail highlighted.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064535505/original/l4R1nEIUhKq2EJ5dSIsMfekX_WTUfV1wVQ.png?1770689802=)

**Tip:** Thumbnail support depends on the selected platform and post type. If the option does not appear, review the current Social Planner media guidelines.

### **5. Connect Additional Social Accounts**

Adding more accounts lets you manage multiple brands, locations, profiles, and platforms from the same Social Planner.

1. Click the **Settings** gear in Social Planner.
2. Open **Social Accounts**.
3. Click **+ Connect Social**.
4. Select the platform you want to add.
5. Sign in, approve the permissions, and select the account.
6. Confirm that the account shows as connected.

![Connect a social account window showing the available social integrations.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046650269/original/xzyt01nDaVJmMNWSUdduYmpA95dddsf4Dg.png?1747266021=)

**Account health:** HighLevel displays in-app and email alerts when a connected account loses authorization. Reconnect it promptly because scheduled posts cannot publish while the account is disconnected.

---

## **Monitor Posts and Social Performance**

Reviewing publishing status and analytics helps you catch failed posts, maintain active connections, and identify the content that performs best.

- Use the **Planner** tab to review drafts, scheduled posts, published posts, and failures.
- Go to **Marketing → Social Planner → Statistics** to review the metrics available for each connected platform.
- Filter results by supported platform or social account.
- Reconnect an account when HighLevel displays a permissions or authentication alert.

When Social Planner dashboard widgets are available in your account, you can also display aggregated metrics such as posts, likes, comments, shares, impressions, reach, and followers. These widgets support platform, social-account, and date-range filters but do not include post-level names, images, or descriptions.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Why can I create a draft but not publish it?**  
At least one active social account must be selected before a post can be published or scheduled. Open Social Planner Settings and confirm that the account is connected.

**Q: Why can't I find my Facebook Page during setup?**  
Confirm that the Facebook profile used for authorization has admin access to the Page. Reconnect Facebook and approve all requested permissions if the Page still does not appear.

**Q: What happens when a social account disconnects?**  
Scheduled posts cannot publish to that account until it is reconnected. HighLevel displays an in-app alert and can also send an email notification.

**Q: Can I use different captions or media on each social platform?**  
Yes. Select multiple social accounts and enable **Customize for Each Channel**. You can then edit each platform's caption and media separately.

**Q: Can I schedule posts in bulk?**  
Yes. Social Planner supports CSV and XLSX uploads with up to 90 posts per file. Review and correct all flagged errors before importing.

**Q: Why is Edit Video Thumbnail unavailable?**  
Custom thumbnails are only available for supported platforms and post types. Review the current Social Planner media guidelines when the option does not appear.

**Q: Why are some analytics missing?**  
Available metrics and reporting delays depend on the platform, account type, permissions, and selected date range. Reconnect the account when HighLevel requests updated analytics permissions.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Connect to Your Facebook Page(s)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001210327)
- [Template Library of Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003329)
- [How to Customize Posts for Each Social Channel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000624)

title_en: How to improve the security of my SaaS Checkout process
source_md:
There are several steps you can take to enhance the security of your SaaS checkout. These measures can help prevent phishing scammers from signing up and misusing your SaaS sub-account.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Step 1 - Use Funnel/Website v2](#Step-1---Use-Funnel/Website-v2)
- [Step 2 - Add Custom Authorization to your trial](#Step-2---Add-Custom-Authorization-to-your-trial)
- [Step 3 - Use LC Phone & LC Email](#Step-3---Use-LC-Phone-&-LC-Email)
- [Step 4 - Enable Phone Number & Email Verification by default](#Step-4---Enable-Phone-Number-&-Email-Validation-by-default)
- [Step 5 - Use Stripe Radar](#Step-5---Use-Stripe-Radar)
  - [Useful rules we recommend](#Useful-rules-we-recommend)
    - [3D Secure Authentication Rules](#3D-Secure-Authentication-Rules)
    - [Block Rules](#Block-Rules)
    - [Review Rules](#Review-Rules)
- [FAQ:](#FAQ%3A)
  - [Q: I followed these steps but a scammer was still able to signup. What do I do?](#Q%3A-I-followed-these-steps-but-a-scammer-was-still-able-to-signup.-What-do-I-do?)
  - [Q: What is Funnel/Website v2 and how does it enhance security?](#Q%3A-What-is-Funnel/Website-v2-and-how-does-it-enhance-security?)
  - [Q: What is Custom Authorization and how does it work?](#Q%3A-What-is-Custom-Authorization-and-how-does-it-work?)
  - [Q: Why should I consider using LC Phone & LC Email over Twilio or Mailgun?](#Q%3A-Why-should-I-consider-using-LC-Phone-&-LC-Email-over-Twilio-or-Mailgun?)
  - [Q: How can I enable Phone Number & Email Verification for my SaaS signups?](#Q%3A-How-can-I-enable-Phone-Number-&-Email-Verification-for-my-SaaS-signups?)
  - [Q: What is Stripe Radar and how does it help in fraud prevention?](#Q%3A-What-is-Stripe-Radar-and-how-does-it-help-in-fraud-prevention?)
  - [Q: How can I set up rules in Stripe Radar for handling transactions?](#Q%3A-How-can-I-set-up-rules-in-Stripe-Radar-for-handling-transactions?)
  - [Q: What action should I take if a flagged payment appears in Stripe Radar?](#Q%3A-What-action-should-I-take-if-a-flagged-payment-appears-in-Stripe-Radar?)

# Step 1 - Use Funnel/Website v2

If you're currently using HighLevel funnels & websites for SaaS sales, it's advisable to switch to v2 funnels & websites. The newer version supports native Stripe integration and 3D secure technology, ensuring a more secure checkout experience.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009989986/original/_3ABLUhxhsHSRmn_uyvJh3NgctFb4XF_QQ.png?1697131516)

# Step 2 - Add Custom Authorization to your trial

Adding an authorization amount to your SaaS products with a trial is the best way to ensure only real credit cards with enough balance are able to get through your signup process.

You can enter an authorization amount on your sales funnel by going to funnel -> Products -> Additional Options -> Custom Authorization.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009990802/original/uVeQroA0MV1fGH7NAp6iH5__P7uEehqo-g.png?1697132231)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009990853/original/4nBOm8fAGyQ34wEgXSws_RD6TYHjsIzESw.png?1697132271)

A Custom Authorization is especially helpful when your SaaS product has a trial. It sim ply creates a payment intent and validates that the card is real and has sufficient balance. The customer is NOT charged and the payment is refunded immediately.

```
Note
- Custom Authorization does NOT charge the customer. It creates a payment intent and immediately refunds it
- It's recommended to set the authorization amount equal to the monthly fee of your most basic plan.
```

# Step 3 - Use LC Phone & LC Email

Using Twilio or Mailgun is risky for SaaS agencies because of latency in rebilling. This allows scam artists and bad actors to rack up your Twilio & Mailgun usage before the location credits are debited. This latency is caused by delays in usage records and webhooks that we receive from Twilio or Mailgun.

Using LC Phone & LC Email allows us to prevent that latency and also gives you access to additional security features like

1. Ramped usage for SMS, Email, VM drops, etc.
2. Maximum sending limits on Sub-accounts
3. Error rate, unsubscribe rate & complaint rate monitoring

[LC Email Ramp](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001220605-what-is-lc-email-i-want-to-know-more#Ramp-Up-Model%3A)

[LC Phone Ramp](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001213941-lc-phone-messaging-policy#1.-Ramp-Up-Model%3A)

[LC Email error thresholds & sending limit](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001220605-what-is-lc-email-i-want-to-know-more#extend-sending-limit)

[LC Phone error thresholds](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001213941-lc-phone-messaging-policy#2.-Spam-Message-handling%3A)

[LC Email Verification](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001235221)

All these technologies run in the background to minimize the chances of bad actors misusing your SaaS sub-account.

Migration to LC Phone & LC Email is easier than you may think.

[How do I migrate my agency and sub-account over to LC Phone?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001204027)

[How to Migrate My Agency Over to LC - Email](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001222501)

# Step 4 - Enable Phone Number & Email Verification by default

Boost the security of future SaaS signups by enabling Phone Number and Email Verification.

- Email Verification is mandatory by default for all SaaS signups.
- You can enable Phone Number verification for future SaaS signups by heading over to Agency Level -> Left Menu -> SaaS Configurator -> Security Settings -> Toggle : Verify Phone Number using a security code during sign-up
- To enable email verification for all your existing sub-accounts please head over to Agency Level -> Left Menu -> Settings -> Email Services -> Sub-Account Settings -> Enable Email Verification for all sub-accounts

# Step 5 - Use Stripe Radar

Stripe Radar is a fraud prevention suite integrated into the Stripe payment platform, utilizing machine learning algorithms trained on vast global data to detect and deter fraudulent transactions. It enables businesses to set custom rules to handle transactions based on specific parameters and provides detailed insights into flagged activities. Additionally, Radar offers features like adaptive acceptance, which dynamically requests added authentication for riskier payments, and a review dashboard for manual assessment. Integrated natively with Stripe, it offers a streamlined approach to online transaction security, reducing the need for third-party tools.

```
Stripe Radar is a paid product by Stripe but highly recommended for SaaS Agencies
```

[Stripe Radar](https://stripe.com/en-ca/radar)

Please log into your Stripe account and head over to Dasboard -> More -> Radar for Fraud Teams

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009992667/original/ybHmh8pg5Q_5Tble9_IzDd5idyaHqPzFig.png?1697134292)

## Useful rules we recommend

You can add Radar rules by heading over to the rules tab

### **3D Secure Authentication Rules**

These rules will allow the payment to go through if 3D Secure is authenticated

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009993558/original/c8R63SyPyTXmuKg5_-C5FW2Jh8O_Q5GU4Q.png?1697135590)

### **Block Rules**

These rules will block they payment altogether

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009993599/original/IdCkpkdV5fOsCS9SX-bkKuIsigezFG8tcQ.png?1697135673)

### **Review Rules**

These rules will allow the payment to occur but they will be successful only if a human reviews and approves them

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009993645/original/MNqV767sNLtdLYKxH3bHERszWOl4Lz1WcA.png?1697135770)

You can see all your pending reviews by heading over to the reviews tab in Radar. It looks like this

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009993689/original/4kNj3tNRcl9hP5jwtqECh2cBCN0LgpkrMA.png?1697135899)

As an agency admin or owner you can approve or refund these payments manually.

---

# **FAQ:**

## **Q: I followed these steps but a scammer was still able to signup. What do I do?**

A: All the rules mentioned above are best practices and they will prevent your SaaS sub-accounts from being misused in most cases. However, some bad actors might still be able to get through in rare instances.

In such cases the best thing is to refund all fraudulent payments and specifically mark them as fraudulent.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009994016/original/NuNsREtKzjWvqpGbTsTRt6xU7gIZC4hXrQ.png?1697136361)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155009994056/original/1DGpk1rEatstJp4RhI8TWSsI--PmCXzYDQ.png?1697136456)

```
When refunding the payment please select it as "Fraudulent". This is VERY IMPORTANT.
```

By refunding the payment and marking it as fraudulent Stripe Radar automatically gets smarter over time and prevents more scams from happening.

It automatically

- Adds the card fingerprint to your blocklist
- Adds the email ID to your blocklist
- Sends various signals like IP, email, card number, etc to Stripe which makes it more accurate over time

## **Q: What is Funnel/Website v2 and how does it enhance security?**

A: Funnel/Website v2 is an upgraded version of HighLevel funnels & websites. It supports native Stripe integration and 3D secure technology, which significantly improves the security of your SaaS checkout.

## **Q: What is Custom Authorization and how does it work?**

A: Custom Authorization is a feature that allows you to add an authorization amount to your SaaS products with a trial. It ensures that only real credit cards with sufficient balance can sign up. The customer is not charged; instead, a payment intent is created to validate the card's authenticity and immediately refunded.

## **Q: Why should I consider using LC Phone & LC Email over Twilio or Mailgun?**

A: Using Twilio or Mailgun can be risky due to latency in rebilling, which can be exploited by scammers. LC Phone & LC Email prevent this latency and offer additional security features like ramped usage, sending limits, and error rate monitoring.

## **Q: How can I enable Phone Number & Email Verification for my SaaS signups?**

A: You can enable these verifications through the Agency Level settings. For phone number verification, navigate to Settings -> Phone Integration. For email verification, go to Settings -> Email Services.

## **Q: What is Stripe Radar and how does it help in fraud prevention?**

A: Stripe Radar is a fraud prevention suite integrated into the Stripe payment platform. It uses machine learning algorithms to detect and deter fraudulent transactions. It allows businesses to set custom rules for transactions and provides insights into flagged activities.

## **Q: How can I set up rules in Stripe Radar for handling transactions?**

A: You can add Radar rules by heading over to the rules tab in your Stripe account. There are different types of rules, such as 3D Secure Authentication Rules, Block Rules, and Review Rules, to customize how transactions are handled.

## **Q: What action should I take if a flagged payment appears in Stripe Radar?**

A: If a payment is flagged in Stripe Radar, you can review it manually. As an agency admin or owner, you have the option to approve or refund these payments based on your assessment.

title_en: Audit Logs
source_md:
Get up to speed with HighLevel’s redesigned **Audit Logs**—now aligned with the New Design System UI. The right-side drawer keeps you in context, while keyboard navigation speeds up reviews. You’ll also learn how filters differ by area, how long data is retained (60 days), and practical tips to investigate changes efficiently.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Audit Logs?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Audit-Logs?)
- [Key Benefits of the New Audit Logs UI](#Key-Benefits-of-the-New-Audit-Logs-UI)
- [Drawer & Keyboard Navigation](#Drawer-&-Keyboard-Navigation)
- [Refreshed Layout](#Refreshed-Layout)
- [Understanding Audit Log Filters](#Understanding-Audit-Log-Filters)
- [How To Access the New Audit Logs UI](#How-To-Access-the-New-Audit-Logs-UI)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Audit Logs?**

Audit Logs are the source of truth for who did what and when across your HighLevel account. They provide time-stamped entries (with user, module, and action context) to help admins troubleshoot changes, maintain accountability, and meet compliance needs. The New Design System UI modernizes the experience so you can review details without leaving the main table.

Audit Logs provide a time-stamped record of key actions taken in your HighLevel account, enabling transparency and traceability for admins and power users. The updated interface delivers the same insights in a cleaner, faster workflow consistent with other New Design System screens.

---

## **Key Benefits of the New Audit Logs UI**

Understanding the value of the redesign helps your team adopt it quickly and apply Audit Logs confidently during investigations.

- **Drawer view:** Details open in a right-side panel so you never lose your table position.
- **Keyboard navigation:** Use **←/→** to move through entries quickly while keeping the drawer open.
- **Consistent components:** New Design System spacing and typography improve readability and reduce scanning fatigue.
- **Faster triage:** Stay in context to confirm changes, capture evidence, and move on without extra page loads.
- **Enhanced Visibility & Accountability:**Track all changes made to users, accounts, and settings to maintain a clear record of modifications.
- **Faster Issue Resolution:** Quickly identify and troubleshoot unexpected changes, saving time and effort.
- **Improved Security & Compliance:** Monitor user actions to prevent unauthorized modifications and ensure adherence to policies.
- **Efficient User Management:**Keep track of user activity, including account creations, edits, and deletions, for better team oversight.

---

## **Drawer & Keyboard Navigation**

The redesigned, right-side drawer keeps you in context while you investigate changes. Once the drawer is open, you can use the keyboard to move through records without closing the panel—perfect for scanning long audit trails quickly and accurately.

- **Open details in place:** Click any row to open the sleek right-side drawer with field-level before/after values, user, and timestamp—no page reloads and no lost scroll position.

```
Notification Preferences audit details (Sub-Account)

Notification Preferences changes appear as Updated actions. When you open an entry, the details drawer shows only the fields that changed with before/after values.

- First-time save: Audit Logs captures all notification preferences.
- Later updates: Audit Logs records only the preferences that were modified.
```

- **Navigate with arrow keys:** With the drawer open, press **left and right arrow keys** to jump to the previous or next audit record; the drawer updates in place so you maintain focus.
- **Work faster, click less:** Keep hands on the keyboard to minimize misclicks and speed up reviews during long investigation sessions.
- **Stay in control:** Close the drawer with the **X** icon or **Esc**; you’ll return to the exact spot in the table.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055833940/original/_wW25CG9R1VywBJZ0THe7kcEgEnOKJEUOw.gif?1760346977)**

---

## **Deleted Page Builder assets are logged**

Audit Logs now creates a **Deleted** entry when a user deletes saved Page Builder assets, including:

- Section Templates
- Global Sections
- Universal Sections
- Element Templates
- Universal Element Templates

Each deletion entry includes the **asset name** and**asset ID**. This applies to assets used in Funnels, Websites, Stores, and Webinars.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066486228/original/qxFvwpbp4uWKvy8-bPGvc1qK3EeG9Cn14A.png?1773051169)

---

## **Understanding Audit Log Filters**

Each filter focuses the results so you can quickly isolate the most relevant events. Understanding what each option does helps you audit faster with fewer clicks.

- **User:** Select a specific team member to view only the actions they performed. Ideal for monitoring individual contributions and investigating suspected edits.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055831976/original/8XutF7qifjQ5ZCxF1n-1MWDDCmahm8XHDg.png?1760346219)
- **Module:** Choose the affected area of the platform (for example, Users, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Websites/Funnels/Stores, Custom Objects, Listings, Notification Preferences, or Conversation AI Activity). Select Conversation AI Activity to view agent status changes and handoffs.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055832012/original/0gndVsLkGlGh1R6_bx-3uo6CwSS5jGSxhg.png?1760346234)
- **Action Type:**Limit results to a type of change such as **Create, Update, or Delete**. Useful for spotting critical changes quickly.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055832024/original/emKTcDtli8VRTbJjO79_c-xCEZDlVSZA0Q.png?1760346246)
- **Time Range:** Constrain results to a defined window (e.g., today, last 7 days, or upto 60 days) to match when the change occurred.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055832034/original/rKVwzwK1WHGuhVvCoGqa7rhI2bcpcTVxyw.png?1760346257)

---

## **Export Audit Logs (CSV Download)**

You can export filtered Audit Logs to a CSV file. Exports run asynchronously, and you can track progress and download completed files from the **Exports** tab.

For step-by-step instructions, see [Exporting Audit Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007611-exporting-audit-logs)

---

## **How To Access the Audit Logs**

The redesign is live across both **Agency** and **Sub-Account (Location)** contexts. Open Audit Logs in the context you need to review—each view shows only its own scope (agency-wide vs. location-specific).

```
Note: Notification Preferences audit logs are available in Sub-Account (Location) Audit Logs only.
```

1. **Choose your context:**  
   **Agency-wide activity:** Go to **Agency → Settings → Audit Logs**  
   **Sub-Account activity:** Go to **Sub-Account → Settings → Audit Logs**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055835291/original/Pnzxpj5NKxcRNUrlIRqd1WHHRGBOkjTxuQ.gif?1760347591)
2. From the Audit logs list, click the Preview (Eye) button or anywhere in the row to **open** the details **drawer** of that log  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055834650/original/9Oft3dRvCq76JHfDu5NXJqJ3he3bWvYu-w.png?1760347370)
3. Use **←/→**on your keyboard to cycle through entries while keeping the drawer open.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055835409/original/6jLq2dLOG-Y7jIhz1YI2mt45liW0QYgLOA.gif?1760347629)
4. **Apply filters** to narrow results. The **User** filter is available in **both Agency and Sub-Account** Audit Logs. (Other filter options such as **Module** and **Action** can vary by module.)  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055834175/original/6gWoK2woPaa6YUu0lT01f52tQSHzqWG1Dw.png?1760347099)
5. For module-specific reviews (e.g., **Funnels/Websites/Webinars/Stores**), open **Settings → Audit Logs** **inside the relevant Sub-Account** to see those entries.

---

## **Conversation AI Activity in Audit Logs**

Audit Logs also track Conversation AI activity, including when an agent is turned on, turned off, paused, or reassigned. These records help you identify what triggered a change, when it occurred, and who or what initiated it.

To view these records, go to Settings → Audit Logs in your sub-account and select Conversation AI Activity from the Module filter. You can also access audit history for a specific contact through Conversations → Contact Details → Audit logs.

For a complete walkthrough of tracked activities, available filters, and audit log details, see [Conversation AI Activity in Audit Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009143-how-to-track-conversation-ai-activity-in-audit-logs).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Who can access Audit Logs, and where do I find them?**  
Agency-level logs are available to **Agency Admins** at **Agency → Settings → Audit Logs**. Module-level logs within sub-accounts are typically available to **Account Admins** at **Sub-Account → Settings → Audit Logs**.

**Q: How long do the Logs retain for?**  
Audit Log entries are retained for **60 days** and then purged. Plan to capture needed evidence within that window.

**Q: Can I export Audit Logs?**

Yes. Using the Export Option on the top right. 

**Q: What’s the fastest way to review lots of entries?**  
Apply **Date** first, then **Action/Module** to narrow the list. Open the first row and use ****←/→**** to step through results while the drawer stays open.

**Q: How do I quickly find and restore deleted items (e.g., Opportunities)?**  
Filter **Action = Deleted** and the relevant **Module** (e.g., Opportunity). Open an entry to access restore options where supported. See: [Deleting & Restoring Opportunities & Pipelines](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002041-deleting-and-restoring-opportunities-pipelines).

**Q: Why do timestamps look different across teams or devices?**  
A: Time zone differences can cause mismatches. Verify your device time zone and the sub-account locale.

**Q: How do WordPress Access/Activity logs relate to Audit Logs?**  
A: WordPress logs complement platform Audit Logs for key events (e.g., site creation/deletion). Use both to form an end-to-end audit trail. See: [WordPress Access & Activity Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004141-wordpress-access-activity-logs).

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Audit Logs in Funnels, Websites, Webinars & Stores](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005439-audit-logs-in-funnels-websites-webinars-stores)
- [Custom Object Audit Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003844-custom-object-audit-logs)
- [Deleting & Restoring Opportunities & Pipelines](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002041-deleting-and-restoring-opportunities-pipelines)
- [Listings: Entity History & Audit Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005639-how-to-use-entity-history-in-listings-with-highlevel-audit-logs)
- [WordPress Access & Activity Logs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004141-wordpress-access-activity-logs)

title_en: Using Ask AI Artifacts and Mermaid Diagrams in HighLevel
source_md:
Ask AI now delivers richer, execution-ready responses that help you move from prompt to action faster. Instead of returning only plain text, Ask AI can intelligently organize information into structured formats such as tables, charts, todo lists, guided questions, code blocks, web search cards, media, approval requests, and Mermaid diagrams. These artifacts make it easier to analyze data, visualize workflows, create content, and collaborate with your team—all without leaving Ask AI.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Ask AI Artifacts?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-are-Ask-AI-Artifacts?)
- [Key Benefits of Ask AI Artifacts](#Key-Benefits-of-Ask-AI-Artifacts)
- [Supported Artifact Types](#Supported-Artifact-Types)
- [Tables](#Tables)
- [Charts](#Charts)
- [Guided Questions](#Guided-Questions)
- [Todo Lists](#Todo-Lists)
- [Code Blocks](#Code-Blocks)
- [Mermaid Diagrams](#Mermaid-Diagrams)
- [Media Artifacts](#Media-Artifacts)
- [Web Search Cards](#Web-Search-Cards)
- [Approval Requests](#Approval-Requests)
- [Error Blocks](#Error-Blocks)
- [How to Use Ask AI Artifacts](#How-to-Use-Ask-AI-Artifacts)
- [Best Practices](#Best-Practices)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What are Ask AI Artifacts?**

Ask AI Artifacts organize AI-generated responses into structured, interactive formats that are easier to read, understand, and act upon. Rather than presenting information only as plain text, Ask AI automatically selects the most appropriate layout—or lets you request one explicitly—to help visualize data, organize tasks, explain workflows, and support better decision-making.

Depending on your request, Ask AI can generate responses as:

- Tables
- Charts
- Todo Lists
- Guided Questions
- Approval Requests
- Code Blocks
- Mermaid Diagrams
- Media Artifacts
- Web Search Cards
- Error Blocks

Artifacts improve readability while helping you move more efficiently from ideas to execution. Although many artifacts organize information for you, some workflows may still require confirmation or supported Ask AI capabilities before actions are completed.

---

## **Key Benefits of Ask AI Artifacts**

Structured AI responses help transform ideas into organized, actionable outputs. Whether you’re planning campaigns, analyzing marketing performance, documenting workflows, or brainstorming new ideas, artifacts improve clarity and collaboration.

- **Improved readability:** Organizes complex information into structured layouts that are easier to review.
- **Faster decision-making:** Visualizes important data using tables and charts.
- **Workflow visualization:** Displays automations and processes using Mermaid diagrams.
- **Interactive conversations:** Uses Guided Questions to collect missing information before generating results.
- **Better collaboration:** Creates organized checklists, diagrams, and reports that are easier to share with your team.
- **Flexible output formats:** Automatically selects—or allows you to specify—the format that best matches your request.

---

## **Supported Artifact Types**

Each artifact type is designed to present information in the most useful format for your request. Ask AI automatically determines the best presentation when possible, but you can also request a specific format directly in your prompt.

## **Tables**

Tables organize structured information into rows and columns, making it easier to compare, prioritize, and review large amounts of data.

Common use cases include:

- Content calendars
- Campaign audits
- Lead reports
- Pipeline summaries
- Budget comparisons
- Performance tracking

**Example Prompt**

Create a 4-week content calendar for a real estate agent. Return it as a table with platform, publishing day, content format, and topic.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074661556/original/KqgaGTpECj71pMiAnGPgBHZQBYrUGAkA4w.png?1782588590)**

---

## **Charts**

Charts transform numerical information into visual insights that are easier to understand. When your prompt includes metrics or performance data, Ask AI can generate charts to help identify trends, comparisons, and opportunities.

Supported chart types may include:

- Bar Charts
- Line Charts
- Pie Charts
- Funnel Charts
- Radar Charts

**Example Prompt**

Analyze my agency performance and generate charts for lead volume, revenue growth, traffic trends, and funnel conversion.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074661682/original/aXhWknc1sKrZEGzeeJWqm5kau75j6Ob60A.png?1782589575)**

---

## **Guided Questions**

Guided Questions help Ask AI collect important information before generating a response. When your request is missing key details, Ask AI may ask follow-up questions to produce more accurate and personalized results.

For example, if you ask:

Create content

Ask AI may first ask:

- What type of content would you like to create?
- Which platform is it for?
- Who is your target audience?
- What industry or business are you in?

Providing these answers helps Ask AI generate more relevant recommendations.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074661567/original/hxe9_tMKIWgNbclBXzsSBq6WH3PyS3hbTA.png?1782588677)**

---

## **Todo Lists**

Todo Lists organize projects and processes into actionable checklists that are easy to follow and manage.

Common examples include:

- Client onboarding
- Campaign launches
- Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
- Internal team processes
- Marketing task planning
- Project management

---

## **Code Blocks**

Code Blocks generate clean, syntax-highlighted code for a variety of programming and scripting languages. Formatting improves readability and makes it easier to copy, review, and implement generated code.

Supported languages include:

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- SQL
- JSON
- Python

For the best results, specify the programming language in your prompt.

**Example Prompt**

Generate a JavaScript function that validates email addresses.

---

## **Mermaid Diagrams**

Mermaid diagrams convert text-based workflow descriptions into interactive visual diagrams. They are ideal for documenting automations, customer journeys, business processes, and decision trees.

Common use cases include:

- Automation workflows
- Lead journeys
- Campaign flows
- Decision trees
- Client onboarding
- Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Large diagrams support:

- Full-screen viewing
- Pan
- Zoom
- Toolbar controls

**Example Prompts**

- Create a Mermaid flowchart for my missed-call text-back automation.
- Map my lead lifecycle from new lead to closed deal.
- Generate a Mermaid diagram for a 7-day reactivation campaign.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155074661622/original/3qNsBL3UF60T1IIBReJlNvra5zJjr4c9pw.png?1782589192)**

---

## **Media Artifacts**

Media Artifacts display supported AI-generated media directly within the conversation, allowing you to review visual content without leaving Ask AI.

Depending on the supported workflow, media may include generated images or other supported visual outputs.

---

## **Web Search Cards**

Web Search Cards present supported web search results as structured preview cards directly within the conversation. This allows you to quickly review relevant information while continuing your workflow inside Ask AI.

---

## **Approval Requests**

Some Ask AI workflows require confirmation before continuing. Approval Requests provide an organized review step so you can verify information before Ask AI proceeds with supported actions.

---

## **Error Blocks**

If Ask AI cannot generate or render a requested artifact, it may display a structured Error Block explaining what went wrong and, when possible, what information is needed to continue successfully.

---

## **How to Use Ask AI Artifacts**

Providing clear instructions helps Ask AI choose the most appropriate artifact and generate higher-quality responses.

1. Open **Ask AI** from the left navigation menu.
2. Start a new conversation.
3. Describe the task you want to accomplish.
4. Optionally specify your preferred output format, such as:  
     
   - Table
   - Chart
   - Todo List
   - Mermaid Diagram
   - Code Block
5. Include relevant business context, campaign goals, workflows, or supporting data.
6. Review the generated artifact.
7. Continue the conversation to refine, expand, or modify the response as needed.

### **Example Prompts**

**Content Calendar**

Create a 4-week content calendar for a real estate agent. Return it as a table with platform, publishing day, content format, and topic.

**Campaign Analysis**

Review this campaign data and generate charts for lead volume, revenue growth, and funnel conversion.

**Automation Workflow**

Create a Mermaid flowchart for a missed-call text-back automation with fallback branches.

---

## **Best Practices**

Following a few prompt-writing best practices helps Ask AI generate more accurate and useful artifacts.

- Request the output format you want whenever possible.
- Clearly describe your business objective.
- Include relevant data, workflows, or campaign details.
- Ask for recommendations instead of summaries when appropriate.
- Specify ranking, comparison, or prioritization criteria when evaluating options  
  .
- Allow Ask AI to ask Guided Questions if additional information is needed.
- Continue the conversation to refine or expand generated artifacts.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to request a specific artifact?**

No. Ask AI automatically selects the format it believes best fits your request. However, specifying an output format usually produces more predictable results.

**Q: What are Mermaid diagrams used for?**

Mermaid diagrams visually represent workflows, automations, lead lifecycles, campaign flows, decision trees, and Standard Operating Procedures.

**Q: Can I view Mermaid diagrams in full screen?**

Yes. Large Mermaid diagrams support full-screen viewing, along with pan, zoom, and toolbar controls for easier navigation.

**Q: What are Guided Questions?**

Guided Questions are interactive prompts that Ask AI uses to collect missing information before generating a response, helping improve the accuracy of the final output.

**Q: Can Ask AI generate charts and tables?**

Yes. When your prompt includes structured data or performance metrics, Ask AI can organize information into tables and generate supported charts.

**Q: Do artifacts automatically complete actions in HighLevel?**

Not always. Artifacts organize and present information. Some actions still require confirmation, supported Ask AI capabilities, or the appropriate user permissions.

**Q: Can I ask Ask AI to change the artifact format?**

Yes. You can continue the conversation and request a different output format, such as converting a table into a chart or generating a Mermaid diagram from a written workflow.

**Q: What types of prompts produce the best artifacts?**

The best results come from prompts that clearly describe your objective, provide relevant context or data, and specify the desired output format whenever possible.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Introduction to Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005327)
- [Ask AI + Agent Studio Integration](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006677)
- [Contact Summary Agent in Ask AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005484)

---

title_en: Accept Payments in AI Studio
source_md:
You can accept payments directly within projects built in AI Studio using your existing HighLevel products and payment setup. Payments can be introduced while AI Studio is building the project or configured later from within the builder. This article explains how to enable payments, add products, configure pricing, manage checkout, and review orders.

[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/1WUiAB0Oc7nKicSV35dW)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Accept Payments in AI Studio](#Accept-Payments-in-AI-Studio)
- [Current Limitations](#Current-Limitations)
- [How to Enable Payments in AI Studio](#How-to-Enable-Payments-in-AI-Studio)
- [Configure Your Payment Provider](#Configure-Your-Payment-Provider)
- [How to Add and Configure Products](#How-to-Add-and-Configure-Products)
- [Checkout Experience](#Checkout-Experience)
- [Orders and Post-Purchase Experience](#Orders-and-Post-Purchase-Experience)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Accept Payments in AI Studio**

Payments in AI Studio lets you add functional checkout experiences to AI-generated projects. Whether you're selling a single product, offering subscriptions, or building an online storefront, you can use products and prices already configured in your HighLevel account.

AI Studio handles how products and checkout appear within your project, while HighLevel manages payment processing and order records. This allows you to customize the shopping experience without rebuilding your existing payment infrastructure.

This gives you a faster way to move from an idea to a working purchase experience while keeping your products, payment setup, and orders centralized in HighLevel.

```
Important: Shipping and pickup are not supported in the current release. Payments are also not supported for AI Studio calendar experiences.
```

---

## **Current Limitations**

- **Manual Payments:** Manual payment methods, including Cash on Delivery, are unavailable.
- **Calendar Payments:** Payments are not supported for AI Studio calendar experiences.
- **Product Personalization:** Arbitrary product-personalization fields, such as engraving text or custom printing instructions, cannot be passed to orders.
- **Product Editing:** Product details, prices, and variations must be managed in the HighLevel product catalog.
- **Project Type:** Payments are currently available only for projects built on **TanStack Start**. Existing React projects must be migrated using **Project Settings > Migrate to SSR** before the Payments option becomes available.
- **Shipping and Pickup:** Customer-facing shipping and pickup options are not supported.

---

## **How to Enable Payments in AI Studio**

Payments can be enabled while AI Studio is building your project or enabled directly from the project's Payments settings.

### **Automatic Payment Detection**

When AI Studio detects that your request involves selling a product or accepting payments, it can prompt you to enable payments while the project is being generated.

1. Describe the website or experience you want AI Studio to build.
2. If AI Studio detects selling intent, an **Add payments to this app** prompt appears.
3. Click **Enable Payments** to include payments in the project.
4. Continue through any follow-up questions AI Studio asks about the experience you want to create.

The follow-up questions are generated based on your original request, so the options can vary from project to project. For example, AI Studio may ask how you want customers to purchase the product or what type of selling experience you want to create.

Enabling payments during the build allows AI Studio to account for checkout and purchasing as it creates the project. After the project is generated, use **More > Payments** to review and complete the payment configuration.

![Automatic payment detection in AI Studio](https://jumpshare.com/share/7ZyzIVSabK6Hg00aYtQB+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-07+at+10.29.23+AM.gif)

### **Manually Enable Payments**

You can also enable or manage payments directly from the project without relying on AI Studio to detect selling intent.

1. From within an AI Studio project, click **More**.
2. Select **Payments**.
3. Click **Enable Payments**.

The Payments area displays the project's payment status, **Test** and **Live** modes, payment method, and payment products. You can also disable payments on a project from this page.

**Already using Payments?** Existing AI Studio projects receive these checkout enhancements on their next prompt. You do not need to reconnect Payments.

![Manually enabling Payments in AI Studio](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082688469/original/iiy48OImUQG4v4xh0RoWtGMgBMfiywNNjw.gif?1791321471)

---

## **Configure Your Payment Provider**

AI Studio uses HighLevel's existing payment infrastructure, so payment providers are managed through your HighLevel payment settings rather than through a separate AI Studio integration.

In the **Payment method** area:

- Click **Connect** if no payment provider is connected.
- Click **Manage** to review or update the existing payment integration.

If a provider is already connected in HighLevel, AI Studio uses that payment setup for the project.

When payments are enabled, the project starts in **Test** mode by default. Use Test mode to verify the product, pricing, and checkout experience without processing real charges. When testing is complete, switch to **Live** mode to begin accepting real customer payments.

```
Important: Manual payment methods, including Cash on Delivery, are not supported in AI Studio Payments.
```

![Payment provider configuration in AI Studio](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082688259/original/cIpCZbScJfwBZ_5XrarRhKbHx9S3puACWA.png?1791320883)

---

## **How to Add and Configure Products**

AI Studio uses products from your existing HighLevel product catalog. The product, its pricing, and any available variations must already be configured in HighLevel before you can add it to an AI Studio project.

To add a product:

1. Open **More > Payments**.
2. In **Payment products**, click **Add products** or **Browse catalog**.
3. Search for a product by **name or SKU**.
4. Select the products you want to add, then click **Continue to pricing**.
5. Choose how the product should be offered:  
     
   - **Fixed price:** Select the specific price or variation customers will purchase.
   - **Customer chooses variation:** Allow customers to choose from the variations already configured for that product.
6. Review the configuration, then click **Add product**.

```
Note: AI Studio Payments supports both recurring products/subscriptions and post-purchase upsells.
```

![Adding and configuring products in AI Studio Payments](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082783154/original/dxvY-UMNAGFcFbl7iybNeqhxxeCM2epa6g.gif?1791393473)

---

## **Checkout Experience**

The checkout in an AI Studio project is hosted and managed by HighLevel. Card details are entered and processed through HighLevel's hosted checkout and are never handled by your app's generated code.

Supported payment methods include:

- Card payments through the connected payment provider
- PayPal Express Checkout

Checkout also supports fully discounted orders without requiring card details and subscriptions, including carts with multiple subscription products.

After checkout, you can present a post-purchase upsell. With supported saved-card providers (Stripe, Square, Authorize.net, NMI, Adyen, and Mercado Pago), customers can accept the offer in one click without entering payment details again. Other payment methods use the standard payment form.

An upsell can only be charged after the original order is successfully paid and can only be charged once per order.

![Hosted checkout experience in AI Studio](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082688602/original/I_2AJkPaNPYnEWCy3jOBglnLq4zgY9Hj-A.png?1791321993)

### 

### **Customize Checkout Fields**

Choose which buyer details appear at checkout to collect the information your business needs without adding unnecessary fields.

From **Sub-Account View > AI Studio > My Projects**, open your Payments-enabled project. In the project chat, enter a prompt such as *"Make phone required and hide the billing address."* Review the updated checkout in the project preview.

- **Phone and billing address:** Set each field to hidden, optional, or required. Address fields include street, city, state, ZIP code, and country.
- **Name and email:** Always required. These fields cannot be hidden.

### **Two-Step Checkout and Lead Capture**

Two-step checkout captures buyer information before payment, helping you retain new leads even when they do not complete a purchase.

From **Sub-Account View > AI Studio > My Projects**, open your Payments-enabled project. In the project chat, enter *"Make it a two-step checkout."* Review the updated checkout in the project preview.

- **Step 1:** Save the buyer as a CRM contact.
- **Step 2:** Collect payment.

**Workflow note:** Newly created contacts trigger **Contact Created**, not **Order Form Submission**. Use Contact Created for lead follow-up workflows.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155085087642/original/UoxkxJCAXZcuO1PCVQ6bTsOKbN9dq2nc_g.png?1793940322)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155085087650/original/N0CUUWCFe56K8qNe9CUkyWgwrOte2oBLsA.png?1793940334)

---

## **Orders and Post-Purchase Experience**

Orders from AI Studio appear in **Orders** in HighLevel, just like orders from other sales channels. Open an order to view the customer, purchased products, payment status, transaction details, and fulfillment information.

The Source section identifies orders that came from AI Studio and shows the related project details, including the project name, project ID, and domain.

You can also use HighLevel workflows after purchase to send confirmations, follow-up messages, internal notifications, or other post-purchase automations.

![AI Studio order details in HighLevel](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082957541/original/3QLvVWaaVfdvFmwbI5hxrO0j08_F3GEtHQ.png?1791552659)

### **Order Confirmations and Custom Thank-You Pages**

After a successful payment, buyers see a detailed order confirmation showing the order ID, purchased items, taxes, and total paid. Subscription confirmations also show the next charge.

You can also direct buyers to a custom thank-you page that displays their actual order details.

From **Sub-Account View > AI Studio > My Projects**, open your Payments-enabled project. In the project chat, enter *"Send buyers to my own thank-you page after payment."* Review the post-payment experience.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155085087634/original/6OSZdDVj8PXYakt_nNIkz8D4o0f2uJZUpA.png?1793940280)

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started - Create & Sell Products](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005071)
- [Supported Payment Providers & Methods](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006075)
