title_en: Ask AI Templates
source_md:
Ask AI

# Ask AI Templates — Guided Workflows for Every HighLevel Task

Follow step-by-step templates to complete common business tasks—from campaign setup to regulatory compliance—without memorizing navigation.

What You'll Learn

Ask AI now includes over 90 ready-made templates that walk you through multi-step workflows in HighLevel—from creating campaigns and booking appointments to purchasing phone numbers and submitting compliance bundles.

Templates are organized by category, scoped to sub-account or agency context, and filtered by your user permissions so you only see workflows you're authorized to run.

## What are Ask AI Templates?

Ask AI Templates are ready-made, guided workflows that walk you through common HighLevel business tasks step by step. Instead of figuring out every click yourself, you select a template and Ask AI collects the information it needs, presents clear choices, and completes the workflow on your behalf.

With over 90 templates covering everyday operations—from creating campaigns and booking appointments to purchasing phone numbers and submitting compliance documents—you can finish complex multi-step tasks in a single guided flow.

## Key Benefits

Ask AI Templates streamline your workflow, reduce training time, and keep your team focused on results instead of navigating menus.

**Complete Multi-Step Tasks Faster** — Finish intake forms, booking flows, campaign setup, and billing processes in one guided conversation instead of switching between multiple screens.

**Reduce Onboarding Time** — New users follow templates instead of memorizing HighLevel navigation, so they can start delivering results on day one.

**Organized by Category** — Templates are grouped into clear categories (Communication, CRM, Commerce & Payments, AI Agents, Integrations, Social Media, Sales, Marketing) and sub-areas (Contacts, Calendars, Invoices) so you can find the right workflow quickly.

**Context-Aware Scoping** — Sub-account templates appear when you're working inside a location; agency templates appear when you're in the agency view, keeping your template list focused and relevant.

**Permission-Aware Visibility** — You only see templates your user role is allowed to run. If you lack access to Calendars, Invoices, or other features, those templates stay hidden—keeping the interface clean and secure.

## Template Categories and Examples

Ask AI Templates are organized into categories that mirror your day-to-day HighLevel workflows. Each category includes templates for specific tasks, and many are further divided into sub-areas for faster discovery.

Communication

Connect Messaging Channels and Launch Campaigns

Templates for connecting Facebook Messenger, Instagram DM, phone systems, and SMS campaigns.

Examples: "Connect your Facebook account and link pages and enable Messenger and Instagram DM", "Guided walkthrough to write your message and select a contact segment" (SMS campaign), "Register your brand and SMS campaign with US carriers" (A2P compliance).

CRM

Manage Contacts, Calendars, and Opportunities

Workflows for creating pipelines, adding deals, and managing customer records.

Example: "Create a named pipeline with custom stages and immediately add your first deal" (Opportunities).

Commerce & Payments

Accept Payments and Manage Bookings

Templates for calendar setup, payment gateway connection, and invoicing.

Example: "Connect your Google Calendar and create a new booking calendar" (Calendars).

AI Agents

Deploy Voice and Conversation AI

Set up AI agents for phone calls, web chat, and review management.

Examples: "Configure a voice AI agent from conversation analysis" (Voice AI), "Auto-build a Conversation AI agent trained on your business profile and website" (Conversation AI), "Create a Review AI agent and connect Google and configure automated review request" (Reputation).

Integrations

Connect Third-Party Platforms

Workflows for linking Facebook, Google, Instagram, and other external services.

Examples: "Full Facebook lead capture flow to connect your account via OAuth" (Facebook Leads), "Link your Facebook pages to Social Planner" (Social Planner), "Link your Instagram account to Social Planner" (Social Planner).

Social Media

Plan and Publish Social Content

Templates for scheduling posts, linking accounts, and managing social campaigns.

Example: "Link your Facebook pages to Social Planner" (Social Planner).

Sales

Build Pipelines and Close Deals

Opportunity management and pipeline setup workflows.

Example: "Create a named pipeline with custom stages and immediately add your first deal" (Opportunities).

Marketing

Launch Campaigns and Capture Leads

Campaign setup, message design, and lead capture workflows.

Example: "Guided walkthrough to write your message and select a contact segment" (SMS Campaign).

Note

The examples above represent a sample of the 90+ templates available. The full catalog covers additional workflows within each category and continues to grow as HighLevel adds features.

## Sub-Account vs Agency Context

Ask AI Templates automatically adjust to your current context—whether you're working inside a sub-account (location) or viewing agency-level settings.

Sub-Account (Location) Templates

Day-to-Day Location Work

When you're inside a specific sub-account, Ask AI shows templates for workflows that operate at the location level—managing contacts, creating campaigns, booking appointments, sending invoices, and connecting messaging channels. These templates help you complete tasks for individual clients or business units.

Agency (Company) Templates

Agency-Level Operations

When you're in the agency view, Ask AI displays templates for agency-wide tasks—creating users, provisioning new sub-accounts, managing SaaS billing, sharing snapshots across locations, and purchasing phone numbers. These templates appear only in the agency context, keeping location-level menus focused on location work.

Tip

Switch between sub-account and agency views to access the full range of templates. Ask AI automatically updates the template list to match your current working context.

## Permission-Aware Visibility

Ask AI Templates respect your user role permissions. You only see templates you're allowed to run—if your role lacks access to a feature (Contacts, Calendars, Invoices, etc.), the related templates stay hidden.

This permission-aware filtering keeps your template list clean, secure, and relevant. Admins and users with broader permissions will see more templates; restricted users see only the workflows they can execute.

Important

Templates are secured by your user permissions (scopes). If you don't have access to a feature—like Contacts, Calendars, or Invoices—you won't see the related templates. Only users with the required permissions can view and run them.

Example

If a user role has read-only Calendars access (or no Calendars access at all), that user will not see calendar booking templates. If the role gains write access, the calendar templates will appear automatically.

## How to Use Ask AI Templates

Ask AI Templates are designed for zero friction. Follow these steps to launch a guided workflow.

Step 1

Open Ask AI

Click the Ask AI icon in your HighLevel account. The Templates view appears by default.

Step 2

Browse or Search for a Template

Use the category tabs (All, Communication, CRM, Commerce & Payments, AI Agents, Integrations, Social Media, Sales, Marketing) to browse workflows, or type a keyword in the search box to filter by name or description.

Step 3

Select a Template

Click the template card that matches your task. Ask AI will open a guided conversation to collect the information needed for that workflow.

Step 4

Follow the Prompts

Answer Ask AI's questions and make selections as prompted. The assistant will guide you through every required field, choice, and configuration step for the task.

Step 5

Confirm and Complete

Review the summary Ask AI provides, then confirm. The assistant executes the workflow—creating the resource, connecting the integration, or launching the campaign—and confirms completion.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077031249/original/6j0E01qigVdBuAFjxPN-eT1DHL8dqKhXHA.png?1785243077)

Success

Once the template completes, you can verify the results in the relevant area of HighLevel—Campaigns, Calendars, Opportunities, etc.—or start a new template workflow from the Templates screen.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Why don't I see certain templates?

Templates are filtered by your user permissions. If your role lacks access to a feature—like Contacts, Calendars, or Invoices—the related templates will be hidden. Contact your account admin if you need additional permissions.

Q: Can I customize or edit a template workflow?

Templates are pre-designed workflows that guide you through a specific task. You cannot edit the template itself, but you provide all the custom data (contact names, calendar settings, message text, etc.) during the guided conversation. The assistant applies your inputs to create the final result exactly as you specify.

Q: Do templates work at both the sub-account and agency level?

Yes. Sub-account (location) templates appear when you're inside a specific location and handle day-to-day tasks like campaigns and bookings. Agency (company) templates appear when you're in the agency view and cover agency-wide operations like user provisioning, SaaS billing, and snapshot sharing. The template list adjusts automatically based on your current context.

Q: How many templates are available?

Ask AI includes over 90 templates at launch, covering Communication, CRM, Commerce & Payments, AI Agents, Integrations, Social Media, Sales, and Marketing. HighLevel continues to add templates as new features and workflows are released.

Q: Can I use templates to train new team members?

Absolutely. Templates are ideal for onboarding because they walk new users through each step of a workflow without requiring them to memorize HighLevel navigation. New team members can start completing tasks—launching campaigns, booking appointments, creating pipelines—on day one by following the guided prompts.

Q: What happens if I start a template and need to stop mid-workflow?

You can exit a template conversation at any time. Any changes you confirmed before exiting will be saved (for example, if you completed step 1 of a multi-step template, that step's result is saved). You can start a new template or return to the main Ask AI interface whenever you're ready.

Q: Are templates available on all HighLevel plans?

Ask AI Templates are included with accounts that have access to Ask AI. Check your plan details or contact HighLevel support to confirm availability for your account type.

Q: Can I suggest a new template for a workflow that isn't covered?

Yes. HighLevel welcomes feedback on template ideas. Contact HighLevel support or submit a feature request through the Ideas Board to suggest workflows you'd like to see added to the template library.

title_en: Post Creation Nudges in Communities
source_md:
Community Engagement

# Post Creation Nudges in HighLevel Communities

Boost community engagement with automated prompts that encourage users to share courses, events, and achievements instantly.

What You'll Learn

Post Creation Nudges help keep your community engaged by prompting users to share important updates immediately after completing key actions. With pre-filled posts and automatic mentions, sharing becomes effortless.

This article covers how Post Creation Nudges work, the supported actions that trigger sharing prompts, and how to use them to drive engagement in your HighLevel Communities.

## What Are Post Creation Nudges?

Post Creation Nudges are smart prompts inside HighLevel Communities (GoKollab) that appear right after key actions—such as creating a course, creating an event, or completing a course. Instead of expecting admins or learners to remember to post manually, HighLevel surfaces a "Share as Post" prompt with a pre-filled message and automatic mentions, so important updates can be shared in one click.

These nudges use the standard community post composer—where members already create rich posts and select channels—to keep everything familiar and easy to manage.

## Key Benefits

Understanding why these nudges exist makes it easier to weave them into your engagement strategy instead of treating them as one-off prompts. Post Creation Nudges remove friction, increase visibility, and celebrate meaningful activity inside your communities.

**Instant visibility for new content** — New courses and events can be shared as posts immediately after they're created, helping members discover them without hunting through tabs or menus.

**Built-in timing at the moment of action** — Nudges appear right when admins or learners are most engaged (right after creating or completing something), which significantly increases the likelihood of sharing.

**Pre-filled posts with automatic mentions** — Course and event mentions are inserted automatically, giving members a clear, clickable path to the resource, which supports higher registrations and course starts.

**More consistent community communication** — Announcements about new learning opportunities and upcoming events are less likely to be forgotten, keeping engagement steady as your community grows.

**Motivation and social proof from learner wins** — Course completion nudges help learners share their achievements, inspiring others to enroll and complete content as well.

**Minimal setup, no extra tools required** — Nudges work directly within GoKollab Communities and use the existing post creation workflow and channels you already manage.

## Post Creation Nudges for New Courses

New course nudges help admins turn every course launch into a clear, discoverable announcement without writing a post from scratch. As soon as a course is added to a group, the admin can share it with the relevant members in seconds.

When you add a new course inside a community or attach a course to a group (often via the Learning area of your community or through Kollab Studio), you configure course details, pricing, and access. Post Creation Nudges build on that flow by prompting you to broadcast the course to the right audience.

How the nudge behaves for new courses:

- After a group admin creates a new course and associates it with a community group, a "Share as Post" prompt appears.
- The post is pre-filled with the course title and a course mention, making the announcement clear and clickable for members.
- Admins can edit the post text before publishing, confirm or change the target community group and channel (using the same channel system for Announcements, General chat, or other categories), and publish immediately with one click.

## Post Creation Nudges for Events

Event nudges ensure that when you create a Community Event—such as a workshop, Q&A, or live room session—you also share it as a post so members can see and register quickly.

Community Events already centralize event details (date, time, description, free or paid, and visibility for specific groups, courses, or membership levels). Post Creation Nudges extend that by turning event creation into a posting opportunity right away.

How the nudge behaves for events:

- When an authorized user (such as a group owner or admin) creates a new Community Event, they'll see a "Share as Post" prompt after saving.
- The generated post includes a pre-filled event announcement and an event mention that links to the event, helping members find details and register.
- Before posting, the creator can adjust the post copy to better match the tone or audience and select the best group and channel (for example, an Announcements channel for major events or a niche channel for smaller cohorts).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077794253/original/zaeg9wdq3aw67dCAFIWALLIHB5FkUx9ykg.png?1786018414)

## Post Creation Nudges for Course Completions

Course completion nudges focus on the learner experience, turning each completion into a moment of recognition and encouragement that can inspire others to keep learning.

When learners finish a course inside a community's Learning area, HighLevel tracks their progress and can present next steps or related content. Post Creation Nudges add a celebration layer by inviting learners to share what they've achieved.

How the nudge behaves for completions:

- After a learner completes a course, they receive a congratulatory prompt inviting them to "Share as Post."
- The pre-filled post typically includes a short congratulatory or reflective message and a mention of the completed course, so other members can easily find and enroll in it.
- The learner can then personalize the message (for example, adding what they learned or thanking the instructor) and choose the group and channel where the achievement will be posted, subject to their posting permissions in that community.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077794622/original/YLUeQAQYBTQgnqPMv8Xwh9EyO0ekdmFaAg.jpeg?1786018597)

## Share as Post Prompt Experience

The "Share as Post" prompt uses the same core post composer as other community posts, so admins and members don't need to learn a new interface. This consistency keeps all of your content—manual posts, scheduled posts, and nudge-driven posts—flowing through the same channels and permissions model.

What to expect when a nudge appears:

Step 1

Trigger an eligible action

Add a new course to a group, create a new Community Event, or complete a course as a learner.

Step 2

See the "Share as Post" prompt

A modal or panel appears with a pre-filled post. The post already contains the relevant course or event mention, so it's ready to share.

Step 3

Review and Customize the post

Edit the headline or body text to better fit your voice or call to action. Optionally add emojis, attachments (images, videos, PDFs, GIFs), or embedded media—just like any other community post.

Step 4

Select the group and channel

Confirm which community group the post belongs to. Choose the appropriate channel (e.g., Announcements, General, or a topic-specific channel), using the existing channel structure you've set up in Communities.

Step 5

Publish the Post

Click Post to publish instantly to the selected group and channel. Members will then see the update in their community feed, alongside other posts, events, and content.

## How to Set Up Post Creation Nudges

Post Creation Nudges do not require complex configuration; they are designed to work automatically within the GoKollab (new UI/Beta) communities experience. However, a solid setup of Communities, courses, and events ensures the nudges show up in the right places and are genuinely useful to your members.

Follow these steps to ensure you're ready to use Post Creation Nudges effectively:

Step 1

Confirm you're using GoKollab (New Communities UI)

Access Kollab Studio, HighLevel's creator hub for managing communities and courses in one place.

Make sure you can see your communities and courses listed there. If you're still on an older communities experience, reach out to Support or your HighLevel rep to confirm GoKollab access.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077900107/original/flRNpvBwpPrNCNlYbTYpbTSPtom7rPt67w.png?1786110612)

Step 2

Create or verify your community and groups

In Communities, create a community (if you haven't already) and set up the groups and channels that structure your member discussions (e.g., Announcements, General, topic rooms).

Confirm you are an owner or admin so you can create courses and events in that community.

Step 3

Add courses to your community

Use the Learning or Courses area associated with your community or access courses through Kollab Studio.

Create a new course (or ensure existing courses are properly associated with the right group).

When you save the course, watch for the "Share as Post" nudge and follow the flow to publish your announcement.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077793898/original/hD7SZl_TCzm7AzoSrhY2lEzYb9_42etQfg.png?1786018227)

Step 4

Enable and create Community Events

Within your community, navigate to the Events or Community Events area.

Create an event with title, time, description, location (such as Live Room, Zoom, or another link), and visibility settings for the appropriate audience.

After saving, use the Post Creation Nudge to share the event as a community post with an automatic event mention.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077793756/original/zdbkdFY50BL0i5fh0LaEasNVyuzRVlYzHg.png?1786018159)

Step 5

Test the learner experience for course completions

Enroll a test member (or yourself) in one of your courses in the community Learning area.

Progress through the course and complete it to trigger the course completion nudge.

Customize the pre-filled post, select the desired community group and channel, and post the celebration to verify visibility.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077794068/original/W4kbbbaiDWGeecBM2JAf8ld6uS3BoN1HFg.png?1786018305)  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077794170/original/HdjLMMTArmlJ4Kvj4hVJDb3tLbRh65-cYw.png?1786018351)

Step 6

Incorporate nudges into your engagement plan

Decide which channels should receive new course announcements, event promotions and reminders (alongside calendar and email reminders where configured), and course completion celebrations.

Communicate expectations to moderators and instructors so they consistently use nudges when they appear.

Pro Tip

Encourage learners to personalize their course completion posts by adding reflections, photos, or thank-yous. This builds community culture and inspires others to engage with your courses.

title_en: Setting Up Linked Calendars & Conflict Calendars
source_md:
HighLevel lets you synchronize external calendars (Google, Office 365, Outlook.com) to keep your availability up to date and prevent double-bookings. Use **Connected Calendars** to authorize HighLevel’s access, **Linked Calendars** to import events and show true availability, and **Conflict Calendars** to automatically block HighLevel slots when you have other commitments.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [When to Use Connected, Linked & Conflict Calendars](#When-to-Use-Connected,-Linked-&-Conflict-Calendars)
- [Prerequisites](#Prerequisites)
- [Setting up the Linked Calendar](#Setting-up-the-Linked-Calendar)
- [Service Bookings Sync to Linked Third-Party Calendars](#Service-Bookings-Sync-to-Linked-Third-Party-Calendars)
- [Sync Preferences (Advanced Settings)](#Sync-Preferences-(Advanced-Settings))
  - [1. Default Sync (One Way Sync)](#1.-Default-Sync-(One-Way-Sync))
  - [2. Two-Way Sync](#2.-Two-Way-Sync)
- [Conflict Calendars](#Conflict-Calendars)
- [How these Calendars Work](#How-these-Calendars-Work)
- [Best Practices & Considerations](#Best-Practices-&-Considerations)
- [Common Troubleshooting](#Common-Troubleshooting)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **When to Use Connected, Linked & Conflict Calendars**

- **Connected Calendars**: Grant HighLevel permission to read (and optionally write) events from an external calendar account.
- **Linked Calendars**: Import events and availability into HighLevel so your true busy times display.
- **Conflict Calendars**: Mark certain connected calendars as blockers, automatically making overlapping High-Level booking slots **Unavailable**.

---

## **Prerequisites**

- **User Role**: Admin or Manager access in the sub-account.
- **External Calendar Account**: Active Google Calendar, Office 365, or Outlook.com login credentials for each user.

---

## **Setting up the Linked Calendar**

### **Step 1:** Access the Connections Tab

In your HighLevel sub-account sidebar, go to **Settings → Calendars,**then click the **Connections** tab at the top to go to **Calendars** and **Connected Calendars**. 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047943546/original/6nBdgykHgbRT_uGAU8fK9U-OP5Rk7y2HhA.gif?1749472656)

### **Step 2:** Add a Calendar

1. Under **Connected Calendars**, click **+ Add New**.
2. Select your provider: **Google**, **Outlook, iCloud or Calendly Calendar.**
3. Sign in and grant HighLevel permission to **read** events (and **write**, if you plan to sync bookings back).
4. Once successful, you’ll see your email listed with its provider icon.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047943978/original/stEFOtKQ5zhCQXbs8zNrUfu19JMVsdKWIg.gif?1749473168)

```
Alert: Reconnect broken integrations  

If you see a red banner like “Reconnect your integration” or the calendar tile is outlined in red, your OAuth token may have expired or been revoked. Click Reconnect and re-authorize HighLevel to restore access.

If the third-party calendar was deleted at the provider, the banner can also display a Fix This option. Click Fix This to review all deleted calendar instances and use Remove Deleted Calendars to clean up broken connections. 

Automatic resync after reconnect or changes: When you reconnect a previously disconnected calendar, HighLevel automatically pushes any unsynced upcoming appointments to your external calendar. If you connect a new calendar or switch to a different selected calendar within the same integration, HighLevel automatically resyncs future appointments to the newly selected calendar.
```

### **Step 3:** Configure Your Linked Calendar

1. In the **Calendar Configuration** section under **Linked Calendar**, click **Add**.
2. Choose one of your **Connected Calendars** to import events into HighLevel.
3. Click **Save**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047944165/original/cmcw_3LVwMag0rf2j0gu5C_Lz6RqRe47IA.gif?1749473383)

```
IMPORTANT:-  
  
1. Writer's access is required for the user to select a calendar as a linked calendar. 
  
2. The linked calendar is by default added to the conflict calendar. This means any event created on the third-party linked calendar will be fetched in the system, and any event created in the system will be pushed to the third-party linked calendar. 
  
3. You can set your Sync Preferences from the Advanced Settings.
```

---

## **Service Bookings Sync to Linked Third-Party Calendars**

Linked calendars help staff keep their assigned service bookings visible alongside the rest of their schedule. This improves day-to-day calendar visibility and makes it easier to manage appointments across platforms like Google, Outlook, and iCloud.

Service bookings can now sync to the linked third-party calendar selected in Calendar Settings > Connections.

Supported linked calendars include:

- Google
- Outlook
- iCloud

**Important:**

bookings assigned to you sync to your selected linked calendar

if a single booking includes multiple services assigned to different staff members, each staff member sees only their own assigned booking on their own linked calendar

This keeps service scheduling more accurate across teams and avoids unnecessary visibility into bookings assigned to other users.

---

## **Sync Preferences (Advanced Settings)**

### **1. Default Sync (One Way Sync)**

- Events created on the system will be synced to Linked Calendar (Eg, Google).
- Events created on Linked Calendar (Eg, Google) will be synced to the system.  
    
  1. These events are synced as blocked slots.
  2. No contact is created for guests in the Linked Calendar (Eg, Google) events.
  3. No automations / workflows are triggered.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047945204/original/jZsOK6uuUHRASpqHvscqcdsB6DadEbS_fg.png?1749474582)

### **2. Two-Way Sync**

- Events created on the system will be synced to Linked Calendar (Eg, Google).
- Events created on Linked Calendar (Eg, Google) will be synced to the system.  
    
  1. These events are synced as appointments.
  2. Contact is created for the guests found in the Linked Calendar (Eg, Google) events.
  3. Automation/workflows can be triggered like any other appointment created in the system.

```
For Example: John has created a google event from 1:00 pm to 2:00 pm called 'Doctor's Appointment with Dr. Mark' and has added Dr. Mark as a guest in his google calendar.  
  
Default Sync (One-way Sync): Only a blocked time from 1:00 pm to 2:00 pm will be added in the system so that no one can book during that time.  
  
Two-way Sync: An appointment is created in the system from 1:00 pm to 2:00 pm so that no one can book during that time. A new contact for Dr. Mark is created in the system. If any workflows are created, they would get triggered for Dr. Mark.
```

---

## **Conflict Calendars**

Events from third-party calendars added as conflict calendars are synced to the system, blocking your availability for the event's duration. As the name suggests, we read all the events from the selected calendar and block off the timings when the user is not available. The availability is blocked only if the event is marked as 'BUSY' in the third-party calendar. For events marked as 'FREE', the events are fetched in the system but the availability remains open. 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155047945538/original/sckXVuIxwCrhketzFQDkdTzL8lhoedKrbg.gif?1749474918)

This ensures accurate availability and avoids double bookings. You can add multiple calendars to be checked to prevent double bookings. In the Conflict Calendars section, we do not create any appointments, instead we just block off the time for any event already scheduled in your third party calendar.

---

## **How these Calendars Work**

1. **Booking Requests**

   - When a client requests an appointment, HighLevel checks both your **Linked** and **Conflict** calendars. Any overlapping events render those slots **Unavailable**.
2. **Two-Way Sync**

   - If you enable **Write Back Appointments**, HighLevel will write new bookings into your external calendar.
   - Cancellations or reschedules in HighLevel also update your external calendar.
   - **Status-only updates:** Marking an appointment as Showed or No Show\*\* does not push an update to the external calendar. This prevents third-party “event updated” emails while keeping status tracking inside HighLevel.
   - **Reliability after changes:**If your integration is reconnected, updated, or switched to a different calendar, HighLevel automatically syncs upcoming appointments so your external calendar stays accurate without manual edits.
3. **Calendar View**

   - In the **Calendar** tab, external events display as shaded blocks, High-Level bookings as colored events, and blocked slots as **Unavailable** marking.

---

## **Best Practices & Considerations**

- **Limit Write-Back**: Enable write-back on only your primary work calendar to avoid duplicate entries.
- **Block Personal Events**: Link personal calendars as **Conflict Calendars** so family or personal commitments auto-block booking slots.
- **Align Time Zones**: Ensure your external calendar’s time zone matches your HighLevel profile to prevent mismatches.
- **Periodic Reauthorization**: If you change your external account password or security settings, reauthorize HighLevel to prevent broken integrations.

---

## **Common Troubleshooting**

| Issue | Cause | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Integration shows as broken (red banner)** | OAuth token expired or revoked | Under **Settings → Calendars → Connections**, click **Reconnect** and re-authorize. |
| **Events not appearing in HighLevel** | No Linked Calendar selected or sync disabled | In **Calendar Configuration → Linked Calendar**, click **Edit**, ensure **Sync Events** is on. |
| **Slots are still bookable during external events** | Conflict Calendar is not enabled | Under **Conflict Calendars**, click **Edit**, toggle **Use as Conflict Calendar**, then **Save**. |
| **High-level appointments are not writing back** | Write-Back toggle is off | Edit your Linked Calendar settings to enable **Write Back Appointments**, then **save**. |
| **Duplicate external events** | Multiple calendars have write-back enabled | Disable write-back on secondary calendars or unlink extras you don’t need. |

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Calendar Scheduling Conflicts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003548-calendar-scheduling-conflicts)
- [Round Robin Calendars: The Setup Guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001485-round-robin-calendars-the-setup-guide)
- [How to Re-Integrate Google Calendar with HighLevel for a User](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001181302-how-to-re-integrate-google-calendar-with-highlevel-for-a-user)

title_en: How to Test Outbound Conversations in Conversation AI
source_md:
Test your Conversation AI agent before going live with the enhanced Test Your Agent experience in HighLevel. You can now simulate outbound conversations, preview personalized opening messages, and test how your agent responds to leads without sending actual messages. Additional improvements include channel-specific rich element previews and a redesigned Deploy tab for managing agent activation and configuration.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Test Your Agent?](#What-is-Test-Your-Agent?)
- [Outbound Testing in Test Your Agent](#Outbound-Testing-in-Test-Your-Agent)
  - [Outbound Test Setup Options](#Outbound-Test-Setup-Options)
  - [Test Values and Message Personalization](#Test-Values-and-Message-Personalization)
- [Rich Elements and Channel Previews](#Rich-Elements-and-Channel-Previews)
- [Redesigned Deploy Tab](#Redesigned-Deploy-Tab)
- [How to Test Your Conversation AI Agent](#How-to-Test-Your-Conversation-AI-Agent)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Test Your Agent?**

[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/jMOKtmQZfZIPZxkv0Wh7)

Test Your Agent is a built-in Conversation AI testing tool that lets you simulate customer interactions before deploying your agent. With outbound testing, you can select a trigger and test contact to preview how an agent-initiated conversation begins, then respond as the lead to evaluate the conversation. The enhanced experience also supports interactive message previews across different communication channels.

The latest improvements include:

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Outbound Testing | Simulate agent-initiated conversations using triggers, test contacts, and personalized opening messages. |
| Rich Element Previews | Test buttons, quick replies, lists, images, and files as they appear on supported messaging channels. |
| Redesigned Deploy Tab | Manage inbound channels, outbound activation, triggers, and working hours from one location. |

```
Important: Test messages are simulated and are not sent to actual contacts.
```

---

## **Outbound Testing in Test Your Agent**

Outbound testing lets you simulate how your agent starts a conversation after a configured trigger, such as a new lead submission. Instead of waiting for an actual event, you can select a trigger, choose a test contact, and preview the opening message using that contact's details. You can then continue the conversation as the lead to verify the agent's responses.

### **Outbound Test Setup Options**

The Outbound test setup allows you to configure the information used to initiate the simulated conversation. These settings help you validate the opening message and its personalization before the agent communicates with real leads.

| Setting | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Trigger | Select the event that initiates the simulated outbound conversation. |
| Test Contact | Choose a contact whose details will be used to personalize the opening message. |
| Test Values | Optionally override contact information with custom values for the simulation. |
| Opening Message | Preview the first message your agent will send using the selected contact and test values. |

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106314/original/ZhpXIT8WXRe-OcujjGz8935rY3vNSZy0FQ.png?1792810171)

### **Test Values and Message Personalization**

Test values let you verify how your agent personalizes outbound messages without modifying the selected contact's saved information. When you enter a test value, it takes precedence over the corresponding contact value. If you leave it empty, the system uses the contact's existing information.

For example, an outbound opening message might use:

- {{contact.first\_name}} — Sushil
- {{contact.property\_type}} — Residential
- {{contact.budget\_range}} — 150k–200k

Example opening message:

"Hi Sushil, I'm Maya from Cedar & Key Realty. Are you still looking for a residential property in Austin with a budget of 150k–200k? I can help you explore available options."

Once the test begins, you can reply as the lead and evaluate how the agent continues the conversation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106323/original/7Q1V-zyfDOqYjYoGu8YWmowr_ZcDD176Mg.png?1792810222)

---

## **Rich Elements and Channel Previews**

The enhanced Test Your Agent experience also lets you preview how interactive messages appear across supported communication channels. Since each channel displays messages differently, selecting a channel under Preview as helps you verify how customers will interact with buttons, quick replies, lists, images, and files.

| Channel | Preview Experience |
| --- | --- |
| Live Chat | Interactive buttons |
| Instagram | Quick replies |
| Facebook | Quick replies |
| WhatsApp | Quick replies and selectable lists |
| Supported Media | Image previews and file attachments, including PDFs |

You can select an interactive response or type a custom message to test how the agent continues the conversation.

For example, if an agent asks whether a customer wants to Buy, Rent, or Sell a property, you can select Rent and verify that the agent follows the appropriate conversation path.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106358/original/wiF3Pevm-0S2FBFAnKzVHmVki67u99LOHA.png?1792810420)

WhatsApp list previews also let you select options from a structured list, such as available neighborhoods or service categories.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106359/original/SNkByoxufZGncdOCb_4nQAn3_rzkgSankg.png?1792810447)

Images appear as previews within the conversation, while supported documents such as PDFs appear as file attachments.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106363/original/RoZvdWjDIMryX-jWNxA1818W9igJhLeltA.png?1792810466)

```
Note: Available rich elements and their appearance depend on the selected channel and agent configuration.
```

---

## **Redesigned Deploy Tab**

The redesigned Deploy tab provides a centralized place to configure how your agent communicates after testing is complete. You can manage inbound channels, outbound activation, triggers, and working hours without navigating between separate configuration areas.

| Setting | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| Inbound Channels | Manage where the agent responds to incoming customer messages. |
| Outbound Channels & Activation | Configure channels for agent-initiated conversations. |
| Triggers | Define events that initiate outbound conversations. |
| Working Hours | Configure when the agent can respond on selected channels. |

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106372/original/lC3vZKv_BJkJaZEAohGFJzFraMfNPbtDqA.png?1792810535)

For more information, refer to [How to Manage Conversation AI Bot Channels and Routing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000008266?portalId=48000045315) and [Working Hours for Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008713-working-hours-for-conversation-ai).

---

## **How to Test Your Conversation AI Agent**

Simulate outbound conversations using a trigger and test contact to preview personalized messages and verify your agent's responses before going live.

1. Navigate to AI Agents > Conversation AI > Agents List and open your agent's Build tab.
2. In Test your agent, select Outbound under Starts with and choose a channel under Preview as.
3. Click Edit under Outbound test setup.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106735/original/ILSqKqRd9SfOGr1xS4h3q_Kpv1QjecsYLw.png?1792811866)
4. Select a Trigger and Test contact, then add optional Test values.
5. Review the Opening message preview and click Save.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106496/original/dNBRsGYUgSoB5pv7k9vcU3LN3EzExk9wQA.png?1792811181)
6. Click **Test your agent**, then reply as the lead to evaluate the conversation. Repeat with different test values or responses to test additional scenarios.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106517/original/DbUTaQ8XsEBMeP24hBxxlu5EWdFYBCbgVQ.gif?1792811284)
7. Once satisfied, open **Deploy** to review inbound channels, outbound activation, triggers, and working hours before going live.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084106532/original/rJ_bAYmYLJF9IrouRXWW7aqoFrsC0rkqng.png?1792811302)

```
Tip: To test rich elements, select Inbound under Starts with, choose a channel, and interact with buttons, quick replies, or lists.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does outbound testing send messages to the selected test contact?**

No. Outbound testing simulates the conversation without sending actual messages to the selected contact or other real customers.

**Q: What happens if I leave a test value empty?**

The simulation uses the corresponding information saved in the selected test contact.

**Q: Why is my outbound opening message showing incorrect or missing contact information?**

Check the selected test contact and any values entered under Test values. Entered test values override the contact's saved information, while empty fields use the corresponding contact values. Make sure the required information is available before starting the test.

**Q: Why isn't my agent initiating outbound conversations after I enable outbound?**

Verify that the appropriate outbound channel is activated and a trigger is configured in the Deploy tab. Outbound activation alone may not initiate trigger-based conversations.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Manage Conversation AI Bot Channels and Routing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/a/solutions/articles/155000008266?portalId=48000045315)
- [Test & Optimize Conversations AI Agents with Prompt Optimizer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008435-test-optimize-conversations-ai-agents-with-prompt-optimizer)
- [How to Optimize Conversations AI Prompts from a Trial Chat](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009286-how-to-optimize-conversations-ai-prompts-from-a-trial-chat)
- [Customize Conversation AI Agent Responses with Prompts and Instructions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002255-customize-conversation-ai-agent-responses-with-prompts-and-instructions)
- [Working Hours for Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008713-working-hours-for-conversation-ai)
- [Conversation AI Bot Explained](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001335)

title_en: How to Use the Printful Integration with HighLevel
source_md:
E-Commerce Integration

# How to Use the Printful Integration with HighLevel

Connect your Printful account to HighLevel and start selling custom print-on-demand products directly through your e-commerce store with automated order fulfillment.

What You'll Learn

This guide walks you through setting up the Printful integration in HighLevel, syncing your print-on-demand products to your e-commerce store, and automating order fulfillment.

You'll learn how to install the Printful app, import product templates, manage variants and pricing, and handle customer data and order synchronization.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/ffv4rMY1VXE?&t=328s&wmode=opaque)

## What is the Printful Integration?

The Printful integration allows you to connect your Printful print-on-demand account directly with HighLevel's e-commerce platform. Printful is a Drop Shipping company that handles printing and fulfillment of custom apparel, accessories, and other products featuring your own designs and logos.

This integration enables you to sell Printful products through your HighLevel website or funnel without manually managing inventory, order processing, or shipping. When customers purchase products from your HighLevel store, orders automatically sync to Printful for fulfillment.

The integration is available through HighLevel's Integrations section and can also be discovered in the HighLevel Marketplace at marketplace.gohighlevel.com, where you can explore apps from external developers and private companies.

## Key Benefits of Printful Integration

**Automated Product Sync** — Products you create or import in Printful automatically appear in your HighLevel store with titles, images, variants, and pricing intact.

**Seamless Order Fulfillment** — When customers purchase products through your HighLevel store, orders sync directly to Printful for automatic fulfillment based on your Printful subscription settings.

**Customer Data Integration** — Shipping addresses, email notifications, and customer information flow into your HighLevel CRM so you can manage everything from one platform.

**Use Existing Product Templates** — Import product templates from existing Printful stores so you don't have to recreate designs or variants from scratch.

**Workflow Automation Support** — Trigger HighLevel workflows based on order submissions for review requests, shipping updates, team notifications, and more.

**Opportunities Pipeline Integration** — Track orders through custom pipelines with stages like "Order Placed" and "Order Fulfilled" for team coordination and follow-up.

## How to Install the Printful Integration

Follow these steps to connect your Printful account to your HighLevel sub-account:

Step 1

Navigate to Integrations in HighLevel

In your HighLevel sub-account, go to **Settings** > **Integrations**. Scroll to locate the **Printful** option or search for it.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/CdBw3F193rGaKC6WBtvg+/GIF+Recording+2026-08-03+at+19.46.21.gif)

Step 2

Install the Printful App

Click **Manage**, then click **Install**. Review the permissions the app is requesting for your sub-account and click **Allow and Install**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/PEdTmeGn8gxCWsy20e3Q+/GIF+Recording+2026-08-03+at+19.47.18.gif)

Step 3

Authorize Access in Printful

You'll be redirected to printful.com. **Login** to your **Printful** account or **Sign** **up** and **create** a **new** **account**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/KnC6xST4tR4XbchKKPAl+/Screen+Shot+2026-08-03+at+19.52.45.png)

Step 4

Create or Select a Printful Store

Choose whether to **create** a **new****Printful** **store** or **connect** an **existing** store then click **Accept**. Your HighLevel account will now have access to Printful, and a new store named "Lead Connector" will be created in Printful.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/OUKUXllswSr6SoTf5Kf4+/Screen+Shot+2026-08-03+at+19.57.41.png)

## How to Add Products to Your HighLevel Store

Once the integration is active, you can add Printful products that will automatically sync to your HighLevel product catalog:

Step 1

Access Your Lead Connector Store in Printful

In Printful, go to the **Stores** section in the left sidebar. You'll see your new **Lead Connector** store listed. Click on the **three** **dots** and then on **View** **Products** for this specific HighLevel integration.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/QWlYQTmPAHCtkE02k45w+/GIF+Recording+2026-08-03+at+20.03.36.gif)

Step 2

Add Products to the Store

Click **Add Product**, then select **Create New Products** to design a product from scratch using Printful’s catalog of apparel, accessories, home goods, and more.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/P5XeRZ3sgFJ0zf6XHVQb+/GIF+Recording+2026-08-03+at+20.07.52.gif)

Step 3

Configure Mockups and Product Details

After selecting a product or template, proceed through Printful's product setup flow. You'll generate mockup images, and configure variants (sizes, colors, etc.). Once done, click on **Save Template**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/LtA6mOZ6parC18qc1nIn+/GIF+Recording+2026-08-03+at+20.39.35.gif)

Step 4

Publish the Product

Choose **mockup** **images** to **display**, **pricing** and **product** **name** then click on **Publish**.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/D2p1OwhuIJtNpNdNp4b8+/GIF+Recording+2026-08-03+at+20.46.04.gif)

Success

Your product is now synced between Printful and HighLevel. Any changes you make to titles, pricing, or variants in Printful will automatically update in HighLevel.

## Managing Product Sync and Pricing

Once products are added in Printful, they automatically appear in your HighLevel product catalog with most details intact:

Viewing Synced Products

Check Your HighLevel Products

In HighLevel, navigate to **Payments** > **Products**. You'll see your Printful product(s) listed with the same names, images, variants, and pricing you configured in Printful.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/W0bgLRrhl0GpBii9NVWL+/GIF+Recording+2026-08-03+at+21.06.10.gif)

Editing Products in HighLevel

Make Adjustments as Needed

Click the three dots next to any product and select **Edit**. You can modify details just like any other HighLevel product. Note that product descriptions do not currently sync from Printful, so you'll need to add those manually in HighLevel.

To make a product available on your HighLevel e-commerce site, toggle on **Include in Online Store** in the product settings. This ensures the product appears on your live storefront.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/O1ElAPIg2ZXKsEXt1W4g+/GIF+Recording+2026-08-03+at+21.12.35.gif)

Important

Product descriptions are not synced from Printful. You must manually add descriptions in HighLevel's product editor before publishing to your store.

The following product data syncs automatically from Printful to HighLevel:

- Product titles
- Product images and mockups
- Variants (sizes, colors, etc.)
- Pricing for each variant

Seamless E-Commerce

Sell Custom Products Without Managing Inventory

The Printful integration handles production, shipping, and fulfillment so you can focus on marketing and customer relationships.

## Order Fulfillment and Customer Data Sync

One of the most powerful aspects of this integration is automated order fulfillment and customer data synchronization:

Automatic Order Sync

Orders Flow to Printful for Fulfillment

When a customer purchases a Printful product from your HighLevel store, the order automatically syncs to your Printful account. Depending on your Printful subscription settings, orders may be fulfilled automatically or require manual approval before production begins.

Customer Data Import

Shipping and Contact Information Sync to HighLevel

Customer information such as shipping addresses and email addresses is imported into your HighLevel CRM. This allows you to manage customer relationships, send follow-up communications, and track order history directly within HighLevel.

Viewing Orders in Printful

Monitor Fulfillment Status

All synced orders appear in your Printful dashboard under the Lead Connector store. You can view order details, fulfillment status, and shipping tracking information from within Printful.

Pro Tip

Check your Printful subscription plan to understand whether orders are fulfilled automatically or require manual confirmation. This ensures you maintain control over quality and timing.

## Shipping Profiles and Live Rates at Checkout

To enable live shipping rates for Printful products at checkout, the system automatically manages a dedicated Printful shipping profile.

What to Expect:

- A system-generated Printful shipping profile is created and configured automatically.
- For existing installations, syncing or updating Printful products can activate the shipping profile and start showing live rates at checkout.
- Products must stay assigned to the Printful shipping profile. Removing them disables live rate calculation for those products.
- If the Printful shipping profile is deleted, it is not recreated automatically. Reinstall the Printful integration to restore it.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/VrBbN5UhtUgZMm1SR90g+/Screen+Shot+2026-08-03+at+21.15.35.png)

Note

Live shipping rates are calculated based on customer location and product specifications. Ensure your Printful products remain assigned to the correct shipping profile to maintain accurate checkout pricing.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do I need an existing Printful account to use this integration?

Yes, you need a Printful account to use this integration. If you don't have one, you can create a free account at printful.com before installing the integration in HighLevel.

Q: Can I use products from multiple Printful stores in one HighLevel account?

The integration creates a dedicated "Lead Connector" store in Printful that syncs with your HighLevel sub-account. While you can import templates from other Printful stores, active sync only occurs between the Lead Connector store and HighLevel.

Q: What product information syncs from Printful to HighLevel?

Product titles, images, variants (sizes, colors), and pricing sync automatically. Product descriptions do NOT sync and must be added manually in HighLevel's product editor.

Q: Are orders automatically fulfilled by Printful?

It depends on your Printful subscription and account settings. Some plans support automatic fulfillment, while others require manual approval before production begins. Check your Printful settings to confirm your fulfillment workflow.

Q: Can I edit product details after they sync to HighLevel?

Yes, you can edit products in HighLevel just like any other product. However, changes made in Printful (titles, pricing, variants) will sync back to HighLevel and may overwrite your edits. For best results, manage titles and pricing in Printful, and use HighLevel for descriptions and store-specific settings.

title_en: Events and Workflows Integration
source_md:
Events and Workflows Integration connects HighLevel Events with workflow automation to manage registrations, reminders, check-ins, and follow-ups. Automatically register contacts for ticketed or RSVP events, trigger workflows based on attendee activity, and create personalized event journeys without manual effort.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Events and Workflows Integration?](#What-is-Events-and-Workflows-Integration?)
- [Key Benefits of Events and Workflows Integration](#Key-Benefits-of-Events-and-Workflows-Integration)
- [Event-Based Workflow Triggers](#Event-Based-Workflow-Triggers)
- [Register for Ticketed Event Action](#Register-for-Ticketed-Event-Action)
- [Register for RSVP Event Action](#Register-for-RSVP-Event-Action)
- [Using Event Data in Workflow Conditions](#Using-Event-Data-in-Workflow-Conditions)
- [Wait Relative to the Event Date](#Wait-Relative-to-the-Event-Date)
- [How to Set Up Events and Workflows Integration](#How-to-Set-Up-Events-and-Workflows-Integration)
- [Common Event Automation Use Cases](#Common-Event-Automation-Use-Cases)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Events and Workflows Integration?**

Events and Workflows Integration allows you to automate the entire attendee journey, from registration to post-event engagement. You can trigger workflows when contacts register or check in, automatically enroll contacts in events through workflow actions, and use event details to personalize communication.

---

## **Key Benefits of Events and Workflows Integration**

Connecting Events with Workflows helps businesses streamline event management and improve attendee engagement.

- **Automated Registrations:** Register contacts for ticketed or RSVP events through workflows.
- **Instant Engagement:** Send confirmation emails, SMS reminders, and follow-ups automatically.
- **Lead Conversion:** Turn leads from forms, funnels, and Facebook Ads into event registrants.
- **Personalized Journeys:** Customize workflows using event details, ticket types, and attendee activity.
- **Event-Based Timing:** Schedule reminders before, during, or after an event.
- **CRM Integration:** Create opportunities, assign tasks, and notify team members based on event activity.

---

## **Event-Based Workflow Triggers**

Event-based triggers automatically start workflows when attendees register or check in. These triggers help you deliver relevant communications based on customer activity.

**Event Registration**

Starts a workflow when a contact registers for an event. Use it to send confirmations, add tags, notify team members, or initiate reminder sequences.

**Event Checked In**

Starts a workflow when an attendee checks in. Use it to send welcome messages, provide resources, or begin follow-up campaigns.

**Trigger Filters**

You can customize event-based workflows using filters such as:

- Specific event
- Registration status
- Ticket type
- Who booked the registration
- Check-in details

---

## **Register for Ticketed Event Action**

The Register for Ticketed Event action allows you to automatically register contacts for ticketed events through workflows. This helps connect your existing lead-generation campaigns with event registrations.

**Common use cases:**

- Register leads captured through Facebook Lead Ads.
- Enroll qualified prospects in workshops or webinars.
- Convert funnel submissions into event registrations.

**Example Workflow:**

Facebook Lead Ad → Register for Ticketed Event → Send Confirmation Email

```
Note: Ticketed events may offer free or paid tickets. Confirm payment, ticket availability, and capacity behavior before using automated registration for paid events.
```

---

## **Register for RSVP Event Action**

The Register for RSVP Event action automatically registers contacts for RSVP events when they reach the action in a workflow.

This is useful for webinars, onboarding sessions, workshops, and other events that don't require ticket payments.

**Common use cases:**

- RSVP contacts captured through forms or landing pages.
- Register customers for onboarding sessions.
- Create automated invitation and registration journeys.

**E****xample Workflow:**

Form Submission → Register for RSVP Event → Send Reminder Email

---

## **Using Event Data in Workflow Conditions**

Event data allows workflows to follow different paths based on attendee information. This helps you deliver personalized experiences without creating separate workflows for every audience. Available event information includes:

- Event type and name
- Start and end dates
- Time zone and location
- Ticket information
- Check-in information

For example, you can use an If/Else condition to send exclusive content to VIP attendees while sending standard reminders to other registrants.

---

## **Wait Relative to the Event Date**

Event-relative Wait actions help you schedule communications around an event's actual date rather than manually calculating reminder times. Three timing options are available:

- **Before the Event:** Send reminders a specified number of days or hours before the event.
- **At the Event Date/Time:** Send day-of instructions or welcome messages.
- **After the Event:** Send thank-you emails, surveys, or follow-up offers.

**Example Workflow:**

Event Registration → Confirmation Email → Wait Until 1 Day Before Event → Send SMS Reminder

---

## **How to Set Up Events and Workflows Integration**

Configuring event-based workflows allows you to automate registrations and deliver timely communications based on attendee activity.

**Set Up an Event Registration or Check-In Trigger**

1. Navigate to **Automation → Workflows**.
2. Create a new workflow or open an existing one.
3. Click **Add Trigger** and select **Event Registration** or **Event Checked In**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083951452/original/aMeW4PhDMdffkmyew0TTrfPwmYVtCszLsA.png?1792665248)
4. Configure event filters as needed.
5. Add actions such as **Send Email**, **Send SMS**, or **Add Tag**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083951687/original/tl5VoipPwBqeL940j6Mi9ktJF9dwqdn3Fg.png?1792665350)
6. Configure conditions or event-relative Wait actions if needed.
7. Test and publish the workflow.

**Set Up the Register for Ticketed Event Action**

1. Navigate to **Automation → Workflows**.
2. Create or open a workflow and configure its trigger.
3. Click the **+** icon to add an action.
4. Select **Register for Ticketed Event**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083952382/original/ER3g1MYpma2z2B1Corbjvb3Zpx5G19QqQg.png?1792665705)
5. Select the target event and complete the available registration settings.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083952411/original/avROtCeOnlhS4fk1S6LkHnfiLcMolCDV9w.png?1792665730)
6. Save the action and test the registration.
7. Publish the workflow once verified.

**Set Up the Register for RSVP Event Action**

1. Open a workflow and configure its trigger.
2. Click the **+** icon and select **Register for RSVP Event**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083952525/original/peLq4yqdXn_4wIKMUcH5ep25GyZNU5ubfA.png?1792665768)
3. Select the RSVP event and complete the available settings.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083952595/original/o_RKGiV-CcyTKgqoV12m21QCwXAjjl7wMw.png?1792665798)
4. Save the action.
5. Test with a contact and verify the registration in Events.
6. Publish the workflow.

```
Important: Test duplicate registrations, attendee capacity, required contact information, and payment behavior where applicable before enabling live registration workflows.
```

---

## **Common Event Automation Use Cases**

Event automation connects lead generation, attendee management, and follow-up activities into a single process.

- **Lead Registration:** Facebook Lead Ad → Register for Ticketed Event → Confirmation Email
- **RSVP Automation:** Form Submission → Register for RSVP Event → Reminder Sequence
- **Attendee Engagement:** Event Registration → Add Tag → Send SMS
- **Sales Follow-Up:** Event Registration → Create Opportunity → Notify Sales Team
- **Check-In Engagement:** Event Checked In → Send Welcome Message
- **Post-Event Follow-Up:** Event Registration → Wait Until After Event → Send Survey

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I automatically register contacts for events?**

Yes. Use the Register for Ticketed Event or Register for RSVP Event workflow action.

**Q: Can I use one workflow for multiple events?**

Yes. Event-based triggers and conditions can use event information to customize how contacts move through a workflow.

**Q: Can I send reminders based on an event's date?**

Yes. Event-relative Wait actions can schedule communications before, at, or after an event.

**Q: Can I create different workflows for different ticket types?**

Yes. Use event filters or conditional branches to personalize communication based on ticket information.

**Q: Can I register leads from Facebook Ads or forms?**

Yes. You can connect lead-generation triggers to the appropriate event registration action.

**Q: Can I automate follow-ups after attendees check in?**

Yes. The Event Checked In trigger can initiate follow-up workflows based on attendee check-in activity.

**Q: Can I automatically register contacts for paid events?**

The Register for Ticketed Event action supports ticketed-event registrations. Verify payment handling before using it with paid tickets.

**Q: Will a workflow-created registration trigger an Event Registration workflow?**

This behavior should be verified before connecting automated registration and event-triggered workflows.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Events – How to Manually Add Attendees](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008421-events-how-to-manually-add-attendees)
