title_en: Imported Snapshots: Load Modal and History Tracking
source_md:
Snapshot Management

# Load Imported Snapshots into Existing Sub-Accounts

Load shared snapshots directly into your sub-accounts, track deployment history, and manage snapshot restrictions — all from the Imported Snapshots tab.

What You'll Learn

HighLevel has enhanced the Imported Snapshots experience to give you centralized control over loading snapshots into your existing sub-accounts. You can load snapshots directly from the Imported Snapshots tab without navigating into individual sub-accounts first.

This article explains how to use the new Load modal, view complete snapshot deployment history, and understand snapshot restrictions when working with shared snapshots.

## What is the Imported Snapshots Load Feature?

The Imported Snapshots Load feature is an enhanced snapshot management capability that allows you to load shared snapshots directly into your existing sub-accounts from a centralized location. When another agency shares a snapshot with you, you can deploy that snapshot's assets and configurations into any of your sub-accounts without needing to navigate into each sub-account individually.

This feature introduces a new Load modal that appears in the Imported Snapshots tab, giving you a streamlined workflow for snapshot deployment across your agency. Each snapshot also includes a View History tab that tracks every load operation, showing which sub-accounts received the snapshot and which specific assets were deployed.

For agencies that share snapshots with restrictions, the Load feature respects those limitations by only allowing loads into the sub-accounts specified by the sharing agency.

## Key Benefits

The enhanced Imported Snapshots experience delivers significant time savings and operational visibility for agencies managing multiple sub-accounts.

**Centralized Snapshot Loading** — Deploy imported snapshots into any existing sub-account directly from the Imported Snapshots tab without navigating into individual sub-accounts first.

**Complete Deployment Tracking** — View the full load history for every imported snapshot, including which sub-accounts received it and which assets were deployed in each load.

**Faster Workflow** — Eliminate the need to switch between sub-accounts when deploying the same snapshot to multiple locations in your agency.

**Transparency and Accountability** — Instantly identify which sub-accounts have received a particular snapshot configuration, making it easier to manage standardized setups across your agency.

**Controlled Access** — When snapshots are shared with restrictions, you can only load them into the sub-accounts approved by the sharing agency, ensuring proper usage and compliance.

## What's Included in This Update

This enhancement introduces three major components that transform how you work with imported snapshots.

Component 1

Load Modal for Imported Snapshots

A new Load modal appears on every snapshot in your Imported Snapshots tab. This modal allows you to select any existing sub-account in your agency and load the snapshot directly into it. You no longer need to open the sub-account separately before deploying the snapshot.

Component 2

View History Tab

Every imported snapshot includes a View History tab that displays the complete load trail. You can see every past load operation, which sub-accounts were included in each load, and the specific assets that were deployed to each sub-account. This provides full transparency and makes it easy to audit snapshot deployments across your agency.

Component 3

Shared Snapshot Restrictions

When an agency shares a snapshot with you and restricts it to specific sub-accounts, the Load modal respects those restrictions. You can only load the snapshot into the sub-accounts approved by the sharing agency. This ensures proper usage and prevents unauthorized deployment of restricted snapshot configurations.

## How to Load an Imported Snapshot

Follow these steps to load an imported snapshot into any existing sub-account from the Imported Snapshots tab.

Step 1

Navigate to the Imported Snapshots Tab

Go to your agency settings and open the Imported Snapshots tab. You will see a list of all snapshots that have been shared with your agency.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077329851/original/R1v8ctEiwjCCrDZATZgI3zyyKGdzFo6-Hw.png?1785495363)

Step 2

Select the Snapshot You Want to Load

Locate the imported snapshot you want to deploy and click the Load option.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077330200/original/QMLr0nHitv-AVzFerGD4Ej_8rLsPIQCJIA.png?1785495559)

Step 3

Choose Your Destination Sub-Accounts

The Load modal will appear with a list of your existing sub-accounts. Select the sub-account(s) where you want to load the snapshot.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077330541/original/7cQsHVM0_EFwz_QM9hCuA_TcXufaNGdq5g.png?1785495629)

If the snapshot has restrictions, only approved sub-accounts will be available for selection.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077330881/original/mQKhrvRnx-rMeLHUzxZkUhNOYwBGNtdv5A.png?1785495717)

Step 4

Complete the Load Process

After selecting your destination sub-accounts, confirm your selection and proceed with the load. The snapshot will be deployed to the selected sub-accounts. You can track the progress through the modal's status indicator.

Pro Tip

You can load the same snapshot into multiple sub-accounts in a single operation by selecting multiple destinations in the Load modal.

## How to View Snapshot Load History

The View History tab provides complete visibility into every load operation for an imported snapshot.

Step 1

Open the View History Tab

From the Imported Snapshots tab, locate the snapshot you want to review. Click the View History option or menu item associated with that snapshot.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077331322/original/49CW50iDFGMK6f5AM-viFSjp-bzY7iLXtg.png?1785495958)

Step 2

Review Past Load Operations

The View History tab displays a chronological list of every load operation performed with that snapshot, including timestamps and version information.

Step 3

Identify Target Sub-Accounts

For each load operation, you can see the complete list of sub-accounts that received the snapshot during that load.

Step 4

View Deployed Assets

Expand any load operation to see the specific assets that were deployed to each sub-account, giving you full transparency into what was included in each snapshot deployment.

## Understanding Shared Snapshot Restrictions

When an agency shares a snapshot with your agency, they can choose to restrict that snapshot to specific sub-accounts. This means you can only load the snapshot into the sub-accounts that the sharing agency has approved.

When you attempt to load a restricted snapshot, the Load modal will only display sub-accounts that are authorized for that snapshot. Other sub-accounts in your agency will be unavailable for selection.

This restriction mechanism ensures that snapshot configurations are deployed only to appropriate sub-accounts, maintaining control and compliance with the sharing agency's intended usage.

Important

If you need to load a restricted snapshot into a sub-account that is not currently authorized, you must contact the agency that shared the snapshot with you to request access for additional sub-accounts.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I load the same imported snapshot into multiple sub-accounts at once?

Yes. The Load modal allows you to select multiple destination sub-accounts in a single operation, making it easy to deploy the same snapshot configuration across multiple locations in your agency.

Q: What happens if I try to load a snapshot into a sub-account that already has some of the same assets?

HighLevel handles conflicts during the load process. The system typically provides options to overwrite existing assets or skip them. Future improvements to dependency handling will make conflict resolution even more seamless.

Q: How do I know which sub-accounts a snapshot has already been loaded into?

Open the View History tab for that snapshot. It displays every past load operation, including the complete list of sub-accounts that received the snapshot in each deployment.

Q: Can I see which specific assets were included in a previous snapshot load?

Yes. The View History tab provides a detailed breakdown of assets deployed to each sub-account for every load operation, giving you full transparency into snapshot deployment details.

Q: What does it mean when a snapshot is "limited to specific sub-accounts"?

This means the agency that shared the snapshot with you has restricted it to specific sub-accounts in your agency. You can only load the snapshot into those authorized sub-accounts. If you need access for additional sub-accounts, contact the sharing agency to request expanded permissions.

Q: Do I still need to navigate into a sub-account before loading an imported snapshot?

No. The new Load modal eliminates this requirement. You can load an imported snapshot directly from the Imported Snapshots tab into any existing sub-account without opening that sub-account separately first.

Q: Will there be future improvements to snapshot loading?

Yes. HighLevel continues to invest in snapshot lifecycle management improvements. Upcoming enhancements will focus on better dependency handling to prevent broken or missing assets at destination sub-accounts during the load process.

Q: How do I provide feedback on the new Load modal or View History tab?

HighLevel welcomes your feedback on these features. You can submit feedback through your HighLevel support channels or contact your account representative directly to share your experience and suggestions.

title_en: GPT Live 1 Speech-to-Speech Model for Voice AI
source_md:
GPT Live 1 brings full-duplex speech-to-speech conversations to HighLevel Voice AI. The model can listen while speaking, allowing callers to interrupt naturally without waiting for a strict turn-taking process.

GPT Live 1 also separates live conversation from deeper reasoning so tools and business logic can run in parallel. This guide explains how GPT Live 1 works, how to configure its Speech model and Reasoning model instructions, and how to test your agent before using it with live callers.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is GPT Live 1 for Voice AI?](#what-is-gpt-live-1)
- [Key Benefits of GPT Live 1](#key-benefits)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#prerequisites)
- [How GPT Live 1 Works](#how-it-works)
- [How to Set Up GPT Live 1 for Voice AI](#setup-gpt-live-1)
- [How to Test GPT Live 1](#test-gpt-live-1)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#faq)
- [Related Articles](#related-articles)

---

## **What Is GPT Live 1 for Voice AI?**

GPT Live 1 is a speech-to-speech model for HighLevel Voice AI agents. It supports full-duplex audio, allowing the model to listen and speak at the same time.

This allows callers to interrupt the agent naturally. The agent can stop or adapt while the conversation is happening instead of waiting for a traditional turn-ending signal.

GPT Live 1 also separates speech and reasoning responsibilities. The Speech model manages the live conversation, while the Reasoning model handles complex business logic, tools, and multi-step tasks.

---

## **Key Benefits of GPT Live 1**

GPT Live 1 separates real-time conversation from deeper processing so Voice AI agents can respond more naturally while handling complex requests.

- **Full-duplex conversations:** The agent can listen and speak at the same time.
- **Natural interruptions:** Callers can interrupt the agent while it is speaking, allowing the conversation to change direction naturally.
- **Parallel reasoning:** Complex tasks can be delegated to a backend reasoning model while the Speech model continues managing the conversation.
- **Less dead air:** Tool calls, bookings, lookups, workflows, and other delegated tasks can be processed while the live conversation continues.
- **Separate instructions:** Configure conversational behavior separately from complex business logic and tool rules.
- **Improved testing visibility:** Review conversation, delegation, and tool activity while testing the agent.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

Understanding how GPT Live 1 divides speech and reasoning helps you configure instructions correctly and test the agent before using it with callers.

Before configuring GPT Live 1:

- You need access to the applicable HighLevel sub-account.
- Your user must have permission to view and manage Voice AI agents.
- Configure any Voice AI actions required for your use case before relying on them during calls.
- Save and test your agent before deploying it to live callers.

Keep the following considerations in mind:

- GPT Live 1 uses separate Speech model and Reasoning model instructions.
- Complex tool and business-logic tasks can be delegated to the Reasoning model.
- Voice AI model availability and pricing can change. Review the latest HighLevel pricing and the information shown in your account before quoting costs.
- Features announced as future enhancements are not covered until they are available in the product.

---

## **How GPT Live 1 Works**

GPT Live 1 divides responsibility between a live Speech model and a backend Reasoning model. This allows the agent to maintain a natural conversation while more complex work is processed separately.

### **Speech Model**

The Speech model manages the live conversation with the caller.

Use **Speech model instructions** for:

- Persona
- Tone
- Conversational style
- Simple conversational instructions

These instructions should focus on how the agent communicates during the call.

### **Reasoning Model**

The Reasoning model handles tasks that require deeper processing.

Use **Reasoning model instructions** for:

- Complex business logic
- Tool rules
- Multi-step processes
- Conditions for business actions

When a caller requests something that requires additional work, the Speech model can delegate the task to the Reasoning model while continuing the conversation.

---

## **How to Set Up GPT Live 1 for Voice AI**

Select GPT Live 1 from the Voice AI agent builder, then configure the Speech model and Reasoning model instructions according to the responsibilities of each model.

### **Step 1:**Open Voice AI

1. From the **Sub-Account View**, select **AI Agents** from the left menu.
2. Select **Voice AI**.
3. Open the **Agent List**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082901616/original/djap35T5b84sn0i95xya1nM4ucSVSuY4Pw.png?1791516939)

### **Step 2:**Open or Create an Agent

To update an existing agent:

1. Locate the agent in **Agent List**.
2. Select the agent to open its configuration.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082901526/original/RbGtyaAtgNkcT9a_x1MqBwTHL5i8hyT4Vw.png?1791516469)

To create a new custom agent:

1. Click **+ Create Agent**.
2. Select **Create Custom Agent**.
3. Click **Continue**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082901537/original/N9UyG7He4CeU8ZttFj07kvORisXB6xNBMA.png?1791516535)

### **Step 3:**Select GPT Live 1

1. Locate the **Model** setting in the agent builder.
2. Open the model dropdown.
3. Select **GPT Live 1**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082901554/original/95sYCmCzEfqZl69lxKHV8B-UNl5DOt2IlA.png?1791516650)

### **Step 4:**Configure Speech Model Instructions

Enter the instructions that control how the agent communicates during the live conversation.

Focus on:

- Persona
- Tone
- Communication style
- Simple conversational behavior

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082901587/original/WZk52CE5IP9-N6nfjYnt7k4ZkrnWaIRKuw.png?1791516771)

### **Step 5:**Configure Reasoning Model Instructions

Enter the instructions that control complex business logic, tools, and multi-step behavior.

Define when the Reasoning model should apply business rules or use configured Voice AI actions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082901612/original/C8eNJXdnDQSLyaxN4BVb0n6wae0ZMbJfVw.png?1791516911)

### **Step 6:**Review and Save

Review the agent's remaining Voice AI settings and configured actions.

Click **Save** when the configuration is complete.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082901611/original/xlTwvf0Ue1I1dL6bWzUT-TkcuHA3NYXHFw.png?1791516892)

---

## **How to Test GPT Live 1**

Testing GPT Live 1 helps verify interruptions, conversational behavior, delegation, and configured actions before the agent handles live customer calls.

### **Step 1:**Start a Test

1. From the **Sub-Account View**, select **AI Agents**.
2. Select **Voice AI**.
3. Open the GPT Live 1 agent.
4. Locate the **Test Your Agent** panel.
5. Select **Web Call** or **Phone Call**.
6. Choose the applicable inbound or outbound scenario.
7. Start the test.

### **Step 2:**Test the Conversation

During the test:

- Speak naturally with the agent.
- Interrupt the agent while it is speaking.
- Change direction during the conversation.
- Test simple conversational requests.
- Test requests that require configured tools or business logic.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082901763/original/nkO_CEyKjfGTmNJ5yC7OT8xeWKqeRd2f-Q.png?1791517448)

### **Step 3:**Review Delegated Activity

Review the available transcript while testing the agent.

For requests that require additional work, review the available delegation and tool activity to confirm that the Reasoning model handles the task as expected.

### **Step 4:**Refine and Retest

1. Review the transcript and available call details.
2. Confirm the agent follows the **Speech model instructions**.
3. Confirm complex behavior follows the **Reasoning model instructions**.
4. Verify configured actions run under the expected conditions.
5. Update the applicable instructions or settings.
6. Save the agent.
7. Test again as needed.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082901767/original/ZAlqHECwTjdkYLiUIvQNnGgdQzHzNjKOgg.png?1791517509)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What makes GPT Live 1 different from turn-based speech-to-speech models?**

GPT Live 1 supports full-duplex audio, allowing the agent to listen and speak at the same time instead of waiting for a strict turn-ending signal.

**Q: Can a caller interrupt a GPT Live 1 agent while it is speaking?**

Yes. GPT Live 1 can respond to interruptions while the conversation is in progress.

**Q: Why does GPT Live 1 have two instruction areas?**

**Speech model instructions** control persona, tone, and conversational behavior. **Reasoning model instructions** control complex business logic, tool rules, and multi-step tasks.

**Q: Can GPT Live 1 use Voice AI tools and actions?**

Yes. Requests requiring configured tools or business logic can be delegated to the Reasoning model.

**Q: Can I test GPT Live 1 before using it for live calls?**

Yes. Use the **Test Your Agent** panel to run a Web Call or Phone Call and review the available transcript and call results.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Test Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004108)
- [Overview of Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003911)
- [Voice AI Agent Logs and Call Details](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007687)

---

title_en: Schedule your Youtube Shorts and Videos in Social Planner
source_md:
HighLevel Social Planner lets you create, schedule, and publish standard YouTube Videos and YouTube Shorts from the same workspace used for your other social channels. After connecting an eligible YouTube channel, you can upload video content, configure YouTube-specific settings, and choose when the post should publish. Social Planner also supports privacy settings, follow-up comments, and custom thumbnails for eligible standard YouTube Videos. This guide walks through the complete YouTube publishing workflow and current upload requirements.

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/KxB-eEo4TbQ?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is YouTube Publishing in Social Planner?](#What-is-YouTube-Publishing-in-Social-Planner?)
- [Key Benefits of YouTube Publishing](#Key-Benefits-of-YouTube-Publishing)
- [Prerequisites and Limitations](#Prerequisites-and-Limitations)
- [How To Set Up YouTube Publishing in Social Planner](#How-To-Set-Up-YouTube-Publishing-in-Social-Planner)
- [YouTube Video and Shorts Requirements](#YouTube-Video-and-Shorts-Requirements)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
    - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is YouTube Publishing in Social Planner?**

YouTube publishing in Social Planner lets you manage supported YouTube Videos and Shorts directly from HighLevel. After connecting your YouTube channel, you can upload a video, choose the appropriate post type, configure

YouTube-specific publishing options, and schedule the content without leaving Social Planner.

---

## **Key Benefits of YouTube Publishing**

Publishing YouTube content through Social Planner brings YouTube into the same workflow used to manage your other connected social channels.

- **Videos and Shorts**: Publish standard YouTube Videos or short-form YouTube Shorts from Social Planner.

- **Scheduled Publishing**: Choose when your YouTube content should publish instead of uploading it manually at publishing time.

- **YouTube-Specific Controls**: Configure the title, description, privacy level, video type, and other supported publishing options.

- **Centralized Social Management**: Manage YouTube alongside your other connected social accounts from one Social Planner workspace.

- **Follow-Up Comments**: Add a follow-up comment when needed as part of the YouTube publishing workflow.

---

## **Prerequisites and Limitations**

YouTube authorization depends on channel ownership, while publishing depends on meeting YouTube and Social Planner media requirements.

Before you begin:

- The Google account used during authorization must own the YouTube channel you want to connect.
- The **Primary Owner** of the YouTube channel must complete the connection to Social Planner.
- Users with only **Manager** or other delegated access cannot authorize the channel through the third-party integration.
- An active YouTube connection is required before content can be scheduled or published to the channel.
- YouTube Videos and Shorts uploaded through Social Planner can be up to **1 GB**.
- YouTube Shorts can be up to **3 minutes** long.
- A vertical **9:16** aspect ratio is recommended for Shorts.
- Custom thumbnails are supported for eligible standard YouTube Videos.
- Custom thumbnail uploads are not supported for YouTube Shorts through this workflow.
- YouTube thumbnails can be PNG or JPEG and up to **2 MB**.
- The YouTube connection does not have a fixed expiration period. It remains active until it is revoked, disconnected, or otherwise becomes invalid.

---

## **How To Set Up YouTube Publishing in Social Planner**

Connect the YouTube channel first, then use the Social Planner composer to configure and schedule the Video or Short.

### 

### **Step 1: Connect Your YouTube Channel**

Connecting the channel authorizes HighLevel to publish YouTube content on behalf of the channel.

1. From the HighLevel **Sub-Account**, go to **Marketing → Social Planner**.
2. Click the **Settings gear**.
3. Open **Social Accounts**.
4. Click **+ Connect Social**.
5. Select **YouTube** from the available social platforms.
6. Sign in with the Google account that owns the YouTube channel.
7. Approve the requested Google and YouTube permissions.
8. Select the YouTube channel you want to connect.
9. Complete the authorization process.
10. Confirm that the YouTube channel appears as a connected account in Social Planner.

```
Important: YouTube requires the channel's Primary Owner to authorize third-party connections. A user with only Manager access cannot complete this connection.
  
If you are unsure whether the selected Google account owns a YouTube channel, sign in to YouTube and review the channels associated with that Google account.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155085152409/original/cLVtGm3DV2aXbNyGz-TanxI593DiDibKpw.gif?1793977775)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155085153346/original/IF5CXlHAokefXTUoCP1CjwCig9cizykZVg.png?1793978260)

### **Step 2: Create a New YouTube Post**

The Social Planner composer lets you create YouTube content after the channel is connected.

1. Go to **Marketing → Social Planner**.
2. Click **+ New Post**.
3. Select **Create New Post**.
4. Select the connected YouTube channel you want to publish to.

### **Step 3: Add Your Video Content**

Add the video and supporting content that should appear with the YouTube post.

1. Upload your video to the post.
2. Enter the video description in the caption field.
3. Add any supported hashtags or emojis you want to include.
4. Confirm that the uploaded video does not exceed the **1 GB** Social Planner limit.

### **Step 4: Choose Video or Shorts**

Selecting the correct YouTube post type controls how Social Planner prepares the content for YouTube.

Choose one of the available options:

- **Video** for a standard YouTube Video.
- **Shorts** for a YouTube Short.

When **Shorts** is selected, HighLevel currently appends `#shorts` to the title by default.

### **Step 5: Add the YouTube Title**

YouTube requires a title before the Video or Short can be published.

Enter the title for your YouTube Video or Short in the title field.

### **Step 6: Choose the Privacy Level**

YouTube privacy controls determine who can view the Video or Short after it is published.

Select one of the supported privacy options:

- **Public**
- **Private**
- **Unlisted**

### **Step 7: Add a Follow-Up Comment**

A follow-up comment lets you add an additional comment as part of the supported Social Planner publishing flow.

Add a follow-up comment if needed before scheduling the post.

### 

### **Step 8: Schedule or Publish the Post**

Review the selected channel, video, title, description, privacy setting, and other YouTube options before publishing.

Choose the appropriate publishing option in Social Planner to publish the content immediately or schedule it for a later date and time.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155085153700/original/zuBltRJm-9gM7UYmrrqklN9Ofk_2LGG1Wg.png?1793978369)

---

## **YouTube Video and Shorts Requirements**

Reviewing the media requirements before publishing helps prevent failed uploads and unsupported thumbnail or Shorts configurations.

| Requirement | YouTube Video | YouTube Shorts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Maximum upload size | 1 GB | 1 GB |
| Maximum Shorts duration | — | 3 minutes |
| Recommended Shorts aspect ratio | — | 9:16 vertical |
| Custom thumbnail | Supported for eligible/verified users | Not supported through this workflow |
| Thumbnail format | PNG or JPEG | — |
| Maximum thumbnail size | 2 MB | — |
| Privacy options | Public, Private, Unlisted | Public, Private, Unlisted |

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### 

### **Q: Why can't a YouTube channel Manager connect the channel?**

YouTube requires the channel's **Primary Owner** to authorize third-party API connections such as Social Planner. Manager or other delegated access can be used within YouTube, but it cannot complete this external authorization.

### 

### **Q: Why isn't my YouTube channel appearing when I connect my Google account?**

Confirm that you signed in with the Google account that owns the YouTube channel. If the account does not have a YouTube channel, there will be no channel available for HighLevel to connect.

### 

### **Q: Does the YouTube connection expire automatically?**

The YouTube connection does not have a fixed expiration period. It remains active until authorization is revoked, the account is disconnected, or the connection otherwise becomes invalid.

### 

### **Q: Can I upload a custom thumbnail for a YouTube Short?**

No. Custom thumbnail uploads are not supported for YouTube Shorts through this Social Planner workflow. Custom thumbnails are supported for eligible standard YouTube Videos.

### **Q: Can I bulk schedule YouTube content?**

Yes. Social Planner's Advanced CSV scheduling supports YouTube-specific post settings, including supported fields for the YouTube title, privacy setting, and video type. Review the Advanced CSV guide before preparing bulk YouTube posts.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started - Setup Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005063)

- [Social Planner Content Guidelines - Image, Video, and Text](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001210585)

- [Advanced CSV Upload for Bulk Social Media Scheduling](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005542-social-planner-advanced-csv-for-bulk-scheduling)

- [Failed Post Error in Social Planner](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001218255)

- [How to Customize posts for each social?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000624-how-to-customise-post-for-each-socials-)

title_en: Email Actions for Company & Custom Object Workflows
source_md:
Workflow Automation

# Send Email Action in Company & Custom Object Workflows

Send automated emails directly from Company and Custom Object workflows to associated contacts without creating additional Contact workflows.

What You'll Learn

This article explains how to use the Send Email action in Company and Custom Object workflows, allowing you to automate email communications to associated contacts based on company or custom object events.

You'll learn how to configure the Send Email action, select recipients using association labels, and manage email delivery for your automated communications.

Labs Feature

Send Email Action in Company & Custom Object Workflows is a Labs feature. Enable it in Settings > Labs before use. Labs features are in active development and may receive updates based on user feedback.

## What Is the Send Email Action?

The Send Email action enables you to send automated emails directly from Company and Custom Object workflows in HighLevel. Previously, email actions were only available in Contact workflows, requiring you to create separate workflows or complex conversion steps to email contacts associated with companies or custom objects.

With this enhancement, you can automate email communication based on Company or Custom Object events without creating additional Contact workflows. When you add the Send Email action to a Company or Custom Object workflow, you select which associated contacts should receive the email using association labels and recipient selection options.

The system uses the relationships defined between your companies or custom objects and their associated contacts to deliver messages automatically when workflow triggers activate, streamlining your automation processes for non-contact record types.

## Popular Use Cases

Use the Send Email action to automate communications for various business scenarios:

**Customer onboarding** — Send welcome emails when a new Company or Custom Object record is created.

****Renewal reminders** — Automate reminders to insurance policy holders when their policies approach expiration.**

****Birthday greetings** — Send personalized birthday wishes to pet owners for their furry friends.**

****Property updates** — Send automated updates on listings and properties to real estate leads.**

**Internal approvals** — Send approval requests to associated support representatives or team members.

****Marketing follow-ups** — Send targeted follow-up marketing emails based on service records or patient history.**

## How to Set Up the Send Email Action

Follow these steps to configure the Send Email action in your Company or Custom Object workflows:

Step 1

Enable the Labs Feature

Navigate to Settings > Labs in your HighLevel account. Locate "Email Action in Company & Custom Object Workflows" and enable the feature.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077245088/original/zW0xIXt7qL2-7oGnzkEujxosvp6stktMlg.png?1785416058)

Step 2

Open Your Workflow

Create or open an existing Company or Custom Object workflow in the Automation section of your account.

Step 3

Add the Send Email Action

Click the + Add button in your workflow. In the Actions panel, locate the Communication section and select "Send email" from the available actions. You can also use the search bar to find it quickly by typing "Send email".

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077245335/original/aFQlf2w9cfxbghyNTCXvhsb_W2kudkpTow.png?1785416142)

Step 4

Configure Email Recipients

In the Email Recipients dropdown, select one of the following options under the Associations section:

- **All associated contacts** — Sends to all contacts associated with the company or custom object
- **Most recently associated contact** — Sends only to the most recently associated contact (Custom Object workflows only)
- **Earliest associated contact** — Sends only to the earliest associated contact (Custom Object workflows only)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077245534/original/sNetnWzLL6UejE84FaYgq7pum_otrDLa0Q.png?1785416185)

Step 5

Select Association Labels (Optional)

If you want to target specific types of associated contacts, use the Association Label field to select one or more association labels. This filters which contacts receive the email based on their relationship type. If you leave this field empty, the email sends based on your Email Recipients selection without filtering by association type.

```
Note: The Association Label option is currently supported only for Custom Object workflows. It is not available for Company workflows at this time. If you're using a Company workflow, this field will not be displayed.
```

Step 6

Configure Email Settings

Complete the email configuration fields:

- **From Name** — Enter the sender name for the email
- **From Email** — Enter the sender email address
- **Subject** — Add your email subject line
- **Cc/Bcc** — Add any Cc or Bcc recipients if needed

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077245636/original/qQ5R8EtbTeZa_Sv7iGfJwrLzOZOBH3a58A.png?1785416233)

Step 7

Create Your Email Content

Compose your email content using the email editor. You can include custom fields, personalization tokens, and formatting as needed.

**You can use personalization tokens from the associated Contact as well as the Company or Custom Object records, allowing you to dynamically personalize your email content.**

The editor supports the same features available in other workflow email actions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077245680/original/I31f4om-cIJeBCTBxnMK5mRm0PjW3Ki6iw.png?1785416257)

Step 8

Save and Publish

Click "Save action" to save your email configuration, then publish your workflow to activate the automation. When the workflow is triggered, emails will automatically be sent to the selected associated contacts.

Important Notes

Emails are sent using the Bulk Email sending domain configured for your account.

This email will be delivered based on the account's timezone setting.

If the From Name and From Email fields are empty, the email will be sent using the default values configured in your account settings.

If a contact matches multiple selected association labels, they receive only one email. Recipient deduplication is handled automatically to prevent duplicate email sends.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do I need to enable this feature in Labs before using it?

Yes, this capability is currently a Labs feature. Navigate to Settings > Labs and enable "Email Action in Company & Custom Object Workflows" before the Send Email action appears in your Company and Custom Object workflows.

Q: Where do I find the Send Email action in the workflow builder?

After clicking the + Add button in your workflow, the Send Email action appears under the Communication section in the Actions panel. You can also search for "Send email" using the search bar to locate it quickly.

Q: What's the difference between "All associated contacts" and using Association Labels?

When you select "All associated contacts" in the Email Recipients dropdown without specifying an Association Label, the email sends to every contact associated with the company or custom object. If you specify labels in the Association Label field, the email only sends to contacts matching those specific relationship types, allowing you to target specific subsets of associated contacts.

Q: What happens if a contact matches multiple selected association labels?

If a contact matches multiple association labels you've selected, they receive only one email. The system automatically prevents duplicate emails to the same contact through recipient deduplication, even when they qualify through multiple association paths.

Q: Can I choose which associated contact receives the email in Custom Object workflows?

Yes, when configuring the Send Email action in Custom Object workflows, you can select whether to send to the earliest associated contact, most recently associated contact, or all associated contacts in the Email Recipients dropdown under the Associations section. This flexibility allows you to target the most relevant recipient based on your business process.

Q: Does the Send Email action work the same way in Company workflows as it does in Custom Object workflows?

The core functionality is similar—both use the Association Label field to identify recipient contacts. The main difference is that Custom Object workflows provide additional recipient selection options in the Email Recipients dropdown (earliest, most recent, or all associated contacts), while Company workflows default to sending to all associated contacts matching the selected labels.

Q: Can I use personalization tokens in these emails?

Yes, you can use custom fields and personalization tokens when composing your email content. The email editor supports the same personalization features available in other workflow email actions, including contact fields, custom object fields, and system tokens.

Q: What if there are no contacts associated with the selected labels when the workflow runs?

If no contacts match the selected Association Label when the Send Email action executes, no email is sent. The workflow continues to any subsequent actions without errors, allowing your automation to handle scenarios where associations may not yet exist.

Q: Which sending domain is used for these emails?

Emails sent from Company and Custom Object workflows use the Bulk Email sending domain configured for your account. Ensure your bulk email domain is properly configured and verified to ensure successful email delivery.

title_en: Client Portal SSO Magic Links: Enable One-Click Access to Client Apps
source_md:
This article will guide you through how to create and use SSO (Single Sign-On) Magic Links to give clients instant, secure access to individual client portal apps—such as Courses, Communities, or Affiliates—without requiring login credentials. You’ll also learn how to embed these links as custom menu items in the client portal, control access visibility, and streamline navigation for a more professional client experience.

---

# **What Are SSO Magic Links?**

SSO Magic Links are unique, authenticated URLs that allow users to directly access a client portal app without entering login credentials. When a client clicks their personalized link, they’re instantly logged in and taken to the correct destination—whether it’s a course dashboard, community area, or affiliate portal.

These links are app-specific and contact-specific, meaning each user receives secure access to the exact portal experience they’ve been granted.

---

## **Key Benefits of SSO Magic Links**

SSO Magic Links are designed to reduce friction, save time, and increase client satisfaction. Key advantages include:

- **One-Click Login:** Instant access without entering a username or password.

- **Faster Onboarding:** Clients can get started with their app experience right away.

- **Fewer Support Tickets:** Eliminates login-related issues such as forgotten passwords.

- **Improved Navigation:** Offers a smoother, more direct login experience.

- **Multi-App Convenience:** Ideal for setups that include multiple apps like Courses + Communities + Affiliates.

- **Higher Engagement:** Easier access encourages repeat visits and ongoing interaction.

---

## **How to Generate and Use Magic Links**

Magic Links can be created from the Client Portal Dashboard and shared with contacts to provide direct access to specific apps.

### **Access the Sites Dashboard**

Navigate to the **Sites** tab from the left-hand menu to access your Client Portal Dashboard. This area allows you to manage your client-facing apps and create secure login experiences.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050728644/original/QwcVGFD8E9HS47bLH5NfFM_Q8M_2iarrwg.png?1753961509)

### **Open the Client Portal Section**

Within the Sites menu, click the **Client Portal** dropdown at the top and select **Dashboard**. This gives you access to client portal management tools like Magic Link generation and app settings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050728791/original/Cn3Kztkto9dJKAMAwRmhihuvouQy-fg6eA.png?1753961576)

### **Click “Generate” for Magic Link**

In the **Actions** panel, click the **Generate** button next to “Generate Magic Link.” This begins the process of creating a secure, one-click login for a specific contact and app.

```
Magic Links generated from the Client Portal expire after 15 minutes.

After you generate a Magic Link, a countdown timer shows the remaining time before the link expires. 

Once the current link expires, the Generate Magic Link button becomes available again so you can create a new link.
```

  

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050729026/original/7RdLEyS0IepSQCqkcIAesQXxtNWZbxNEDQ.png?1753961741)

### **Select Magic Link Type**

Choose **Custom Menu** to generate a reusable magic link intended for client portal navigation. This type of link is ideal for embedding directly in your portal’s sidebar.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050729114/original/RGZhCO315eahK9CuvUxUxDtq_a4R-kzBug.png?1753961860)

### **Select the App**

Use the dropdown under **Select App** to choose which client portal app the magic link should open—**Courses**, **Affiliates**, or **Communities**. This determines the destination when the link is used.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050729176/original/aiLwGjt_kEl898qQef_RT2IWNTZPIEWngQ.png?1753961925)

### **Generate the Magic Link**

Once you’ve selected the app, click the **Generate** button. This will instantly create a secure, one-click login URL that you can embed or share.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050729267/original/au6OxawdM0mQP0A4JztT_lqP5rWhywZ8jA.png?1753961997)

### **Copy the Magic Link**

Once the link is generated, click the **copy icon** to save it to your clipboard. You can now paste this secure SSO link wherever needed—such as in emails or custom menu items—for seamless client access.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050729400/original/wtBufc4AaGmWKi4-RSAZuiwv5rXWxrPUYA.png?1753962096)

---

## **How to Use Magic Links as Custom Menu Links**

You can embed Magic Links as **custom menu items** inside the client portal for quicker access.

To add a Magic Link as a menu item:

### **Switch to Agency View**

From the sub-account dashboard, click the dropdown beside the account name and select **Switch to Agency View**. This allows you to manage global settings like custom menu links for all sub-accounts.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050729573/original/I53tUsI43Rfc2aAhDAV7E0xPTKCJjsGNTA.png?1753962224)

### **Access Agency Settings**

Once you are in the Agency View, scroll to the bottom of the left-hand sidebar and click on **Settings**. This is where you can configure platform-wide preferences, including adding custom menu links.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050729712/original/Ib3m497jMk0ErzzdxpRTbkeuQL7uFAVOWQ.png?1753962303)

### **Navigate to Custom Menu Links**

In the **Settings** panel, scroll down and click on **Custom Menu Links**. This section displays all the existing menu links and is where you can manage or create new custom links for agency and sub-accounts.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050729770/original/ELclgWfbIwfzJREkp0sn_PEX1wPD45eQAA.png?1753962348)

### **Create a New Custom Link**

Click the **+ Create New** button in the top-right corner of the Custom Menu Links section to begin creating a new menu link.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050729905/original/8DQLlsuy97Bq7M99CoswTFmnP2JE1xa67g.png?1753962464)

### **Enter Link Details**

Fill in the required fields:

- **Link Icon**: Choose an icon identifier (e.g., vr-cardboard)
- **Link Title**: Name the menu item (e.g., “Test Link”)
- **URL**: Paste the full magic link generated previously.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050730145/original/piM2e1feZmZTFZEULHCiFh41q6bfKfAMjg.png?1753962675)

### **Choose Link Behavior**

Select how the link will open when clicked. You can display it inside the current window as an embedded iFrame, open it in a new tab, or load it in the same window.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050730280/original/_LgCu09DXrA4iiUykNgX9S05HBEMGKdZrQ.png?1753962777)

### **Set Sidebar Visibility**

Choose where the custom menu link will appear. You can display it in the Agency’s sidebar, the Sub-Account’s sidebar, or both for easier navigation across different user levels.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050730378/original/Ma9e_IcpAQK7K0zWOtuPS73yt9JGlSsYjQ.png?1753962848)

### **Select Sub-Accounts**

Assign the custom menu link to one or more sub-accounts. Only the selected accounts will display this link in their navigation sidebar.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050730522/original/ZTeeKMtDLvg0tkkjFuVFqHLPFgGdWyQ72w.png?1753962931)

### **Set Role-Based Visibility**

Choose who can access this custom menu link based on user roles. You can limit visibility to Admins, Users, or make it available to all users within the assigned sub-accounts.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050730664/original/QOrfQw-iCiso42qnsJOC6pFc4K53DbNM_w.png?1753963033)

### **Enable Permissions (Optional)**

You can grant microphone and camera access to the custom menu link if the embedded content requires these capabilities—ideal for video conferencing or recording tools.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050730751/original/OAb5ZI1qj9mWMSnECaG1Q4p-IBdSUuUHiQ.png?1753963110)

### **Save the Menu Link**

Once you’ve configured all options—such as the URL, sidebar visibility, selected accounts, role-based visibility, and any necessary permissions—click **Save** to finalize the custom menu link. This will add the Magic Link to the designated sidebar(s), making it easily accessible to users based on the rules you defined.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050730957/original/dJn2dDIJ31gpRR3O_Yci8ueDjFykuxWJFg.png?1753963266)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do Magic Links work for all client portal apps?**

They work with **Courses**, **Communities**, and **Affiliates**.

**Q: Are Magic Links secure?**

Yes. Each link is unique to the contact and app, providing only the necessary access.

**Q: Can I use Magic Links in automations or emails?**

Yes. You can insert the link in automated messages, onboarding emails, or custom buttons.

**Q: Do users need to be logged into the portal first?**

No. Clicking the Magic Link logs them in and redirects them automatically.

**Q: Can I regenerate a Magic Link?**

Yes. Simply repeat the generation process to create a new link.

title_en: Chat Widget Spam Protection — Automatic Bot Detection
source_md:
Chat Widget

# Chat Widget Spam Protection

Automatically detect and tag spam and bot submissions from your chat widget forms — without adding CAPTCHA or delaying genuine visitors.

What You'll Learn

Chat widget forms can receive high volumes of fake or bot-generated submissions that waste messaging spend and damage your sender reputation. Spam Protection automatically flags suspicious leads, pauses outbound messaging on those contacts, and tags them for review — all without disrupting the experience for legitimate visitors.

This guide explains how the feature works, how to enable it for your chat widgets, and how to review flagged leads so you retain control over which contacts are genuine.

## What is Chat Widget Spam Protection?

Chat Widget Spam Protection automatically detects and tags submissions that exhibit patterns consistent with bot or spam behavior. When a lead is flagged as suspicious, HighLevel pauses outbound messaging on the channels you choose — preventing wasted SMS credits and protecting your email sender reputation — while still creating the contact record and tagging it for your review.

The feature operates server-side without adding CAPTCHA, extra form fields, or visible delays. Legitimate visitors experience no change to the chat widget form.

Suspicious leads arrive in your contacts list tagged with **chat\_widget\_high\_volume\_flag**. You retain full control: review the flagged contacts, restore genuine leads with a single click, and delete confirmed spam.

## Key Benefits

Spam Protection delivers automatic bot detection without disrupting your conversion funnel or discarding leads you may need to review.

**Zero Visitor Friction** — No CAPTCHA, no extra form fields, and no added wait time. Genuine visitors see the same fast, simple chat widget experience as before.

**Suspicious Leads Are Kept** — Flagged contacts are created and tagged rather than deleted, so borderline judgments never cost you real business. You make the final call.

**Sender Reputation Protected** — No outbound messages are sent to flagged leads on paused channels. Your account stops accumulating bounces that degrade delivery of genuine campaigns.

**Per-Widget Control** — Configure protection independently on each chat widget. Choose from four options: Tag only, Pause SMS, Pause Email, or Pause Both.

**Precise and Reversible** — Only the channels you select are paused. Calls, inbound messages, and all other DND settings remain untouched. Restore a contact in one click.

**Clear Audit Trail** — The activity log shows "DnD enabled by chat widget spam protection" and names the paused channel, so you always know why a message was not sent.

## Protection Options

You can configure how Spam Protection handles flagged leads by choosing one of four options. Select the level of protection that matches your needs and risk tolerance.

Option 1

Tag Only

Flagged leads are tagged with **chat\_widget\_high\_volume\_flag** but messaging is not paused. Use this if you want visibility into suspicious submissions without blocking outbound communication.

Option 2

Pause SMS

Flagged leads are tagged and SMS messaging is paused. Email remains enabled. Ideal for protecting SMS spend while allowing email follow-ups.

Option 3

Pause Email

Flagged leads are tagged and email messaging is paused. SMS remains enabled. Use this to protect email sender reputation while allowing SMS outreach.

Option 4

Pause Both

Flagged leads are tagged and both SMS and email messaging are paused. This is the default setting for new chat widgets and provides the most comprehensive protection.

Note

Calls, inbound messaging, and other DND settings are never affected by Spam Protection. Only the outbound channels you select are paused on flagged contacts.

## How to Enable Spam Protection

Spam Protection is configured per chat widget. Follow these steps to enable it on an existing widget or verify the default setting on a new one.

Step 1

Navigate to Sites → Chat Widget

Open the chat widget builder by selecting the widget you want to configure.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080611354/original/kHVBwLAhBBGXgANtjrNy15cyAHoCYMBEPg.jpeg?1789047621)

Step 2

Open the Spam Protection Panel

In the builder sidebar, locate and expand the **Spam Protection** section.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080611691/original/OcuEUZJ3cJBr5zIQC3ZG9RKZI2UAkPv8rQ.png?1789047763)

Step 3

Toggle Protection On

Enable the Spam Protection toggle. Existing widgets default to OFF; new widgets default to ON.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080611793/original/9xn1sJioGlrjNVlBOs2Acw073pdroOUQmw.png?1789047800)

Step 4

Choose the Protection Level

Select one of the four options.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080611841/original/dJbtYj-SB3p4WVU9T-PIqe9QNEI1IIfB2A.png?1789047841)

Step 5

Save the Widget

Click **Save** to apply your changes. Protection is active immediately for submissions received after saving.

Default Behavior

New chat widgets created in the builder have Spam Protection enabled by default with **Pause Both** selected. Existing widgets remain OFF until you manually enable them.

## Reviewing Flagged Leads

Flagged contacts appear in your contacts list with the tag **chat\_widget\_high\_volume\_flag**. Review them periodically to identify genuine leads that were flagged by mistake and restore messaging permissions.

Step 1

Filter by Tag

Go to **Contacts** and filter on the tag **chat\_widget\_high\_volume\_flag** to view all flagged submissions.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080613182/original/Qw6YfBfVDBeUxfdRZbRYttb3nGVa5akbhw.png?1789048352)

Step 2

Review Contact Details

Open each contact to inspect the submission. Check the activity log for the entry **"DnD enabled by chat widget spam protection"** to confirm which channels were paused.

Step 3

Restore Genuine Leads

If a contact is legitimate, manually remove the DND setting for the paused channel(s) and remove the **chat\_widget\_high\_volume\_flag** tag. Outbound messaging resumes immediately.

Step 4

Delete Confirmed Spam

Bulk-select confirmed spam contacts and delete them. This clears your contact list and prevents accidental outreach to invalid addresses.

Tip

Schedule regular reviews of flagged contacts — weekly or after campaigns — to ensure you restore genuine leads before they become stale.

## Managing Legitimate Surges

Legitimate spikes in chat widget submissions — caused by product launches, paid ad campaigns, events, or press coverage — can resemble spam waves from an automated detection standpoint. During these periods, temporarily disable Spam Protection to avoid tagging genuine leads.

Follow these steps to pause and resume protection around high-volume events:

Step 1

Disable Protection Before the Event

Navigate to **Sites → Chat Widget**, open the widget, and toggle Spam Protection OFF before your campaign or event begins.

Step 2

Re-enable Protection After the Surge

Once the event concludes and submission volume normalizes, toggle Spam Protection back ON and restore your protection settings.

Note

If you forget to disable protection during a legitimate surge, review the flagged contacts after the event and restore any genuine leads that were paused.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Does Spam Protection add CAPTCHA or extra fields to my chat widget?

No. Spam Protection operates server-side and does not modify the visitor-facing form. Legitimate users experience no change — no CAPTCHA, no extra steps, and no visible delay.

Q: Are flagged leads deleted automatically?

No. Flagged contacts are created in your account and tagged with **chat\_widget\_high\_volume\_flag**. Outbound messaging on the selected channels is paused, but the lead remains available for you to review and restore if legitimate.

Q: Can I restore a flagged contact if it's genuine?

Yes. Open the contact record, remove the DND setting for the paused channel(s), and delete the **chat\_widget\_high\_volume\_flag** tag. Outbound messaging resumes immediately.

Q: Does Spam Protection affect existing leads or workflows?

No. Spam Protection only applies to new submissions received after it is enabled. Existing contacts and active workflows are unaffected. The feature defaults to OFF on all existing chat widgets, so you must manually enable it.

Q: What happens to inbound calls and messages from flagged contacts?

Nothing. Spam Protection only pauses outbound messaging on the channels you select (SMS and/or email). Inbound calls, text replies, and all other contact interactions function normally.

Q: How do I know which channel was paused on a flagged contact?

Open the contact record and check the activity log. You will see an entry that reads **"DnD enabled by chat widget spam protection"** and specifies the paused channel (SMS, email, or both).

Q: Will Spam Protection affect my form conversion rate?

No. Because the feature operates server-side and adds no visible friction, it does not impact the visitor experience. Legitimate users complete the form exactly as they did before protection was enabled.

Q: Can I use Spam Protection on multiple chat widgets?

Yes. Protection is configured independently on each chat widget. You can enable it on some widgets and leave it off on others, or apply different protection levels (Tag only, Pause SMS, Pause Email, Pause Both) to each widget based on its purpose.

title_en: Google sheet integration for Knowledge Base
source_md:
Connect your live spreadsheets directly to your HighLevel Knowledge Base with Google Sheets integration. This feature helps you keep structured information current without repeated file uploads, making it easier for AI agents to reference the latest data. With manual refresh and near real-time sync options, teams can choose the update method that best fits how often their data changes. This is especially useful for pricing, service details, internal references, and other frequently updated information.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Google Sheets Integration for Knowledge Base?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Google-Sheets-Integration-for-Knowledge-Base?)
- [Key Benefits of Google Sheets Integration for Knowledge Base](#Key-Benefits-of-Google-Sheets-Integration-for-Knowledge-Base)
- [Sync Options](#Sync-Options)
- [How Google Sheets Supports Dynamic Knowledge Base Content](#How-Google-Sheets-Supports-Dynamic-Knowledge-Base-Content)
- [How To Setup Google Sheets Integration for Knowledge Base](#How-To-Setup-Google-Sheets-Integration-for-Knowledge-Base)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Google Sheets Integration for Knowledge Base?**

Google Sheets integration for Knowledge Base allows you to connect a Google Sheet as a live data source inside HighLevel. Instead of manually re-uploading spreadsheet files when values change, you can connect the sheet and let the Knowledge Base pull updated information from it. This helps AI agents use more current data when answering questions based on structured content.

Google Sheets integration is especially helpful when your team manages information in a spreadsheet that changes over time, such as product details, pricing updates, operating hours, service availability, or internal reference data. By using a connected sheet, you can reduce manual maintenance and keep your Knowledge Base aligned with the latest version of your data.

---

## **Key Benefits of Google Sheets Integration for Knowledge Base**

- **Near real-time sync:** Updates from your connected Google Sheet can be pulled into the Knowledge Base approximately every 15 minutes, helping AI agents reference fresher data.
- **Manual refresh option:** You can refresh the source on demand when you want changes reflected immediately after updating the sheet.
- **Support for changing data:** Added or removed columns, updated rows, and edited cells can be reflected without relying on repeated manual uploads.
- **Reduced maintenance:** Teams can keep using the spreadsheet they already manage instead of exporting and re-uploading files whenever information changes.
- **More current answers:** AI agents can reference updated spreadsheet content more consistently, which helps reduce outdated responses.

---

## **Sync Options**

Choosing the right sync method helps you balance freshness and control. Some teams need ongoing updates throughout the day, while others prefer to review changes first and refresh only when ready.

**Auto Sync (~15 min)**

Near real-time sync is designed for spreadsheets that change often and need to stay closely aligned with your Knowledge Base. This option is useful when your team regularly updates values that AI agents may reference in conversations.

Examples of when near real-time sync is helpful:

- Frequently updated pricing
- Availability or schedule changes
- Service details that change throughout the week
- Shared reference sheets used by multiple team members

**Manual Refresh**

Manual refresh is a good fit when you want more control over when updates go live in the Knowledge Base. This option works well for content that changes less often or needs to be reviewed before it is used by AI agents.

Examples of when manual refresh is helpful:

- Periodic updates made in batches
- Reviewed or approved spreadsheet changes
- Internal datasets that do not change often
- Situations where you want to refresh only after testing updates

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069568297/original/RUhoCQdmT2ZYcqp9GunMwuhGnj5pCrtHvQ.png?1776754332)

---

## **How Google Sheets Supports Dynamic Knowledge Base Content**

Dynamic spreadsheet content can be difficult to maintain when teams rely on static uploads. Connecting Google Sheets directly to the Knowledge Base helps reduce manual work by keeping structured data easier to update and maintain over time. This is especially useful for teams that manage information collaboratively and need AI agents to reference the latest version of frequently changing content.

This feature is useful for structured information such as:

- Product or service pricing
- Office or support hours
- Location-specific details
- Frequently updated internal reference data
- Sales, onboarding, or service notes stored in a tabular format

Google Sheets integration also supports ongoing changes within the sheet, which makes it a practical option for live data that evolves over time. HighLevel can reflect updates such as:

- Updated cell values
- New or removed rows
- Added or removed columns
- Other changes to structured spreadsheet content

By keeping the sheet connected as a live source, teams can make updates in Google Sheets and use sync options to help the Knowledge Base stay aligned with the latest version of that data.

---

## **How To Setup Google Sheets Integration for Knowledge Base**

A simple setup process helps you connect your spreadsheet correctly and make sure your Knowledge Base can use the latest version of your data. Once the sheet is connected, auto-sync helps keep the imported data updated as changes are made in Google Sheets.

1. From your Sub-Account, go to AI agents and Open the **Knowledge Base** tab. Open an existing Knowledge Base or create a new one.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069566801/original/p3s01C-cBOAR7j9s5JAgVdDbirz_xDC30Q.png?1776752792)
2. Click on**Tables**and**Import from Google Sheets**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069566972/original/r7GABI-m-ns26-RqmDcaeVGENMGTSlrptw.png?1776752917)
3. If no Google account is connected yet, set up a Google connection using the standard Google Drive permissions already used by HighLevel. No extra permissions are required.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069567085/original/p5ZGKmBc1tI0R3WxCBufnLFYZObPm_u-fQ.png?1776753048)
4. Choose the connected Google account, then browse the available accounts, drives, and spreadsheets.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069567586/original/y6HjwgtmfgXV5N5igpA4yc9Q9ZwvpBG6_g.gif?1776753629)
5. Select the Google Sheet you want to import.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069567629/original/YRg-lyN6B-bShmRdmFOngXVPly2kZ8oqEQ.png?1776753702)
6. Review the sheet and choose the appropriate data types, similar to the regular CSV upload flow.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069568063/original/MWkucSuP6R-kPb-Q0ZAZMcZwefpjeaoHLA.gif?1776754113)
7. Start the import and wait for processing to finish.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069568054/original/YAND503I_vRE-tCnCBg3dSsIoee0T7l-Fg.png?1776754098)
8. Allow auto-sync to keep the Knowledge Base updated when changes are made to the connected Google Sheet. Updates usually sync within about 15 to 20 minutes. Use the manual refresh option when you want to force an update sooner.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069567707/original/DuRvd3Xwvyii_12EKorIcDxyupWZaqFT8g.png?1776753812)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What does Google Sheets integration do in the Knowledge Base?**  
It allows you to connect a Google Sheet as a live Knowledge Base source so HighLevel can use spreadsheet data without relying only on static file uploads.

**Q: How often does near real-time sync update the sheet data?**  
Near real-time sync is designed to update at about 15-minute intervals.

**Q: What kinds of spreadsheet changes can be detected?**  
The feature supports row-level changes, cell updates, and schema-related changes such as added or removed columns.

**Q: What types of data work best in Google Sheets for Knowledge Base use?**  
Structured information such as pricing, hours, service details, reference data, and similar spreadsheet-based content is a strong fit.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Knowledge Base Integration for Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005266-knowledge-base-integration-for-voice-ai-agents?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
