title_en: Summer of AI: Agency Landing & Access Control
source_md:
AI Employee

Summer of AI: Agency Landing & Access Control

Preview the Summer of AI offer, control which eligible sub-accounts can see it, and manage access individually or in bulk.

What You'll Learn

HighLevel gives Agency Admins dedicated controls for managing Summer of AI offer visibility across eligible sub-accounts. The agency landing page provides promotion details and a direct way to choose which sub-accounts can see the offer.

The same offer-management workflow is also available from AI Employee settings, making it easier to update one account or several accounts in bulk. This guide focuses specifically on agency visibility and access control rather than the full trial, billing, or subscription workflow.

Offer Availability

Summer of AI is a promotional offer. Availability, eligibility, and promotional dates can change. Use the offer details shown in HighLevel and the current Summer of AI help article as the source of truth for live eligibility and billing terms.

# **What is Summer of AI Agency Landing & Access Control?**

Summer of AI Agency Landing & Access Control gives Agency Admins a centralized way to review the promotion and decide which eligible sub-accounts can see the offer. Admins can manage visibility from the dedicated Summer of AI landing page or through AI Employee settings.

When the offer is available, eligible sub-accounts may receive access to the Summer of AI AI Employee promotion. Hiding the offer prevents that promotion from being shown to the selected sub-account; it does not, by itself, remove existing AI Employee feature access.

## **Key Benefits of Summer of AI Agency Access Control**

Agency-level access controls help teams decide how a promotion should appear across different client accounts before clients interact with the offer. This provides a faster way to align promotional visibility with client strategy, billing preferences, and account eligibility.

- **Centralized Promotion Preview:** Review Summer of AI information from an agency-only landing page.
- **Granular Visibility Control:** Decide which eligible sub-accounts can see the offer.
- **Bulk Management:** Update offer visibility for multiple sub-accounts in one workflow.
- **Alternative Management Path:** Use AI Employee settings when you prefer account-level or bulk controls outside the landing page.
- **Cleaner Client Experience:** Hide the promotion from accounts where the offer is not appropriate or should not be client-facing.

## **What Agency Admins Can Control**

Summer of AI controls are designed around offer visibility rather than forcing one promotional experience across every client account. The available tools let Agency Admins review the offer, select sub-accounts, and manage whether eligible users can see it.

| Control | What It Does |
| --- | --- |
| **Agency Landing Page** | Provides agency-only promotion information and access-management controls. |
| **Individual Selection** | Lets you include or exclude specific sub-accounts from seeing the promotion. |
| **Bulk Selection** | Lets you apply the same visibility decision to several sub-accounts at once. |
| **AI Employee Settings** | Provides another place to manage Summer of AI offer visibility alongside AI Employee account settings. |

## **Offer Visibility vs. AI Employee Access**

Summer of AI visibility and AI Employee feature access are separate concepts. This distinction matters when a client already uses AI Employee or when the agency wants to hide the promotion without changing the client's existing AI configuration.

**Summer of AI Offer:** Controls whether the promotion is shown to an eligible sub-account. **AI Employee Feature:** Controls access to AI Employee itself. Changing promotion visibility should not be treated as the same action as granting or revoking AI Employee access.

## **How To Setup Summer of AI Agency Landing & Access Control**

Configure promotion visibility before directing clients to the offer. Start from the agency landing page when you want to review the promotion first, or use AI Employee settings when you need a more direct account-management view.

### **Step 1: Open the Summer of AI Agency Landing Page**

The dedicated landing page is intended for Agency Admins and provides the promotion overview before you decide which sub-accounts should receive visibility.

1. Switch to **Agency View**.
2. Open the **Summer of AI** page when it is available in the agency navigation.
3. Review the promotion details and available access-management controls.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080633711/original/S55-U0g5T8NQcv1qAJoMrP0k0a-bT8cSXA.png?1789056509)

### **Step 2: Select Which Sub-Accounts Can See the Offer**

The access-management window lets you search for specific sub-accounts or make a broader selection. Use this control to prevent the promotion from appearing for accounts where the offer should not be shown.

1. Open **Manage Access to Summer of AI** from the landing page.
2. Search for a sub-account or use the available selection controls.
3. Select the sub-accounts whose promotion visibility you want to manage.
4. Review and confirm the access choice shown in the current workflow.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080633739/original/l03F1ZTvCwqfOSFeyh8WC1r-8CCWCQ-qWQ.png?1789056525)

### **Step 3: Manage the Offer from AI Employee Settings**

AI Employee settings provide an alternative management path when you want to review Summer of AI offer status alongside AI Employee feature, rebilling, payment-plan, and payer information for each sub-account.

1. From **Agency View**, go to **Settings → AI Employee**.
2. Locate the sub-account you want to manage.
3. Use individual controls for one account or select multiple accounts and open **Bulk Actions**.
4. Update the Summer of AI offer setting without changing unrelated AI Employee controls unless that is also intended.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155080633857/original/owskZkx6pgzekMYLXspT7pc1lBZ53Ioosg.png?1789056544)

## **Troubleshooting Summer of AI Access Control**

If the promotion or its controls are missing, confirm both account eligibility and agency-level visibility settings before changing AI Employee access. A hidden or unavailable offer does not necessarily indicate an AI Employee feature problem.

| Issue | What to Check |
| --- | --- |
| **The Summer of AI page is not visible** | Confirm you are using an Agency Admin account and that the promotional page is currently available. |
| **A sub-account cannot see the offer** | Check the Summer of AI offer visibility setting and confirm the sub-account is eligible for the promotion. |
| **The offer is hidden but AI Employee still works** | This can be expected. Promotion visibility and AI Employee feature access are separate controls. |
| **Bulk controls do not affect an account as expected** | Confirm the intended sub-accounts were selected and review the current Summer of AI status for each account in AI Employee settings. |

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

Q: Who can access the Summer of AI agency landing page?

The agency landing page and its access-management controls are intended for Agency Admins.

Q: Can I manage Summer of AI visibility for several sub-accounts at once?

Yes. The release supports selecting sub-accounts individually or managing eligible accounts in bulk.

Q: Does hiding the Summer of AI offer disable AI Employee?

No. Summer of AI offer visibility and AI Employee feature access are separate controls. Hide the promotion without changing AI Employee unless you also intend to change feature access.

Q: Why might an enabled sub-account still not see the promotion?

Offer visibility does not override promotion eligibility. The sub-account may be ineligible, may have already used the applicable offer, or the promotion may no longer be available.

Q: Where else can I manage Summer of AI access?

Use Agency View → Settings → AI Employee to review Summer of AI offer status and manage eligible sub-accounts individually or through available bulk actions.

Q: Where should I check the current trial and billing terms?

Use the current Summer of AI promo article and the pricing displayed in HighLevel. Promotional eligibility, dates, pricing, and billing behavior can change over time.

### **Related Articles**

[How to Use the Summer of AI Promo for AI Employee](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008558-how-to-use-the-summer-of-ai-promo-for-ai-employee) [AI Employee: Access, Rebilling and Reselling](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003906) [AI Product Pricing](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006652-ai-product-pricing) [AI Usage Limits](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007813-ai-usage-limits) [AI Tools in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002166) [Selecting AI Employee Plan Tiers in SaaS Configurator](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008309-selecting-ai-employee-plan-tiers-in-saas-configurator)

title_en: Workflow Action - Update Custom Values
source_md:
The **Update Custom Value** workflow action in HighLevel allows you to dynamically update or replace **existing** [custom values](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001161575) within workflows. This action is a powerful tool for automating processes, personalizing campaigns, and maintaining accurate data across your CRM. Whether you're updating loyalty tiers, synchronizing data from external APIs, or managing automation triggers, this feature enhances flexibility and efficiency in your workflows.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Update Custom Value Action?](#What-is-the-Update-Custom-Value-Action?)
- [Key Use Cases](#Key-Use-Cases)
- [How to Set Up the Update Custom Value Action](#How-to-Set-Up-the-Update-Custom-Value-Action)
- [Field Descriptions](#Field-Descriptions)
- [Advanced Use Cases](#Advanced-Use-Cases)
- [Suggested Triggers](#Suggested-Triggers)
- [FAQs](#FAQs)
- [Related Resources](#Related-Resources)

---

## **What is the Update Custom Value Action?**

The **Update Custom Value** action enables you to dynamically modify custom values in workflows. It allows you to set, update, or replace existing values in custom values based on current/specific conditions.

- Update CRM data dynamically based on real-time triggers.
- Use variables to set dynamic values.
- Maintain accurate and consistent data across your CRM.

---

## **Key Use Cases**

- **Dynamic Personalization in Campaigns:**Automatically update customer loyalty tiers after purchase milestones.
- **Data Synchronization:**Update CRM fields dynamically with external API data.
- **Real-Time Automation:**Adjust discount codes or loyalty points dynamically in response to customer actions.
- **Trigger-Based Updates:**Automatically change status fields based on user interactions.
- **Example Scenario**:*"When a user makes a purchase above $500, update their loyalty tier from 'Bronze' to 'Gold' using the Update Custom Value action."*

In this example, when the "VIP" tag is added to a contact, the discount rate custom value is updated from 10% to 15%, enabling the contact to receive a higher discount during future interactions.

- **Trigger**: Contact Tag Added, Condition is a tag "VIP" is added to a contact.
- **Action**: Update Custom Value
- **Custom Value**: Discount Rate (created previously)
- **Current Value**: 10%
- **New Value**: 15%

---

## **How to Set Up the Update Custom Value Action**

Follow these steps to configure the **Update Custom Value** action in a workflow.

**Step 1**: Navigate to **Automation > Workflows**. Add a new workflow or edit an existing one.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039509092/original/xIr8vhfB8RNFCvCUZQo5FoAKjjDTrfzNvw.png?1736383274)

**Step 2**: Click the **"+" button** to add an action. Browse or search any part of the name "update custom value."

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039509111/original/S7pIzLiepub8l1e-HLgEbi-j90CkZEXSdw.png?1736383408)

**Step 3**: Configure the fields by selecting the custom value to change and selecting the new value. For example, if a custom value is the link to a specific calendar, you can change that to a different link.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155039509144/original/ZcXp5SXMnQPSDfCv7p2tqCrmk-w-RTqIRw.png?1736383538)

**Step 4**: Save and test the action and workflow. If you want to refer to the new value in the custom value it will be available immediately after that action runs in a workflow, just pull up the same custom value and it will have the new data in it.

---

### **Field Descriptions**

| **Field** | **Description** | **Example** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Action Name** | A descriptive name for the action displayed in the workflow. | Update Loyalty Tier |
| **Custom Value** | Choose the specific custom value to update. | Loyalty Level |
| **Current Value** | Displays the current value, if available. | Bronze |
| **New Value** | Set a static value or dynamic variable. | Gold |

---

## **Advanced Use Cases**

- **Using Conditional Logic (If/Else Action):**Adjust a field only if certain conditions are met. Example: Update loyalty tiers only if the current value is "Bronze."
- **Integrating with APIs:**Automatically update custom values using incoming data from external APIs. Example: Update a "Last API Sync Date" custom field dynamically.
- **Math Operations Integration:**Use math operations to dynamically calculate and update numeric custom values. Example: Add 50 points to a user's reward balance dynamically.
- **Dynamic Discount Codes:**Change a discount code dynamically in real-time workflows. Example: *"When a user completes three purchases in a month, automatically update their discount tier to '10% Off Next Purchase'."*

---

## **Suggested Triggers**

- **Contact Tag Added:**When a new tag is added to a contact (e.g., "VIP", "High Priority"), you can update a related custom value to reflect the importance of that contact.
  - **Example**: If the "VIP" tag is added, update the custom value for **Discount Rate** to offer a higher percentage.

- **Contact Updated:**Trigger the action when specific contact fields are updated. For example, if a customer’s preferences or contact information changes, you can update a corresponding custom value.
  - **Example**: If the **Email Subscription** field is updated to "Subscribed", update a custom value **Email Frequency** to "Weekly".

**Form Submitted:**After a form submission, you can update custom values based on the data provided in the form.

- **Example**: A form submission triggers the workflow to update the custom value **Survey Score** or **Preferences**.

**Appointment Booked:**After an appointment is successfully booked, you can update custom values based on the type of appointment or other related criteria.

- **Example**: When a contact books a high-ticket appointment, update the **Appointment Importance** custom value to “High”.

**Opportunity Status Changed:**When the status of an opportunity changes in the pipeline (e.g., from "Qualified" to "Won"), you can update a custom value that helps manage customer expectations.

- **Example**: If the opportunity status changes to "Won", update the custom value **Client Tier** to "Platinum".

**Survey Submitted:**When a contact submits a survey, their responses can be used to dynamically update custom values that inform future interactions.

- **Example**: If a customer survey response indicates a high satisfaction score, update a custom value **Customer Satisfaction** to reflect that score.

**Order Fulfilled:**After an order is fulfilled, you can update the contact's custom value to track their order history or customer status.

- **Example**: When an order is fulfilled, update the custom value **Last Order Date** to the current date.

**Link Clicked:**When a contact clicks a link in an email or SMS, the workflow can dynamically update a custom value based on their behavior.

- **Example**: If a link for a new product is clicked, update a custom value **Product Interest** to reflect the interest in the clicked product.

---

## **Frequently**

**Q: Can I use variables in the Update Custom Value action?**  
Yes, variables like `{{contact.custom_field}}` can be used for dynamic updates.

**Q: Can this action trigger other workflows?**  
**A:** Yes, updates can serve as triggers for additional workflows.

**Q: Is there a limit to the number of Update Custom Value actions in a workflow?**  
**A:** No, you can use multiple actions as needed.

**Q: What happens if the current value doesn’t match the condition?**  
**A:** The update will not proceed unless the current value matches the specified condition (if one is set).

**Q: Can I use Update Custom Value in If/Else actions?**  
**A:** Yes, you can combine it with conditional logic for more advanced workflows.

**Q: Can I update multiple Custom Values or bulk Custom Values?**  
**A:** One Update Custom Value action can update one Custom Value one time. Use more actions to update more Custom values or to update the same Custom Value again.

**Q: Can I use Update Custom Value to update a Custom Value in another subaccount?**  
**A:** The custom value that is being updated must be in the same subaccount as the workflow that is running.

**Q: Can I undo an update after it's done?**  
**A:** No, there is no "undo" function for the Update Custom Value action.

---

## **Related Resources**

For more advanced scenarios and integrations, check out these resources:

- [How to Use Custom Values](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001161575-how-to-use-custom-values)
- [Update Custom Values in Math Operation](https://ideas.gohighlevel.com/changelog/update-custom-values-in-math-operation)
- [Workflow - Custom Values in If/Else Action](https://ideas.gohighlevel.com/changelog/workflow-custom-values-in-ifelse-action)
- [Using Custom Objects in Workflow Actions and Triggers](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004389-using-custom-objects-in-workflow-actions-and-triggers)

title_en: Enhanced Document Privacy & Access Controls
source_md:
Document Management

# Enhanced Document Privacy & Access Controls

Securely share contact documents with configurable link types, expiration dates, and download permissions

What You'll Learn

Enhanced Document Privacy & Access Controls upgrades how you share files from the contact record's Documents panel. Instead of every file behaving like a public URL, you can generate configurable share links with different security levels, expirations, and download permissions.

This guide walks through the four link types, access controls, and how to implement secure document sharing that aligns with your internal security policies and client expectations.

Labs Feature

This feature is available through Labs and may evolve over time. If you don't see it in your account, ask an Agency or Sub-account Admin to check Settings → Labs and enable it for your location.

## What is Enhanced Document Privacy & Access Controls?

Enhanced Document Privacy & Access Controls upgrades how you share documents stored in a contact's Documents panel on the Contact Detail Page. Instead of every file behaving like a public URL, you can generate configurable share links with different security levels, expirations, and download permissions. You also gain visibility into who accessed what and when.

Historically, documents under contacts could be accessed by anyone with the URL, which meant sensitive information required extra care. With this feature enabled, new links default to private/internal access, and you explicitly choose when a link should be public, email-verified, or password-protected.

New documents uploaded as attachments through Notes are private by default. These files are stored in the **Notes attachments** folder under **Documents**.

This change applies only to Notes attachments uploaded after this update. Existing documents previously uploaded through Notes remain public.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078239273/original/wxd_yXuIMvMUTkB82E-bQ-OWe7i88ZIjDw.png?1786538316)

Important

This feature is delivered through Labs and may evolve based on feedback. Behavior and UI can change over time as the product team refines the experience.

## Key Benefits

Stronger document controls protect your clients and your team while keeping everyday work simple. These benefits focus on how the feature improves real-world document workflows:

**Stronger security for client files** — Choose between private, one-time passcode, password-protected, or public links based on the sensitivity of the document.

**Better alignment with policies & compliance** — Match sharing behavior to your internal data handling rules and industry requirements, instead of relying on a single, always-public link type.

**Clearer auditability & accountability** — View document details and access history so teams can quickly answer "who accessed this and when."

**Reduced risk of oversharing** — Links are private by default, limiting unexpected exposure when someone copies a URL into chat, email, or tickets.

**Flexible client experience** — Let internal teams use private links, while clients and external partners get OTP- or password-protected links that don't require a HighLevel login.

## Link Expiration & Download Controls

Expiration dates and download permissions add fine-grained control over how long a link stays active and what recipients can do with the file. Used together, they significantly reduce the risk of documents lingering in inboxes or being downloaded inappropriately.

Control 1

Link Expiration

Set a specific date when the link should stop working. This is ideal for time-boxed offers, sensitive reports, or compliance-driven data retention policies.

Control 2

Download Permissions

Choose whether recipients can download the file for their records, or restrict to view-only access (where supported). This helps keep copies under tighter control.

Best Practice

Combine shorter expiration windows and restricted downloads for documents that carry the most risk if leaked.

## Document Details & Access History

Document details and access history give you visibility into how each file is being shared and interacted with. This is especially helpful for audits, internal reviews, and troubleshooting questions like "Did the client open this yet?"

From the document's details view, you can:

- See the link type (public, private, OTP, password-protected) and whether downloads are allowed
- Confirm expiration settings and when the file was last updated
- Review access history, such as when links were opened and by whom (where available), giving you an at-a-glance audit trail for that document

Combined with activity tracking and message history, this gives teams a fuller picture of contact engagement around key documents.

Getting Started

Ready to Implement Secure Document Sharing?

Follow the step-by-step setup guide below to enable the feature and start creating configurable share links for your contact documents

## How to Set Up Enhanced Document Privacy & Access Controls

Setting up this feature has two main parts: enabling it through Labs (where available) and then using the new controls while sharing documents from the contact record. A careful setup ensures your links default to the correct privacy level and your team knows which option to choose in each scenario.

Step 1

Enable the Feature in Labs

1. Sign in with an Agency Admin or Sub-account Admin account that can access Settings and Labs
2. From the appropriate workspace (Agency or Sub-account), go to **Settings → Labs**
3. Locate the feature card named similar to "Enhanced document privacy & access controls" or referencing document link controls for contacts
4. Toggle the feature **ON**. If the card supports assignment, select the sub-accounts/locations that should get access, then save
5. Refresh your Contact Detail Page and confirm that the new sharing options appear when you share a document from the Documents panel

Step 2

Open the Contact's Documents Panel

1. Go to **Contacts** and open any contact record
2. In the right panel, click the **Documents** tab/module to view files associated with that contact (internal docs, synced attachments, and other stored files)

Documents uploaded through Notes are stored in the **Notes attachments** folder under **Documents**. New Notes attachments are private by default.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078019036/original/NCfRhsmUj4Qx0SxqkwyOGtiUWYHkgGkrOQ.png?1786362472)

Step 3

Choose a Document to Share

1. Locate the file you want to share in the contact's Documents list
2. Click the **more actions menu** (shown as three dots) next to the file name, then choose **Share link**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078019100/original/Kr2-vFO62zO-p37yBMWhGMbLtgKXAjO--g.png?1786362510)

Step 4

Configure the Link Type

In the share dialog, select one of the available access types:

- **Public link** — anyone with the URL can view (respecting your download and expiry settings)
- **Private link** — only authorized HighLevel users can access
- **One-time passcode link** — recipients must confirm access through a code sent to the contact's primary email
- **Password-protected link** — requires a passcode that you define

Confirm that the access type matches the sensitivity of the document and your internal policies.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078019219/original/dVcISOmPmUMisBsC0A0TEqGnbWpogek9hw.png?1786362575)

Step 5

Set Expiration and Download Options

1. **Set an expiration date** (optional but recommended): Pick the date when this link should no longer be accessible
2. **Choose download permissions:** Enable "Allow downloads" if recipients should save a copy. Disable it to keep access as view-only where supported
3. Review the summary of your chosen settings before finalizing

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078019380/original/TOkzih12hYHyQbVQQU32LpxARw0FaB4SIA.png?1786362665)

Step 6

Copy and Send the Link

1. Click **Create** or **Generate link** (wording may vary)
2. Use the **Copy link** button to copy the URL to your clipboard
3. Paste and send the link via your preferred channel (email, SMS, WhatsApp, client portal message, etc.), following your security practices—for example, sharing passwords or sensitive details via a separate channel

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155078019461/original/_7884cWU5GKiGuQx_NKEPTX_ZDztQLQPug.png?1786362724)

Step 7

Review Document Details & Access History (Optional)

1. Return to the contact's Documents panel
2. Open **Document details** for the shared file (e.g., via a details icon or more options menu)
3. Review: Link type and expiration, Download settings, Access history where available (e.g., last accessed timestamps)
4. Use this view to confirm that settings are correct and to support internal reviews or client inquiries

title_en: Connect HighLevel MCP to Muse
source_md:
HighLevel MCP is now available as an official app in Muse, giving Muse access to approved HighLevel CRM capabilities through Model Context Protocol (MCP). The connection uses OAuth, allowing you to choose the CRM sub-account(s) you want to connect and review the permissions requested before granting access. Once authorized, Muse can access 600+ supported operations across 38 CRM domains through four unified MCP tools, based on the scopes you approve.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is HighLevel MCP for Muse?](#What-is-HighLevel-MCP-for-Muse?)
- [Key Benefits of HighLevel MCP for Muse](#Key-Benefits-of-HighLevel-MCP-for-Muse)
- [How OAuth Permissions Work with Muse](#How-OAuth-Permissions-Work-with-Muse)
- [Supported HighLevel Operations](#Supported-HighLevel-Operations)
- [How To Set Up HighLevel MCP for Muse](#How-To-Set-Up-HighLevel-MCP-for-Muse)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is HighLevel MCP for Muse?**

HighLevel MCP for Muse creates a secure connection between Muse and HighLevel so Muse can interact with supported CRM services using Model Context Protocol. MCP provides a standardized way for compatible AI clients to discover available capabilities, retrieve information, and perform approved actions without requiring users to build separate integrations for each CRM function. HighLevel's MCP Server supports CRM services such as Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Opportunities, Payments, Locations, and Custom Fields.

With the Muse integration, authentication is completed using OAuth through a dedicated HighLevel MCP endpoint:

`https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/muse/v2/`

During authorization, you select the CRM sub-account(s) Muse can connect to and approve the requested scopes. These scopes determine which HighLevel data and functionality Muse is authorized to access.

---

## **Key Benefits of HighLevel MCP for Muse**

Connecting HighLevel to Muse gives you a controlled way to make supported CRM capabilities available to Muse while retaining visibility into the permissions being requested. OAuth scopes help limit access to the specific HighLevel resources and actions authorized during setup.

- **OAuth-based connection:** Authenticate through HighLevel without manually configuring credentials for the Muse connection.
- **Sub-account selection:** Choose the CRM sub-account(s) you want to make available during authorization.
- **Granular access control:** Approve OAuth scopes that determine the HighLevel resources and actions Muse can access.
- **Broad CRM coverage:** Access 600+ supported operations across 38 CRM domains.
- **Unified MCP access:** Supported operations are exposed through four unified MCP tools, simplifying how Muse interacts with HighLevel.
- **Permission visibility:** HighLevel's OAuth experience displays requested scopes so users can review the permissions an external application is requesting before authorizing it.

---

## **How OAuth Permissions Work with Muse**

OAuth allows an external application to request access to specific HighLevel resources without requiring you to share account credentials directly with that application. Reviewing requested scopes before authorization helps you understand which areas of HighLevel Muse will be able to use and what types of actions may be available.

When you connect HighLevel to Muse, the OAuth authorization flow presents the permissions, or **OAuth scopes**, being requested. HighLevel's OAuth consent experience is designed to show users the requested permissions and explain what those permissions allow before access is granted.

OAuth scopes should not be confused with HighLevel user permissions:

- **OAuth scopes** control what the Muse connection is authorized to access.
- **User roles and permissions** control what an individual HighLevel user can access within a sub-account.
- **Assigned data restrictions** can further limit which records a HighLevel user can view or manage. HighLevel supports Admin and User roles as well as granular module permissions and assigned-data restrictions.

Always review the requested OAuth scopes before approving the connection.

---

## **Supported HighLevel Operations**

MCP allows compatible AI clients to work with HighLevel services through a standardized connection instead of requiring a separate integration for every supported CRM function. The Muse integration provides access to 600+ supported operations across 38 CRM domains through four unified MCP tools, with actual access determined by the OAuth scopes you approve.

HighLevel's general MCP Server supports services including:

- Contacts
- Conversations
- Calendars
- Opportunities
- Payments
- Locations
- Custom Fields

HighLevel's MCP documentation also explains that MCP-compatible clients can retrieve records, update data, send messages, search opportunities, access calendar information, and perform other supported actions when appropriate access is available.

The exact operations available to Muse depend on the permissions granted to the connection. Approving only the scopes you need helps keep access aligned with your intended use case.

---

## **How To Set Up HighLevel MCP for Muse**

A successful setup requires completing HighLevel's OAuth authorization flow, selecting the correct CRM sub-account(s), and reviewing the scopes requested by Muse. Confirming these settings during setup helps ensure Muse receives the intended level of CRM access.

1. Open Muse and locate the option to connect an app or MCP service.
2. Select **HighLevel** as the app you want to connect.
3. When prompted for the HighLevel MCP connection, use the Muse-specific endpoint:

   `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/muse/v2/`
4. Start the HighLevel authorization process.
5. Sign in to HighLevel if prompted.
6. Review the HighLevel OAuth authorization screen.

   HighLevel's OAuth consent experience displays the application's requested scopes so you can understand the permissions being requested before approving access.
7. Select the CRM sub-account(s) you want to connect to Muse.
8. Review the requested OAuth scopes and confirm that they match the access you want Muse to have.
9. Approve the authorization request.
10. Return to Muse and confirm that HighLevel shows as connected.

Muse can now use the HighLevel operations available through the scopes you approved.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need a Private Integration Token to connect HighLevel to Muse?**  
The Muse connection described here uses a dedicated HighLevel MCP endpoint and an OAuth authorization flow. Follow the OAuth process presented through Muse rather than the generic token-based setup documented for other HighLevel MCP client configurations.

**Q: What determines which HighLevel operations Muse can use?**  
The available operations depend on the OAuth scopes approved during authorization. Scopes define which HighLevel resources and actions an external application can access.

**Q: Can Muse make changes to data in HighLevel?**  
HighLevel's MCP Server supports both retrieving information and performing supported actions, including updating data, when the required access is available. Whether a specific action is available through Muse depends on the approved scopes and supported operation.

**Q: Why do I need to review OAuth scopes before connecting?**  
OAuth scopes identify the HighLevel resources and actions an external application is requesting. Reviewing them helps you understand the access you are granting before completing authorization.

**Q: Why can't I see the HighLevel sub-account I want to connect?**  
First verify that the HighLevel user completing authorization has access to the expected sub-account. HighLevel user roles and permissions determine what a user can access within individual sub-accounts.

**Q: Are OAuth scopes the same as HighLevel user permissions?**  
No. OAuth scopes control the permissions granted to an external application, while HighLevel user roles and permissions control what an individual user can access inside a sub-account.

**Q: Can I revoke Muse's access later?**  
HighLevel recommends regularly reviewing connected applications and revoking access to applications that are no longer needed. Connected application access can be reviewed from **Settings > Connected Apps** in HighLevel.

**Q: Does every Muse connection automatically receive all 600+ HighLevel operations?**  
No. The integration supports 600+ operations across 38 CRM domains, but the operations available to a connection are based on the scopes approved during authorization.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Setup and Use the HighLevel MCP Server](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005741/create_ticket)
- [API Security - OAuth Consent for Marketplace Apps](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005002)
- [Sub-account: User Roles, Permissions and Assigned Data](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002544)

title_en: How to Import Emails from Any Platform Using Email AI
source_md:
Import Email Templates with Email AI lets you turn an existing email into an editable HighLevel template without rebuilding it from scratch. This article shows how to import an email from your inbox or previous marketing platform, choose the right editor, and review the converted template before using it in a campaign.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Importing Email Templates with Email AI?](#What-is-Importing-Email-Templates-with-Email-AI?)
- [Key Benefits of Importing Email Templates with Email AI](#Key-Benefits-of-Importing-Email-Templates-with-Email-AI)
- [Supported Import Options](#Supported-Import-Options)
- [How To  Import Email Templates with Email AI](#How-To-%C2%A0Import-Email-Templates-with-Email-AI)
- [Design Editor vs. Code Editor](#Design-Editor-vs.-Code-Editor)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Importing Email Templates with Email AI?**

Email AI can convert an existing email into a reusable HighLevel template by reading the email you send to a unique import email address. Once the email is received, HighLevel uses AI to recreate the email structure so you can continue editing it in either the Design Editor or Code Editor.

Import Email Templates with Email AI helps you bring campaigns from tools like Mailchimp, Active Campaign, Kajabi, HubSpot, or another email platform into HighLevel. Instead of manually rebuilding layouts, copying text, and recreating buttons, you can import the original email and start editing the converted version.

---

## **Key Benefits of Importing Email Templates with Email AI**

- **Platform flexibility:** Import emails from your inbox or previous marketing platforms without being limited to one provider.
- **Faster client onboarding:** Bring a client’s existing high-performing emails into HighLevel in minutes.
- **Less manual rebuilding:** Convert an existing email into an editable template instead of recreating the layout from scratch.
- **AI-assisted optimization:** Use Email AI to make improvements after the email has been imported.
- **Reusable campaign assets:** Turn existing emails into templates that can be edited, saved, and used for future campaigns.
- **Editor choice:** Open the imported template in the Design Editor for visual editing or the Code Editor for HTML-level control.

---

## **Supported Import Options**

The import dropdown helps you choose the source that best matches where the email came from. Selecting the correct option gives HighLevel better context when Email AI converts the email into an editable template.

**Available import options include:**

- Import from any platform with AI
- Mailchimp
- Active Campaign
- Kajabi

Use **Import from any platform with AI** when the email comes from an inbox, a provider not listed in the dropdown, or a general external source. Use a platform-specific option when the email was created in one of the listed tools.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Iv8H0gTuCCjVayEILnJQ+/Screenshot+2026-04-29+at+16.59.07.png)

---

## **How To  Import Email Templates with Email AI**

A successful import starts by sending or forwarding the email to the dynamic email address shown in HighLevel. After the email is received, HighLevel can convert it into an editable template so you can review, adjust, and save it for future use.

```
Important: Email AI can make mistakes. Always review the imported template before using it in a live campaign. Check the layout, images, buttons, links, spacing, copy, personalization, and mobile appearance.
```

1. Go to **Marketing** in the left navigation menu.
2. Click **Emails** in the top navigation menu.
3. Open **Templates**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/2KznD8JuUKPfHFHNEeiQ+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-29+at+17.13.03.png)
4. Click + **New**.
5. Select **Import Email with AI**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/D1clLTm2wh9NG53aq1CQ+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-29+at+17.14.43.png)
6. In the **Import Email Templates** modal, choose where the email is being imported from.

   - Select **Import from any platform with AI** for emails from an inbox or unsupported platform.
   - Select a listed platform, such as **Mailchimp**, **Active Campaign**, or **Kajabi**, when applicable.  
       
     ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Iv8H0gTuCCjVayEILnJQ+/Screenshot+2026-04-29+at+16.59.07.png)
7. **Copy** the **dynamic** **email** **ID** shown under **Send an email to**.
8. From your **inbox** or **previous** **marketing** **platform**, **send a test email or forward the email to the copied import email address**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/yyhbY8e7iB2kVSRqE1BY+/GIF+Recording+2026-04-29+at+17.22.57.gif)
9. Return to Email Import screen after the email is sent.
10. Choose whether to open the converted template in the **Design Editor** or **Code Editor**.
11. Click **Continue**.
12. Review the imported email and make any needed edits before saving or using it in a campaign.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/8ESTjpBZph9XjEfUNe40+/GIF+Recording+2026-04-29+at+17.24.56.gif)

---

## **Design Editor vs. Code Editor**

Choosing the right editor determines how you will edit the imported email after Email AI converts it. The Design Editor is best for visual editing, while the Code Editor is best for users who need direct control over the email HTML.

Choose **Open in Design Editor** when you want to:

- Edit the template visually with drag-and-drop style controls
- Adjust text, buttons, images, and layout without working in code
- Make quick marketing updates after importing the email
- Hand the template off to users who prefer a visual editor

Choose **Open in Code Editor** when you want to:

- Review or edit the email HTML directly
- Preserve a code-based workflow for custom layouts
- Make technical changes that require HTML knowledge
- Continue working with a template that was originally built as custom HTML

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/U89ciCFmIY9dfh1hqcEA+/Screen+Shot+2026-04-29+at+17.44.19.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What platforms can I import templates from?**  
You can import from any email platform that allows you to send a test email or campaign, including Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ConvertKit, ActiveCampaign, Constant Contact, and more. Use **Import from any platform with AI** when the provider is not listed in the dropdown.

**Q: Can I forward an email from my inbox instead of sending a test email from another platform?**  
Yes. You can forward an existing email from your inbox to the dynamic import email address shown in HighLevel.

**Q: Will my email’s original formatting and images stay intact?**  
Email AI is designed to preserve the email’s structure, HTML, images, and design elements during import. Always review the converted template before using it in a live campaign, since some elements may need minor adjustments.

**Q: Can I use the imported template in campaigns right away?**  
Yes. Once imported, the template can be used in email campaigns or automations after you review, edit, and save it.

**Q: What if I update the original template on the other platform?**  
Re-import the updated version by sending or forwarding the updated email to the system-generated import address shown in HighLevel.

**Q: Does this work with plain-text emails too?**  
Yes. Plain-text emails can be imported, but the Code Editor is best suited for HTML-based emails with structured content.

**Q: Where do imported templates appear in my HighLevel account?**  
Imported templates appear under **Marketing > Emails > Templates**, just like manually created templates.

**Q: Should I use the Design Editor or Code Editor?**  
Use the Design Editor if you want to visually edit the email without code. Use the Code Editor if you need direct HTML control or are working with a custom-coded email.

**Q: What should I check after importing the template?**  
Review the layout, images, buttons, links, spacing, branding, copy, merge fields, and mobile appearance before saving or sending the email.

**Q: Can I import competitor emails or emails I received from another sender?**  
You can forward an email from your inbox to use it as a starting point for a new editable template. Make sure the final template uses your own branding, content, links, and compliant messaging before sending.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to use the Email Builder and its In-line Editor](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000087)
- [How to Preview & Test Your Email Campaigns/Templates](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001215382)
- [How to Use the Kajabi Email Template Importer](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002542)
- [Importing and Editing Mailchimp Email Templates in the HighLevel Design Editor](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001219298)
- [How to import Email Template(s) from ActiveCampaign](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001223010)

title_en: Workflow Action - Add Leads Under an Affiliate
source_md:
The **Add Leads Under an Affiliate** workflow action allows you to automatically assign leads to specific affiliates within chosen campaigns. This feature helps you streamline lead management, ensure accurate affiliate crediting, and enhance engagement by connecting leads with the right affiliate partners—saving time and reducing manual effort.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the “Add Leads Under an Affiliate” Action?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-the-%E2%80%9CAdd-Leads-Under-an-Affiliate%E2%80%9D-Action?)
- [Key Benefits of Using the Add Leads Under an Affiliate Action](#Key-Benefits-of-Using-the-Add-Leads-Under-an-Affiliate-Action)
- [How to Configure the Workflow Action](#How-to-Configure-the-Workflow-Action)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is the “Add Leads Under an Affiliate” Action?**

This workflow action connects your lead generation process directly with your affiliate management system. When triggered, it automatically assigns new leads under selected affiliates and campaigns, ensuring every contact is tracked and attributed properly for performance reporting, commissions, or follow-ups.

The action can be used manually or automatically, depending on how you prefer to manage affiliate assignments.

---

## **Key Benefits of Using the Add Leads Under an Affiliate Action**

Understanding how this feature enhances your affiliate workflow helps you maximize automation potential and minimize human error. Below are the key advantages of implementing this action.

- **Automation:** Automatically assign leads to the correct affiliate without manual input.

- **Accuracy:** Prevent errors in affiliate tracking by syncing directly with campaign data.

- **Flexibility:** Choose from multiple assignment methods — Manual, Auto-Track via Attribution, or Custom Mapping.

- **Integration:** Seamlessly connect workflow automations, forms, and affiliate tracking links.

- **Scalability:** Handle large affiliate networks efficiently by automating lead routing.

---

# **How to Configure the Workflow Action**

Setting up the **Add Leads Under an Affiliate** workflow action allows you to assign leads to affiliates in your campaigns automatically or manually, depending on how your leads are captured.

The following steps walk you through setting up the workflow trigger, adding the action, choosing a configuration method, and publishing your workflow.

### 

### **Access the Workflow Builder**

Navigate to the **Automation** section in the left-hand menu, then select **Workflows**. From the **Workflow List**, click **Create Workflow** in the u**pper-right corner**.

You can choose to start from a recipe, template, or from scratch, depending on your workflow needs. This step opens the workflow builder, where you can begin setting up the structure of your automation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155057427792/original/tv22d0uAxG_kXkldg7Sw-mNcsb_iwTK37w.png?1762167673)

### **Add a Workflow Trigger**

Before adding the affiliate action, ensure your workflow has a **trigger**—this determines when a lead will be added under an affiliate.

Without a trigger, no leads will enter the workflow, and the action will not execute.

Common triggers include:

- **Form Submitted:** When a contact completes a specific form.
- **Tag Added:** When a tag is applied to a contact.

### 

### **Add the Workflow Action**

After setting up your trigger, add the **Add Leads Under an Affiliate** action to the workflow.

Click the **+ Add** button, then select **Add Action** from the dropdown menu.

This opens the list of available workflow actions where you can choose the appropriate one for your automation setup. This step adds a new action block that will handle your affiliate lead assignment.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155057426145/original/OIZKKiCio23PynVlAPspLfNfHkzl6a87Og.jpeg?1762166888)

### **Select the Action Type**

Once the action menu opens, scroll to the **Affiliate** section under **Actions** and select **Add Leads Under an Affiliate**.

This connects your workflow to the Affiliate Manager system, enabling leads to be added under a specific affiliate campaign and affiliate.

After selecting this action, it appears in your workflow builder, ready for configuration.

### 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155057426311/original/Jw2a3lv7PbtA1rd8EBTsEUo8SlX60gle3w.jpeg?1762166953)

### **Choose Manual Assignment**

Choose **Manual Assignment** when you want to directly assign a lead to a specific affiliate and campaign.

This is ideal for fixed lead routing, internal workflows, or cases where affiliate assignments are predetermined.

In this configuration:

- Select **Manual** under Choose Action Mapping.
- Pick an affiliate **Campaign** from the dropdown list.
- Once a campaign is chosen, the system displays affiliates linked to that campaign.
- Select the desired **Affiliate** from the list.
- Save the configuration.

This ensures all new leads entering this workflow are automatically assigned to the chosen affiliate.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155057426391/original/LZ5YcEpMsdXR_uen_vf_qQ3GPNWvF3Vb5Q.jpeg?1762166995)

### **Configure Auto-Track via Attribution**

The **Auto-Track Affiliate via Attribution** method automatically assigns leads to affiliates based on tracking links containing an affiliate ID (am\_id).

This is best for automated setups where affiliate links are used to drive traffic.

Here’s how it works:

- Select **Auto-Track Affiliate via Attribution** under *Choose Action Mapping.*
- Choose the **Attribution Source**:

  - **First Attribution:** Credits the first affiliate who referred the contact.
  - **Latest Attribution:** Credits the most recent affiliate interaction.
- Save your configuration.

When leads arrive through affiliate URLs (e.g., https://yourdomain.com/?am\_id=1234), HighLevel captures that ID and automatically credits the correct affiliate.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155057426453/original/zpQh8LCaLbSn9UNAqQZFcTUhODFd671Dlw.jpeg?1762167017)

### **Configure Custom Mapping**

Use **Custom Mapping** to dynamically assign affiliates using data stored in custom fields or workflow variables.

This method is ideal for API integrations or external systems where affiliate data is passed dynamically rather than through tracking links.

To configure:

- Choose **Custom Mapping** under *Choose Action Mapping.*
- Enter the mapping source:

  - Use a **custom field** (e.g., {{contact.custom\_field.am\_id}})
  - Or a **workflow variable** (e.g., {{workflow.am\_id}})
- The system matches the affiliate ID to the correct affiliate record and assigns the lead automatically.

This setup gives you maximum flexibility for advanced routing or integrated affiliate data flows.

### 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155057426494/original/hc3hXwhgX4T05iQnW_NmKWNptjBvxE8tKQ.jpeg?1762167037)

### **Test and Publish Your Workflow**

Before activating, test your setup to ensure that affiliates are being assigned correctly. Testing confirms that your triggers, campaign selection, mapping logic, and attribution all function as intended.

Steps to finalize:

1. Click **Test Workflow** in the top-right corner to simulate lead entry.
2. Review the **Execution Logs** to verify successful affiliate assignment.
3. Once confirmed, toggle from **Draft** to **Publish** to activate your workflow.

Your workflow is now live and ready to automatically assign leads to affiliates using your chosen configuration method.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q:****What happens if no matching affiliate is found for an am\_id?**

The workflow will complete without assigning the lead. Verify that the am\_id corresponds to an existing affiliate in your campaign.

**Q:****Can I manually override an automatically assigned affiliate?**

Yes. You can manually reassign affiliates from within the Affiliate Manager if a correction is needed.

**Q: Does this action require a sale or reward to work?**

No. You can assign a lead under an affiliate even if no reward or dollar amount is involved. Rewards or commissions are only applied when a qualifying purchase or conversion is made through the affiliate’s link.

**Q:****How is “First Attribution” different from “Latest Attribution”?**

“First Attribution” credits the initial referrer, while “Latest Attribution” credits the most recent one before conversion.

**Q:****Can I assign multiple affiliates to one lead?**

No. A lead can be assigned to only one affiliate per campaign to maintain accurate tracking.

**Q:****How can I test this workflow before activating it?**

Use the **Test Workflow** feature with sample data to ensure correct assignment before publishing.

title_en: ClientPortal Builder Enhancement Pack
source_md:
HighLevel added multiple upgrades to the ClientPortal Builder to speed up branded app launches and reduce churn. Agencies can Book a Call for guided onboarding, end users now see a “Cancelled from Live” screen when subscriptions are paused or cancelled, and subscription automations are smoother with enhanced webhooks, automatic subscription creation, and re-subscription handling. These improvements reduce friction, improve retention, and shorten time-to-live.
