# **What is Automatic Newsletters for Communities?**

Communities Automatic Newsletters in HighLevel are recurring messages automatically sent to community members to keep them informed, engaged, and up to date. These newsletters can include announcements, highlights, updates, or curated content from your community. With built-in scheduling controls, admins can define when these newsletters are delivered, ensuring consistent communication that aligns with member activity and expectations.

---

## **Key Benefits of Newsletters for Communities**

- **Consistent Communication:** Automatically send newsletters to keep your community informed without manual effort.
- **Flexible Scheduling:** Choose daily, weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly delivery schedules that fit your content strategy.
- **Timezone-Based Delivery:** Ensure newsletters are sent at the correct local time for your selected audience.
- **Improved Engagement:** Deliver relevant updates when members are most likely to read and interact.
- **Admin Control:** Manage both content delivery and timing from a single, streamlined setup.

---

## **Newsletter Content Rules**

These signals define what members see in their digest so you can set expectations and answer “why did/didn’t this appear?” questions.

- **Active Threads**: Shows the **last thread** a member interacted with, plus the **freshest replies** from others.
- **Top Posts (public channels)**: Highlights trending content so members don’t miss what’s hot.
- **Posts from Followed Members**: Includes updates from creators a member follows.
- **Upcoming Events**: Surfaces the most relevant upcoming events.
- **Clickable Cards**: Each item links back to the originating post, thread, or event for fast re‑engagement.
- **Permissions honored**: Members only see items they’re allowed to access.

---

## **Scheduling Options**

Choosing the right schedule ensures your newsletters align with your audience’s habits and expectations. HighLevel provides flexible scheduling options designed to support different communication styles and content strategies.

- **Daily Scheduling**

  - Set a specific time and timezone for newsletters to be sent every day
  - Ideal for frequent updates or active communities
  - **Example:** Daily at 8:00 AM (New York time)
- **Weekly / Bi-weekly Scheduling**

  - Select specific days along with time and timezone
  - Great for consistent content like weekly digests or announcements
  - **Example:** Every Tuesday at 10:00 AM (London time)
- **Monthly Scheduling**

  - Choose a specific date (1–27 or last day of the month), along with time and timezone
  - Best for summaries, reports, or long-form updates
  - **Example:** 1st of every month at 9:00 AM (IST)

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/XJkQzMjdF576JUnfY5h9+/Screenshot+2026-04-20+at+21.05.23.png)

---

## **How To Setup Automatic Newsletters for Communities**

Follow these steps to enable and configure newsletters for a specific group. Consistent configuration ensures members get the right digest on the cadence you choose.

1. Go to **Memberships > Communities > Groups**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/A4rTqL2ZrtUeGEbAZqMZ+/Screenshot+2025-10-24+at+7.37.59%E2%80%AFPM.png)

4. Click on the **Newsletter** tab.
5. Choose your **Frequency**: Daily, Weekly, Bi‑Weekly, or Monthly.
6. Configure the following based on your selection:  
     
   - **Time**
   - **Day** or **Date** (depending on schedule type)
   - **Timezone**
7. Click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/z5jUpTVBNVGcLfpdf1gA+/GIF+Recording+2026-04-20+at+21.02.27.gif)

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Who can turn newsletters on?**

Group Owners and Admins.

**Q: Are newsletters on by default?**

No. They are off by default until an Owner or Admin enables them per group.

**Q: What content is included in newsletters?**

Newsletters include curated community content such as posts, announcements, and updates. Members will only see content they have permission to access.

**Q: Do newsletters include private or restricted content?**

Members only see content they have permission to access.

**Q: Can I choose the send cadence?**

Yes. You can select Daily, Weekly, Bi-Weekly, or Monthly schedules.

**Q: Can I customize the send time and timezone?**

Yes. You can define the exact time and timezone to ensure 

newsletters are delivered at the most relevant time for your audience.

**Q: Can I change the newsletter schedule after setting it?**

Yes. You can update the schedule at any time from the newsletter settings.

**Q: Can I send newsletters at different times for different members?**

No. The schedule is configured at the community level and applies to all members.

**Q: Can members unsubscribe from newsletters?**

Yes. Each email includes an “Update Preferences” link where members can manage their subscription.

# **Overview of Adding Pinterest Pins in Social Planner**

Pinterest pins can be created and published directly from Social Planner, so you do not need to switch between HighLevel and Pinterest to build your post. After connecting a Pinterest business account, you can upload an image or video, add the pin title and description, include a destination link, and choose the Pinterest board or boards where the pin should be published.

Each pin requires one image or one video, and at least one Pinterest board must be selected before the pin can be posted, scheduled, saved, or sent for approval.

You can also create multiple Pinterest pins at once by selecting up to 25 boards for the same post. Each selected board creates its own published pin, allowing you to share the same content across multiple Pinterest destinations without recreating the post manually.

---

## **Key Benefits of Adding Pinterest Pins in Social Planner**

- **Multi-Board Publishing:** Publish the same Pinterest pin to multiple selected boards from one post composer workflow.
- **Centralized Scheduling:** Create, schedule, save, or publish Pinterest pins directly from Social Planner.
- **Board Flexibility:** Select existing Pinterest boards or create a new board while creating the pin.
- **Post Preview:** Review how the Pinterest pin will appear before publishing or scheduling.
- **Media Support:** Publish image or video pins as long as the uploaded media meets Pinterest requirements.

---

## **Pinterest Media Requirements**

Pinterest pins require either **one image** or **one video**.

- **For Image:** It needs to be 10MB or less than 10 MB, it supports PNG and JPG.
- **For Video:** It needs to be 1 GB or less than 1GB, it supports MOV,MP4 and WEBP and it requires minimum 4 secs or maximum 5 mins video size. The recommended aspect ratio is 9:16 (full-bleed videos), 1:2, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, or 1:1 and Video Encoding: H.264 or H.265.

---

## **How to Connect a Pinterest Account**

1. Navigate to **Marketing** > **Social Planner**> **+ Socials**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071941362/original/uMjjpzBSTeTtNK0FM-4FSweoMGM4rcg1fg.png?1779384112)
2. Click **Connect Pintrest**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071941427/original/WRDKcerfgXTY6mKQLGdWLPExrA8x2-bu5g.png?1779384149)
3. Log into your Pinterest account. Ensure you are an admin of the account.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071941473/original/LUnO0KG5XuRc5OiXJi6sGCeRtFhxu8WRSQ.png?1779384208)

---

## **How To Create and Post Pins**

1. From the Social Planner, click **+****New Post**.  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071941578/original/Ik4RI9e_hW1YhigyZiCb0Te-ywDiKTY68g.png?1779384311)**
2. In the **Post to** field, select the Pinterest account.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071942447/original/_cdmZ1E3JxOgLtooKodpG59ozerjMbCCUA.png?1779385305)
3. Add your post content or description and upload a supported image or video.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071942465/original/7_CQ-9RLJHQtuCWqpfAHei3opoJ6hBbjow.png?1779385333)
4. Add a Title and Link.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071942482/original/5wLDe20eVNoQGOUIw3gW4cgQYY_uNoisHw.png?1779385357)
5. Select one or more Pinterest boards. Up to 25 Boards are supported. When publishing to multiple boards, each selected board generates its own published pin.  
     
   Private board will show the **Lock** icon.  
     
   If you do not have any boards, you can create one using the **A****dd board** option in the board selection dropdown.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155071942501/original/Od_PJcJHSfQ3QQsx8Svh65mJEYV6ODEZUA.png?1779385392)
6. Choose your publishing option:

   - Save for later
   - Post now
   - Schedule post
   - Recurring post
   - Send for approval

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I publish one Pinterest pin to multiple boards?**  
Yes. Multi-board publishing allows you to publish a single Pinterest pin to up to 25 boards per Pinterest account from one Social Planner composer. Each selected board creates its own published pin automatically, so you do not need to duplicate the same post manually for each board.

**Q: Does each selected board create a separate pin?**  
Yes. Each selected board creates a separate published pin. This helps keep tracking and analytics separated by board.

**Q: What happens if publishing fails for one selected board?**  
A failure on one board does not block the other selected boards from publishing. Each board is handled independently.

**Q: Why do I need to select a Pinterest board?**  
Pinterest requires pins to be saved to a board. The selected board determines where the pin appears on Pinterest.

**Q: Can I create a new Pinterest board while creating a pin?**  
Yes. Use the New board or Add board option in the board dropdown to create a board during post creation.

**Q: Why is my Pinterest board not appearing?**  
Confirm that the correct Pinterest business account is connected, that you have admin access, and that the board exists in the connected Pinterest account. If the account was recently updated, reconnecting or refreshing the social account may help.

**Q: What happens if my media does not meet Pinterest requirements?**  
The pin may fail to publish or may need to be adjusted before it can be scheduled. Check the file type, file size, duration, and aspect ratio before posting.

---

title_en: Enhanced Consent Checking for Voice AI Outbound Calling (Forms, Surveys, Calendars)
source_md:
Voice AI outbound calling in HighLevel now validates consent across Forms, Surveys, and Appointment Forms/Calendars before dialing. This upgrade helps you place compliant calls by recognizing opt-in collected from additional asset types. Learn how consent is captured, evaluated, and audited—plus how to configure assets and troubleshoot call blocks.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Enhanced Consent Checking for Voice AI Outbound Calling?](#What-is-Enhanced-Consent-Checking-for-Voice-AI-Outbound-Calling?)
- [Key Benefits of Enhanced Consent Checking](#Key-Benefits-of-Enhanced-Consent-Checking)
- [Consent Sources Scanned (Forms, Surveys, Appointment Forms/Calendars)](#Consent-Sources-Scanned-(Forms,-Surveys,-Appointment-Forms/Calendars))
- [What Counts as “Valid Opt-In”?](#What-Counts-as-%E2%80%9CValid-Opt-In%E2%80%9D?)
- [Pre-Call Check Behavior & Outcomes](#Pre-Call-Check-Behavior-&-Outcomes)
- [Multi-Number Handling](#Multi-Number-Handling)
- [Auditability & Logs](#Auditability-&-Logs)
- [How To Setup Enhanced Consent Checking](#How-To-Setup-Enhanced-Consent-Checking)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Enhanced Consent Checking for Voice AI Outbound Calling?**

HighLevel’s Voice AI performs a pre-call compliance scan to determine whether a contact has provided valid opt-in consent for voice calls. With this enhancement, the consent engine looks beyond standard Forms and also recognizes consent captured via Surveys and Appointment Forms/Calendars. Understanding how consent is stored, evaluated, and surfaced in logs ensures your team can confidently automate compliant outbound calling.

---

## **Key Benefits of Enhanced Consent Checking**

These benefits focus on safer, more reliable outbound operations. Each item highlights how the change reduces risk or improves efficiency for admins and compliance teams.

- **Broader Coverage:**Consent found in Forms, Surveys, and Appointment Forms/Calendars is now recognized before a call is placed.
- **Fewer False Blocks:** Valid opt-in from any supported asset allows eligible calls to proceed.
- **Centralized Compliance:**Pre-call validation reduces manual reviews and keeps workflows moving smoothly.
- **Better Auditability:**Source and timestamp visibility make reviews and investigations faster.
- **Future-Ready:**Upcoming tools (consent text audit + bulk updates) simplify ongoing compliance maintenance.

---

## **Consent Sources Scanned (Forms, Surveys, Appointment Forms/Calendars)**

Knowing every asset type that contributes to the pre-call decision prevents confusion and rework. Use this as your definitive list of sources the system checks before dialing.

- Forms (existing coverage)
- Surveys (newly supported)
- Appointment Forms/Calendars (newly supported)

```
Tip: Use consistent consent language across all assets to produce predictable allow/block outcomes.
```

---

## **What Counts as “Valid Opt-In”?**

Clear criteria prevent misinterpretation and help your legal/compliance team standardize language across assets.

- A clear, affirmative action (e.g., checked box) indicating consent to receive voice calls.
- Displayed consent text that references voice calls; avoid vague or bundled language.
- Timestamp (and when available: submission details like IP/user agent).
- The consent submission must be associated with the contact and the phone number you intend to call.
- Maintain language that is region-agnostic and adaptable to your legal framework; consult counsel for jurisdiction-specific requirements.  
    
  [Screenshot placeholder: Example consent text with clear “voice calls” reference]

---

## **How To Setup Enhanced Consent Checking**

Following a clear setup sequence ensures your assets collect the right data and that Voice AI can evaluate it reliably before dialing.

### **Step 1:****Update Forms**

- Navigate to your form created or Create a form.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065172623/original/MtsHGy9dVcUd9l-6t6Owwf0kJ7dxeCu9tg.png?1771415995)
- Click on the settings icon available to edit the consent information.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155065172767/original/LXA7oPA-cwXWKf8B-z5Nx_v1IhYRYjuj5A.png?1771416091)
- Add a required consent checkbox; ensure the phone field is present and mapped to the contact’s phone.
- Confirm submissions save timestamp and consent text exposure.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060706341/original/LifGKN2xEA2etOZ4bas8_PF_Hyv8u0alvg.jpeg?1765880744)

### **Step 2: Update Surveys**

- Add a required consent item (checkbox or explicit confirmation).
- Capture or confirm the phone number to associate consent correctly.

### **Step 3: Update Appointment Forms/Calendars**

- Enable a required consent checkbox on booking forms.
- Ensure the booking collects the phone number used for Voice AI calls.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060706620/original/EEz9JQs64WxhTRLBZvm7-04unzfSwvyTMQ.png?1765880856)  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155060706755/original/LN6_Ia2t1LpKBLSo2KoZnpIhWw5Od1GCnA.png?1765880913)

### **Step 4: Verify on a Test Contact**

- Submit each asset once, then open the contact timeline to confirm consent entries, source, and timestamps.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Is opt-out always stronger than opt-in?**A: Yes. A recent opt-out or DNC flag blocks calls even if prior opt-in exists.

**Q: Do I need separate consent for each phone number?**A: Best practice is number-specific consent. If your policy uses contact-level consent, confirm it with your legal team.

**Q: Are older Survey or Calendar submissions recognized now?**A: They can be, provided the submission is associated with the contact and phone number. Verify in the contact timeline and logs.

**Q: Where can I see why a call was blocked?**A: Review Voice AI call logs and the contact timeline for the decision, reason, and any available consent source.

**Q: What should my consent text include?**A: A clear statement authorizing voice calls, not bundled with unrelated permissions, and presented next to an explicit affirmative action.

**Q: Will the audit & bulk-update tools change my existing text automatically?**A: They’re designed to help you review and standardize language. Expect controls to preview and apply changes at scale when released.

---

title_en: Customizable Message Field in Chat Widgets
source_md:
Give every new conversation instant context with HighLevel’s customizable message field for WhatsApp, Email/SMS, All-in-One Chat, and Voice AI widgets. Capture a meaningful first message, protect contact details, and keep workflows running smoothly.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Customizable Message Field in Chat Widgets?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-the-Customizable-Message-Field-in-Chat-Widgets?)
- [Key Benefits of the Customizable Message Field](#Key-Benefits-of-the-Customizable-Message-Field)
- [Pre-Defined Message Field Logic](#Pre-Defined-Message-Field-Logic)
- [Customizing the Pre-Filled Message](#Customizing-the-Pre-Filled-Message)
- [Visitor Editing Experience](#%C2%A0Visitor-Editing-Experience)
- [Supported Chat Widget Types](#Supported-Chat-Widget-Types)
- [How To Set Up the Customizable Message Field](#How-To-Set-Up-the-Customizable-Message-Field)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Customizable Message Field in Chat Widgets?**

The customizable message field is a pre-filled “Message” textbox that appears in the contact form of newly created chat widgets (except Live Chat). It lets you define default text—such as “Hi, I’d like to learn more about…”—so visitors always submit an opening message while their personal details (name, phone, email) are stored privately in your CRM rather than in the conversation transcript.

The field is required when no other message field exists and optional when your form already includes one. Visitors can freely edit or replace the pre-filled text before sending.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Customizable Message Field**

Providing a default message delivers immediate value:

- Guarantees a clear, consistent first message for every chat.

- Keeps contact information inside CRM records, not exposed in the chat thread.

- Preserves flexibility—works whether your contact form already has a message field or not.

- Improves agent efficiency by giving context up front.

- Enhances marketing attribution by ensuring each transcript starts with visitor intent.

---

## **Pre-Defined Message Field Logic**

A default “Message” field appears in the builder whenever you create a WhatsApp, Email/SMS, All-in-One Chat, or Voice AI widget.

- If your contact form lacks a message field, this field is mandatory and pre-populated with editable text.
- If your form already contains a message field, the field is optional—you can keep, remove, or reorder it.
- The widget saves, embeds, and generates code seamlessly in either case.

---

## **Customizing the Pre-Filled Message**

Within the widget builder you can:

- Click the Message field and type any default text (max 255 characters).

- Insert merge fields (e.g., ) for dynamic branding.

- Rearrange the field order via drag-and-drop.

- Toggle “Required” on/off when the field is optional.

---

## **Visitor Editing Experience**

After the widget loads on your site, visitors see your pre-filled text inside the message box. They can:

- Send it as-is for a quick start.

- Modify or delete the content before submitting.

- Benefit from immediate context with no extra typing.

---

## **Supported Chat Widget Types**

The feature is available in:

- WhatsApp Chat Widget

- Email/SMS Chat Widget

- All-in-One Chat Widget (multi-channel)

- Voice AI Chat Widget

```
Note: Live Chat widgets still rely on the existing free-form message box and do not include this new field.
```

---

## **How To Set Up the Customizable Message Field**

Setting up takes less than two minutes:

### **Open Chat Widget Settings**

From the left-hand navigation menu, go to **Sites** and select **Chat Widget** at the top.

This opens the main dashboard where you can view, manage, and edit all existing chat widgets created for your account.

### 

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058667619/original/Qdy0n-OyD2aRTTQRwlhI9FVuy-Rvw_Mtlw.png?1763478164)

### **Create a New Widget**

Click the **+ New** button in the top-right corner of the Chat Widget page.

This begins the setup process, allowing you to choose the widget type (WhatsApp, Email/SMS, All-in-One Chat, or Voice AI) and start customizing its design and behavior.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058667862/original/0R7FpvESyr4fjh4S5F4LObeslB68_2aNOA.png?1763478225)

### **Select Chat Type**

Choose the type of chat widget you want to create from the available options — **All-In-One Chat, SMS/Email Chat, Live Chat, WhatsApp Chat,** or **Voice AI**.

Each option supports different communication methods, so pick the one that best fits how you want to interact with your website visitors.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058668667/original/t6n4k6De1nY0TyrLrFeaVWU8blUED4ScSA.png?1763478540)

### **Configure Chat Window**

After selecting the chat type, open the **Chat Window** tab to customize visitor-facing details.

Here, you can edit the **Chat Window Title**, add an **Intro Message**, and define a **Prefilled Message Text**—a default message visitors see when starting a chat, which they can edit before sending.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058670237/original/XjJVDrvwCXSWYX-gvR-WC1wpnXyYhLXE3g.png?1763479314)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does this replace my existing message field?**

No. If your form already has one, the new field is optional—you choose which to keep.

**Q: Can I use different default messages on different pages?**

Yes. Create multiple widgets with unique pre-filled text and embed each on specific pages.

**Q: Is the visitor’s edited message stored in the contact record?**

The final message appears in the conversation transcript; personal details remain in the CRM contact.

**Q: Does Live Chat support this feature?**

Not yet. Live Chat continues to use its native free-text box without a pre-filled value.

**Q: Can I remove the field later without breaking my embed code?**

Absolutely, edit the widget in HighLevel, remove the field, save, and the live widget updates automatically.

**Q: How many characters can the default text contain?**

Up to 255 characters, including spaces.

**Q: Will workflows that trigger on “Customer Replied” still work?**

Yes. The visitor’s first submitted message (pre-filled or edited) triggers any “Customer Replied” automation.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Overview of Chat Widget Customizations](https://gohighlevelassist.freshdesk.com/a/solutions/articles/155000002960?portalId=48000045315)
- [How to Use the All-in-One Chat Widget](https://gohighlevelassist.freshdesk.com/a/solutions/articles/155000004779?portalId=48000045315)
- [Adding Custom Fields in the Chat Widget Contact Form](https://gohighlevelassist.freshdesk.com/a/solutions/articles/155000004356?portalId=48000045315)
- [Collect Visitor Details Before Live Chat Starts](https://gohighlevelassist.freshdesk.com/a/solutions/articles/155000005415?portalId=48000045315)

title_en: Diagnose Mobile App Notification Issues
source_md:
Mobile App • Notifications • Troubleshooting

Diagnose Mobile App Notification Issues

Notification Diagnosis helps identify why HighLevel Mobile App notifications may not be reaching your phone. From one troubleshooting flow, you can check your network, notification permission, sound settings, and actual notification delivery. If a problem remains after troubleshooting, you can copy the diagnostic report and share it with Support.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to run Notification Diagnosis, understand each diagnostic check, confirm whether a test notification arrives, rerun the diagnosis after making changes, and copy the report when additional Support assistance is needed.

# What Is Notification Diagnosis in the HighLevel Mobile App?

Notification Diagnosis is a built-in troubleshooting tool that helps identify why notifications may not be reaching your phone.

The diagnosis checks four areas: **Network**, **Notifications**, **Sound**, and **Test delivery**. Each check returns a result so you can identify which part of the notification experience may need attention.

The Test delivery check sends an actual notification to your phone. If a check identifies a possible issue, the app provides guidance about what to review before you run the diagnosis again.

## Key Benefits of Notification Diagnosis

Notification Diagnosis brings the most important notification checks into one guided flow, helping you narrow down problems without manually reviewing every device setting first.

- **Check Multiple Dependencies at Once:** Review Network, Notifications, Sound, and Test delivery from one troubleshooting flow.
- **Test Real Notification Delivery:** Send a test notification to your phone and confirm whether it arrives.
- **Identify What Needs Attention:** Use the result of each check to focus on the relevant device or connection setting.
- **Retry Test Delivery:** Use **Resend** when you want another test notification.
- **Verify Changes:** Run the diagnosis again after adjusting a setting.
- **Share Diagnostic Results:** Copy the report and include it in a Support request when the issue continues.

## Prerequisites and Limitations

Use a supported mobile app version and review the diagnostic results together rather than relying on a single check. Passing checks confirm the areas tested, but persistent notification problems may still require further investigation.

- Use HighLevel Mobile App version **4.25.0 or higher**.
- The diagnosis evaluates **Network**, **Notifications**, **Sound**, and **Test delivery**.
- Follow the guidance displayed by the app when a check needs attention.
- After making changes, run the diagnosis again to verify the new result.
- If the checks pass but notifications still do not arrive as expected, copy the diagnostic report and send it to Support.
- The feature is also supported in LeadConnector and supported white-label mobile apps when running an applicable version.

## How To Run Notification Diagnosis

Run Notification Diagnosis when expected mobile notifications are missing or when you want to verify whether your device can receive HighLevel notifications correctly.

1. Open the **HighLevel Mobile App**.
2. Open **Settings**.
3. Select **Diagnose Notifications**.
4. Tap **Start Diagnosis**.

![Notification Diagnosis flow showing Start Diagnosis and test notification confirmation](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081930912/original/uJUnCQWTbjA8TW0arSH0ZE6uhk6kh0mMdA.png?1790468383)

5. Allow the app to run the **Network**, **Notifications**, **Sound**, and **Test delivery** checks.
6. Review the result displayed for each check.
7. When the test notification is sent, confirm the result using:
   - **Received:** Select this when the test notification arrived.
   - **Didn't receive:** Select this when the notification did not arrive.
   - **Resend:** Send another test notification.
8. Follow any guidance displayed for checks that need attention.

9. Make the recommended change to the applicable device or connection setting.
10. Return to Notification Diagnosis and tap **Run diagnosis again**.
11. Review the updated results.
12. If notifications still do not work as expected, tap **Copy report**.
13. Paste the copied diagnostic report into your Support request.

![Notification Diagnosis showing diagnostic results, failed test delivery, Run diagnosis again, and Copy report](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081930920/original/G0mOKaymxPWv7hNrQeesQ3JWXOJPJf3qLA.png?1790468527)

## Understanding the Notification Diagnosis Checks

Each check tests a different part of notification delivery. Reviewing all four results helps narrow down whether the issue is related to connectivity, device permissions, audible alerts, or actual notification delivery.

### Network

The Network check evaluates the connection needed for notification delivery. If the check needs attention, follow the guidance shown in the app and review your network or Wi-Fi connection before running the diagnosis again.

### Notifications

The Notifications check determines whether the required notification permission is available. If it needs attention, follow the in-app guidance to review notification permission, then return to the app and rerun the diagnosis.

### Sound

The Sound check helps identify settings that may prevent you from hearing notification alerts. Review the guidance displayed for settings such as your ringer or Focus mode, make the applicable change, and rerun the diagnosis.

### Test Delivery

Test delivery sends an actual notification to your phone so you can confirm whether notification delivery is working.

- Select **Received** if the notification arrived.
- Select **Didn't receive** if it did not arrive.
- Select **Resend** when you want another test notification.
- If the other checks pass but test delivery still fails, use **Copy report** and include the diagnostic results in your Support request.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What does Notification Diagnosis check?

It runs four checks: Network, Notifications, Sound, and Test delivery.

Q: What should I do if the test notification does not arrive?

Select **Didn't receive** or use **Resend**. Review any checks that need attention, follow the guidance displayed in the app, and run the diagnosis again after making changes.

Q: Can I rerun the diagnosis after changing a device setting?

Yes. Tap **Run diagnosis again** to check whether the change resolved the issue.

Q: What should I do if every check passes but notifications still do not arrive?

Tap **Copy report** and include the diagnostic results in your Support request for further investigation.

Q: Which HighLevel Mobile App version supports Notification Diagnosis?

Use version **4.25.0 or higher**.

Q: Does Notification Diagnosis change my notification preferences?

Notification Diagnosis is a troubleshooting flow. If a check identifies a setting that needs attention, follow the guidance shown in the app and make the applicable change before rerunning the diagnosis.

title_en: Automate Marketing Audit Reports in HighLevel Workflows
source_md:
Automating marketing audit reports in HighLevel allows you to instantly generate insights for your prospects and deliver them through personalized outreach. By leveraging workflow automation and custom values, you can seamlessly include audit report links and business-specific details in your emails or SMS messages. This eliminates manual steps and helps you scale lead engagement efficiently. Whether you're nurturing new leads or running outbound campaigns, this feature enhances both speed and personalization.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Marketing Audit Report Automation in Workflows?](#What-is-Marketing-Audit-Report-Automation-in-Workflows?)
- [Key Benefits of Marketing Audit Report Automation](#Key-Benefits-of-Marketing-Audit-Report-Automation)

---

# **What is Marketing Audit Report Automation in Workflows?**

Marketing Audit Report Automation in HighLevel enables you to automatically generate a detailed audit report for a prospect and use that report within your workflow-driven communications. This functionality connects lead capture, analysis, and outreach into a single streamlined process, allowing you to deliver immediate value without manual intervention.

When the Generate Marketing Audit Report action is added to a workflow, HighLevel creates a report for the prospect and generates dynamic custom values. These values—such as the audit report link and the prospect’s business name—can then be inserted into downstream steps like emails or SMS messages for personalized communication.

---

## **Key Benefits of Marketing Audit Report Automation**

Automating audit reports within workflows helps businesses deliver faster, more personalized outreach while reducing manual work and improving scalability.

- **End-to-End Automation:**Automatically move from lead capture to audit generation to outreach without manual steps
- **Personalized Messaging:**Use dynamic data like business name and report links to tailor communication
- **Faster Response Time:** Instantly deliver value to new leads, improving engagement rates
- **Scalable Outreach:** Handle large volumes of prospects without additional effort
- **Improved Lead Conversion:**Provide actionable insights upfront to build trust and credibility

---

## **Generate Marketing Audit Report Action**

The Generate Marketing Audit Report action is the core component that powers this feature. It allows workflows to automatically create a marketing audit report for each prospect, making the data immediately usable in subsequent steps.

- Generates a unique audit report per contact
- Works with leads from forms, ads, imports, or other triggers
- Outputs dynamic custom values for use later in the workflow

---

## **Custom Values for Audit Reports**

Custom values generated by the audit report action allow you to dynamically personalize your outreach. These values are populated automatically once the audit report is created, ensuring your messages include relevant and accurate information.

Available Custom Values:

- **Prospect Web Report Link:**A direct link to the generated audit report
- **Prospect Business Name:** The name of the prospect’s business used for personalization

These values can be inserted into email or SMS steps within the same workflow.

---

## **Using Audit Reports in Email and SMS**

Incorporating audit report data into your messaging helps create highly personalized and value-driven communication. 

This improves engagement by giving prospects immediate, actionable insights about their business.

Example Email:

> Hi {{prospect\_business\_name}},
>
> We’ve created a free marketing audit for your business. You can view it here:  
>   
> {{prospect\_web\_report\_link}}

Example SMS:

> Hi {{prospect\_business\_name}}, check out your free audit: {{prospect\_web\_report\_link}}

---

## **How To Setup Marketing Audit Report Automation**

Proper setup ensures that audit reports are generated and delivered seamlessly within your workflow. Following the correct sequence of steps guarantees that custom values are available when needed for personalization.

1. Navigate to Automation → Workflows in HighLevel  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070203137/original/x_8uRxbxxTIH40IJkjWhoqVlU2OgXWDDyA.png?1777457489)
2. Create a new workflow or open an existing one
3. Add a trigger (e.g., form submission, new lead, or import)
4. Click + Add Action and select Generate Marketing Audit Report  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070203303/original/KQZhWjzQuDBqh4gXNLlbksoxBKNrOwUSZw.png?1777457612)
5. Add a follow-up action such as Send Email or Send SMS
6. In the message editor, insert:  
     
   - Prospect Web Report Link
   - Prospect Business Name  
       
       
     ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070203551/original/pwY_Tk3JquB3GJNXv11S66fR7m9VVzEVCg.png?1777457741)
7. Customize your message content as needed  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155070203636/original/_FrDhiauZJIi6COETyx3l69JeT9r1Ga40w.png?1777457785)
8. Save and publish the workflow

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q1: When are the custom values populated?**A: Custom values are generated immediately after the “Generate Marketing Audit Report” action runs in the workflow.

**Q2: Can I use these custom values outside workflows?**A: These specific values are generated within workflows, so they are primarily intended for use in downstream workflow steps.

**Q3: What happens if I add the email step before the audit action?**A: The custom values will not be available. Ensure the audit report action comes before any messaging steps.

**Q4: Can I use this feature for leads from any source?**A: Yes, it works with leads from forms, ads, imports, and other workflow triggers.

**Q5: Is the audit report link unique for each prospect?**A: Yes, each generated report link is unique to the individual prospect.

**Q6: Can I customize the audit report content?**A: Customization options depend on the audit report feature settings within HighLevel.

---

title_en: Community Editor Enhancements: Rich Text Toolbar & Moderation Tools
source_md:
Community Management

# Community Editor Enhancements: Rich Text Toolbar & Moderation Tools

Create better-looking posts, moderate your community more efficiently, and manage recordings with fewer clicks using the enhanced community editor.

What You'll Learn

The HighLevel community editor includes several enhancements designed to streamline content creation, moderation, and discussion management. These tools help you format posts more easily, moderate communities without leaving the feed, and interact with recordings directly from posts.

This article covers the floating rich text formatting toolbar, direct user banning from posts, recording downloads, and improved keyboard shortcuts for the comment editor.

## Rich Text Formatting Toolbar

The floating formatting toolbar eliminates the need to memorize keyboard shortcuts or navigate away from your content. When you select text in the editor, a toolbar appears with common formatting options, making it faster to create well-structured, visually appealing posts and comments.

The toolbar provides instant access to the following formatting styles:

**Bold** — Emphasize important words or phrases

**Italic** — Add subtle emphasis or indicate titles

**Underline** — Highlight key information

**Strikethrough** — Show deletions or changes

**Insert Links** — Embed hyperlinks within your text

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077267147/original/8R8bGN3JP87oNyc0vehGDGlFFVZdyd6bew.png?1785426049)

Pro Tip

The formatting toolbar appears automatically when you highlight text with your cursor. You can also use traditional keyboard shortcuts if you prefer.

## Ban Spammers Directly from Posts

Community moderators can ban users immediately without leaving the discussion feed or navigating to the Members tab. This streamlines moderation workflows and allows you to address spam or inappropriate content quickly.

When you ban a user, HighLevel provides the option to delete all content created by that user, ensuring spam or policy violations are removed comprehensively.

Step 1

Open the Post Menu

Locate the post from the user you want to ban and click the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top-right corner of the post.

Step 2

Select "Ban User"

Choose "Ban User" from the dropdown menu. A confirmation dialog appears with the user's profile and username.

Step 3

Confirm the Ban

Check the "Delete all content created by this user" box if you want to remove all posts, comments, and recordings from the user. Click "Yes, Ban" to complete the action.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077267285/original/MxKl9bcUhEUBK2iYVBBqgy6kwzAAurFkRQ.png?1785426094)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077267342/original/XUrDKOw_FEXz2-JBJjNr-XTMvsHm-WX11A.png?1785426126)

Note

Banned users cannot access the community until unbanned. All their content is permanently removed if you select the delete option during the ban process.

## Download Recordings from Posts

Video and audio recordings shared in community posts can be downloaded directly from the post menu. This allows you to save recordings for offline viewing, archiving, or repurposing content without additional steps.

Step 1

Locate the Recording Post

Navigate to the post that contains the recording you want to download.

Step 2

Open the Post Menu

Click the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top-right corner of the post.

Step 3

Select "Download Recording"

Choose "Download Recording" from the dropdown menu. The recording file downloads immediately to your device.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077267396/original/JV0EWDfwufDXnRO_Twu-bc32Hzs-j4R0rQ.png?1785426168)

Pro Tip

Recording downloads are available for both video and audio posts. The file format depends on the original recording type.

## Improved Comment Editor Keyboard Shortcuts

Based on user feedback, HighLevel has updated the comment editor keyboard shortcuts to align with common text editing behaviors. The updated shortcuts provide a more intuitive writing experience and reduce confusion when drafting comments.

Feature 1

Enter Key → Start a New Paragraph

Pressing Enter creates a new paragraph block with vertical spacing, matching standard word processing behavior.

Feature 2

Shift + Enter → Insert a Line Break

Pressing Shift + Enter inserts a line break within the same paragraph, allowing you to separate lines without creating a new paragraph block.

Feature 3

Ctrl + Enter → Publish the Comment

Pressing Ctrl + Enter (or Cmd + Enter on Mac) submits the comment immediately, providing a keyboard alternative to clicking the "Post" button.

Why This Matters

The updated keyboard shortcuts align with familiar text editor conventions, reducing the learning curve and helping users write comments faster without accidental submissions.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I use keyboard shortcuts instead of the rich text toolbar?

Yes. The floating toolbar is a visual enhancement that complements existing keyboard shortcuts. You can continue using traditional shortcuts (e.g., Ctrl+B for bold, Ctrl+I for italic) if you prefer.

Q: What happens to a user's content when I ban them?

When you ban a user, you are given the option to delete all content created by that user. If you check the "Delete all content created by this user" box, all posts, comments, and recordings from the user are permanently removed. If you do not check this box, their content remains visible in the community.

Q: Can I unban a user after banning them?

Yes. Navigate to the Members tab, locate the banned user, and select "Unban User" from their profile menu. Note that if you deleted their content during the ban process, that content cannot be restored.

Q: What file format are downloaded recordings?

Downloaded recordings retain the format of the original file uploaded to the community. Most recordings are saved as MP4 for video and MP3 for audio, but formats may vary depending on how the recording was created.

Q: Do the improved keyboard shortcuts work in the post editor as well?

Yes. The updated keyboard shortcuts (Enter for new paragraph, Shift+Enter for line break, Ctrl+Enter to publish) apply to both the comment editor and the post editor, providing a consistent experience across all writing areas in the community.

Q: Can I download recordings from posts I didn't create?

Yes, as long as the post is visible to you in the community. Recording downloads are available to all community members with access to the post, not just the post author.

Q: Does the rich text toolbar appear in mobile browsers?

The floating rich text toolbar is optimized for desktop browsers. On mobile devices, formatting options may be accessed through a different interface depending on your device and browser. The toolbar is designed to provide the best experience on desktop while maintaining full functionality across all platforms.

title_en: Improve your Phone Number's reputation with Voice Integrity
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/AH1JqR9PTPE?&wmode=opaque)

In this guide, you’ll learn how to register your U.S. phone numbers with HighLevel’s Voice Integrity feature—leveraging top caller-ID analytics platforms to clear spam flags, repair your caller-ID reputation, and significantly boost your answer rates.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Voice Integrity with High Level](#Voice-Integrity-with-High-Level)
- [Why Switch on Voice Integrity?](#Why-Switch-on-Voice-Integrity?)
- [Before Registering for Voice Integrity](#Before-Registering-for-Voice-Integrity%C2%A0)
- [Enabling Voice Integrity](#Enabling-Voice-Integrity)
  - [Step 1: Navigate to the Voice Integrity Tab within the Trust Center](#Step-1%3A-Navigate-to-the-Voice-Integrity-Tab-within-the-Trust-Center%C2%A0)
  - [Step 2: Complete the Registration Form](#Step-2%3A-Complete-the-Registration-Form)
- [What Happens After You Register?](#What-Happens-After-You-Register?)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **Voice Integrity with High Level**

HighLevel Voice Integrity submits eligible U.S. phone numbers to First Orion, Hiya, and TNS for reputation review. These providers evaluate calling activity and may update how the number is classified. Voice Integrity can help address incorrect spam labels, but each provider and carrier makes its own reputation decisions.

---

## **Why Switch on Voice Integrity?**

- **Fix a bad reputation:** Clear existing spam flags and restore trust in your caller ID.
- **Higher answer rates:** Studies show calls labeled with a recognized, branded name are far more likely to be answered.
- **Better deliverability:** Legitimate callers avoid unnecessary blocks, so your outreach and support calls reach more customers.

```
Note: HighLevel may prompt you to register for Voice Integrity after an unanswered outbound call from the web dialer. This prompt is a shortcut to help you improve future answer rates.
```

---

## **Before Registering for Voice Integrity**

Before you enable Voice Integrity, make sure you’ve met the following key requirements.

1. **SHAKEN/STIR Registration**  
   SHAKEN/STIR must be configured before you can submit a Voice Integrity application. It authenticates caller ID information and helps carriers verify that your business is authorized to use the displayed phone number.
2. **EIN requirement:** A valid Employer Identification Number (EIN) is required for the documented HighLevel SHAKEN/STIR registration process.
3. **CNAM (Caller Name)** (recommended)  
   Submitting a branded name alongside your number further enhances trust in analytics platforms.
4. **U.S. Phone Numbers Only**  
   Voice Integrity currently applies solely to domestic traffic—international numbers are not supported.

---

## **Enabling Voice Integrity**

Here’s how to activate Voice Integrity in minutes and ensure your calls are marked as legitimate across the major networks. Also, please note that SHAKEN/STIR registration is required to complete the Voice Integrity form. If you don’t already have it, register before proceeding.

### **Step 1:** Navigate to the Voice Integrity Tab within the Trust Center

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048790618/original/XLqtPNtNwF3LhY9xfg72UOOKgClYvrn_LQ.gif?1750770991)**

### **Step 2:** Complete the Registration Form

Within the Trust Center under the Voice Integrity tab, fill in:

- **Use Case:** Select the type of calls you’ll be making (e.g., sales outreach, customer support).
- **Employee Count:** Enter your organization’s size.
- **Average Business Day Call Volume**: Provide your expected daily call count.
- **CNAM Details**: (Optional) Enter your branded caller name.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155048791059/original/QdCinpeqBhKjgAALyKcZDuTLief7Wse0uA.png?1750771315)

```
Please Note: Once you click Submit, your Voice Integrity application is typically processed within 2 business days. You can monitor progress at any time by visiting the Submitted Applications tab in the Trust Center.
```

---

## **What Happens After You Register?**

Once you submit your information, each of the analytics providers—Hiya, TNS, and First Orion—will review your registration separately.

- **Fast Turnaround:** Most applications clear within two business days.
- **Live Updates:** You’ll receive a notification once your numbers are approved.
- Label removal may take time to propagate across all networks

```
Please Note: To get started with Voice Integrity, your business must first be registered for SHAKEN/STIR, which requires a valid Employer Identification Number (EIN). However, if you're a sole proprietor or do not yet have an EIN, you can still improve your phone number reputation using the Free Caller Registry.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will activating Voice Integrity automatically enroll my numbers in SHAKEN/STIR?**  
No. SHAKEN/STIR must be fully configured on your account before you can register for Voice Integrity.

**Q: Can I register international numbers?**  
At this time, only U.S. numbers are supported. We’re evaluating expansion to other regions.

**Q: Why is CNAM optional?**  
CNAM provides caller-name identification, while SHAKEN/STIR provides caller authentication and Voice Integrity handles reputation review. CNAM is not required for Voice Integrity, but an accurate caller name can provide an additional identification signal.

**Q: Does Voice Integrity guarantee spam-label removal?**

No. Voice Integrity submits eligible phone numbers to caller-ID analytics providers for reputation review. Each provider and carrier evaluates reputation independently, so label removal is not guaranteed and may take time.

**Q: What should I do if my business does not have an EIN?**  
Businesses without an EIN cannot use the documented HighLevel SHAKEN/STIR registration process required for Voice Integrity. For eligible U.S. numbers, use the Free Caller Registry as an alternative reputation-remediation option.

**Q: Can my number be marked as spam again after Voice Integrity registration?**  
Yes. Carriers and analytics providers continue to evaluate call volume, recipient complaints, engagement, calling patterns, and other reputation signals. Voice Integrity registration does not permanently prevent future spam labels.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Overview of Phone Number Configuration Options](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001229976-overview-of-phone-number-configuration-options)
- [Using Call Connect to Ensure Accurate Call Status Tracking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001181825-using-call-connect-to-ensure-accurate-call-status-tracking)
- [Why are my Calls marked as Spam, and How can I avoid it ?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001231665-why-are-my-calls-marked-as-spam-and-how-can-i-avoid-it-)

title_en: Configure Response Settings in Conversation AI
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/J3RwzIpEWzc?&wmode=opaque)

Response Style Settings in HighLevel Conversation AI help you control how long and detailed your bot’s replies are. By choosing **Concise**, **Balanced**, or **Detailed**, you can better match your brand voice and the channel you’re replying in. This guide explains how Response Style Settings work, where to find them in Bot Settings, and how to configure them for more consistent customer conversations.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Response Style Settings?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Response-Style-Settings?)
- [Key Benefits of Response Style Settings](#Key-Benefits-of-Response-Style-Settings)
- [Supported Bot Types](#Supported-Bot-Types)
- [Enable or Disable Response Style Settings](#Enable-or-Disable-Response-Style-Settings)
- [Bot-Level Configuration](#Bot-Level-Configuration)
- [How To Setup Response Style Settings](#How-To-Setup-Response-Style-Settings)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Response Style Settings?**

Response Style Settings allow you to set a preferred reply length for a Conversation AI bot. Choosing a response style helps keep responses aligned with your use case: whether you need quick confirmations, helpful context, or more thorough answers without rewriting prompts or rebuilding flows.

---

## **Key Benefits of Response Style Settings**

Controlling response length helps you deliver a more consistent experience across channels and use cases. The right level of detail can reduce confusion, improve engagement, and keep conversations aligned with your brand.

- **Channel-friendly replies:** Match reply length to SMS, web chat, social DMs, and more.
- **Better customer clarity:** Provide the right amount of detail to reduce back-and-forth questions.
- **Consistent brand experience:** Keep replies aligned with your preferred tone and depth.
- **Flexible by bot:** Use different styles for different bots based on their purpose.
- **Easy adjustments:** Switch styles anytime without changing existing flows or prompts.

---

## **Supported Bot Types**

Knowing which bots support Response Style Settings helps you apply the feature confidently across your Conversation AI setup. If you manage multiple bot formats, this ensures you’re enabling the setting in the right place.

Response Style Settings are supported for:

- **Form-Based Bots**
- **Prompt-Based Bots**
- **Flow-Based Bots**

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066020578/original/JGlajciqbAoD5O7kiNSi1jimdtxtI02D5Q.png?1772464775)**

---

## **Enable or Disable Response Style Settings**

Turning Response Style Settings on or off gives you control over whether a bot should follow a selected verbosity style. This is helpful when testing new behavior or returning a bot to its current/default response behavior.

- **When enabled:** A Response Settings section appears in Bot Settings, allowing you to choose **Concise**, **Balanced**, or **Detailed**.
- **When disabled:** The bot continues responding exactly as it does today (without applying a selected response style).

| Response Style | Approximate Length | Best For | What to Expect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Concise | ~30 words | Quick acknowledgments, simple Q&A, SMS-friendly replies | Direct answers with minimal extra context |
| Balanced | ~80 words | Most general conversations, qualifying questions, basic support | Clear answer plus light context or guidance |
| Detailed | ~200 words | FAQs, troubleshooting, onboarding, step-by-step instructions | More thorough, structured explanations |

  
  

```
Note: Response Style word counts are guidelines, not strict caps. Depending on the conversation, replies may be slightly shorter or longer than the target length. 
If your prompt includes conflicting length instructions (example: “always respond in 20 words”), results may be less predictable. For best results, avoid adding separate word-count rules inside your custom prompt when using Response Style Settings.
```

---

## **Bot-Level Configuration**

Bot-level settings make it easier to tailor different experiences across channels and purposes. This is especially useful if you run separate bots for sales, support, or different platforms.

Response Style Settings apply to the **current bot only**, which means you can:

- Run one bot in **Concise** mode for SMS
- Run another bot in **Detailed** mode for support-heavy channels (like web chat or Messenger)

---

## **How To Setup Response Style Settings**

Correct setup ensures the bot consistently follows your chosen verbosity level. Once enabled, the selected style applies to new replies automatically, making it easy to standardize response length without redesigning your bot.

1. Navigate to **AI Agents** **→** **Conversation AI → Agents list.**Create a new bot or Open an existing bot  
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066020326/original/m93Fm1vU81P9CZxYHTEyJQE8sNlsXW-wew.png?1772464643)**
2. Scroll to **Response Settings**. Toggle ON/Enablefor**Response Settings.**
3. Select one option from the dropdown: **Concise**, **Balanced**, or **Detailed**.  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066020465/original/KmsOBDpYB2CzMZZUGhp4dM7tN0lo42CbrA.gif?1772464720)**
4. Click **Save** to apply the change.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: If I enable Response Style Settings for one bot, do all bots change?**  
No. Response Style Settings are saved per bot, so each bot can use a different style.

**Q: Is the word count a strict limit?**  
No. The word count is a soft guideline, and replies may vary slightly based on context.

**Q: What happens if I disable Response Style Settings?**  
The bot continues responding exactly as it does today, without applying a selected response style.

**Q: Can prompt instructions override the selected style?**  
They can conflict. For the most predictable results, avoid adding separate word-count or length rules in your prompt when using Response Style Settings.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Advanced Settings Overview - Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004415-advanced-settings-overview-conversation-ai)
- [Conversation AI Bot – Explained](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001335-conversation-ai-bot-explained)
- [Setting Up Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004401-setting-up-conversation-ai)
- [Auto-Pilot Mode in Conversation AI for Efficient Communication](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001022-auto-pilot-mode-in-conversation-ai-for-efficient-communication)
- [Conversation AI Flow Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006515-conversation-ai-flow-builder)

title_en: WordPress - SEO Reports
source_md:
This guide covers the new SEO Report Tab in HighLevel’s WordPress Hosting. You’ll learn how to turn on access, read the insights for title tags, meta descriptions, and meta keywords, and use guided actions to improve search readiness — all without leaving your hosting dashboard.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is the SEO Report in WordPress Hosting?](#What-Is-the-SEO-Report-in-WordPress-Hosting?)
- [Key Benefits of the SEO Report in WordPress Hosting](#Key-Benefits-of-the-SEO-Report-in-WordPress-Hosting%C2%A0)
- [Core SEO Checks](#Core-SEO-Checks)
- [Prerequisites and Access](#Prerequisites-and-Access)
- [How To Use the WordPress Hosting SEO Report](#How-To-Use-the-WordPress-Hosting-SEO-Report)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is the SEO Report in WordPress Hosting?**

The SEO Report centralizes core on‑page SEO checks directly inside the WordPress Hosting dashboard for each hosted site. It highlights missing or weak metadata and provides practical, guided actions so you can resolve issues quickly without third‑party tools.

---

## **Key Benefits of the SEO Report in WordPress Hosting**

- **Time to Value:** Quickly identify and resolve high‑impact SEO opportunities from a single dashboard.
- **Workflow Efficiency:** Guided fixes reduce context switching and accelerate completion.
- **Better SERP Outcomes:** Improving core metadata increases relevance and can lift click‑through potential.
- **Operational Simplicity:** See insights where you manage hosting—fewer tools and logins to juggle.
- **Reduced Risk of Oversights:** Automated checks surface gaps often missed in manual reviews.

---

## **Core SEO Checks**

Learning what gets checked and why it matters helps you interpret the insights and decide which fixes will produce the biggest search impact.

### **Title Tags**

- **Detects:** Missing titles, duplicates, and titles that exceed recommended length guidelines.
- **Why it matters:** Titles influence rankings, click‑through rate (CTR), and how your page is interpreted by search engines.
- **What to do:** Use **Fix Now** to open the relevant edit view and craft a concise, descriptive title that reflects primary intent.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/VwYKp41UaVkFFnriCrvQ+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-10+at+9.57.56+PM.png)

### **Meta Descriptions**

- **Detects:** Missing or unoptimized descriptions.
- **Why it matters:** Descriptions can improve SERP engagement by previewing value and encouraging clicks.
- **What to do:** Use **Fix Now** to add a clear, benefit‑oriented summary that aligns with the page title and content.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/4xpgFBP9PQlZ32TwynnT+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-10+at+9.59.54+PM.png)

### **Meta Keywords**

- **Detects:** Opportunities to refine keyword focus and topical relevance based on your content.
- **Why it matters:** While major search engines may not use meta keywords for rankings, keyword focus remains valuable for content planning and internal consistency.
- **What to do:** Use **Fix Now** to review suggested keywords and ensure your on‑page copy aligns with the topic.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/u8UsGTeJT64Hb6NBXKFQ+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-10+at+10.01.39+PM.png)

---

## **Prerequisites and Access**

Verifying requirements upfront prevents access issues and ensures the SEO tab can load and display insights for your site.

You’ll need:

- **Active SEO subscription at the sub‑account level**. If SEO is not subscribed for the sub‑account, the SEO tab will not be visible under WordPress Hosting.

  - **How to Confirm:** **Agency View** > **Sub-accounts** > **Manage Client** > **Reselling** > **SEO**

**![](https://jumpshare.com/share/NhGPrSLFRELmetmyAG7y+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-10+at+8.38.21+PM.png)**

- **LC (LeadConnector) WordPress Plugin v3.0.12 or later**, installed and active on the WordPress site to enable insights and ensure API compatibility.  
    
  - **How to Confirm: Sites > WordPress >**Click**Manage Website**button of the particular website **>** **Plugins**

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/xb1ZykqvlltY4h7ofV2Q+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-10+at+8.40.47+PM.png)

---

## **How To Use the WordPress Hosting SEO Report**

Follow these simple steps to use the SEO Report feature.

### **Step 1:** Open the WordPress Hosting dashboard and select your site.

1. Navigate to **Sites → WordPress.**  
     
   **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/RQqDQYrDDEP7RzXlVxbZ+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-10+at+8.53.10+PM.png)**
2. Click on the **Manage Website** button of the site you want to generate the report for.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/1xxulNQJG9YO3dgzWfJw+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-10+at+8.54.48+PM.png)
3. Click on the **SEO**tab.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/XHm6NCKamVsp8hhcLiVw+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-10+at+8.56.56+PM.png)

### **Step 2:** Review the SEO insights

1. Check **Title Tag**, **Meta Description** & **Meta Keywords** suggested **fixes**.   
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/sdz8n98y31MgHzRP29b0+/GIF+Recording+2025-11-10+at+9.28.02+PM.gif)
2. Switch between **Not Fixed** & **Fixed** tags.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ouDXhwilwcr3TGACvSvw+/Screen+Shot+2025-11-10+at+9.12.30+PM.png)

### **Step 3:** Fix Issues

- Click **Fix Issue** button for a suggested fix to apply the recommended improvement.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/LQo37Tvb8wAtO5inKP6C+/GIF+Recording+2025-11-10+at+9.51.25+PM.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to subscribe to SEO for the SEO tab to appear in WordPress Hosting?**

Yes. The SEO add‑on must be active for the sub‑account; otherwise, the SEO tab will not be visible.

**Q: What plugin version is required for SEO insights?**

The **LC (LeadConnector) WordPress plugin v3.0.12 or later** must be installed and active on the site.

**Q: How often do insights refresh?**

Insights refresh on a periodic schedule. If a **Refresh/Re‑scan** control is available, use it after publishing changes to update sooner.

**Q: Does this replace the full SEO suite in HighLevel?**

No. The Hosting **SEO tab** focuses on foundational on‑page checks for WordPress. For advanced audits and broader SEO tooling, use the dedicated SEO product area in HighLevel.

**Q: Will changes go live immediately?**

Metadata changes take effect when you save/publish in WordPress. Search engines may take additional time to re‑crawl and reflect updates in results.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Disable SEO Indexing for WordPress Sites](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005158)
- [A Quick Walkthrough of SEO: A Guide to Boosting Your Search Rankings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004723)
- [Custom Meta Tags](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001073924)

title_en: How to Use Dark Mode in GoKollab Communities and Courses
source_md:
Dark Mode gives GoKollab members a darker web interface across Communities, Courses, and other supported areas. Members can switch their appearance from the top navigation, while community owners can define separate brand palettes for Light and Dark Mode. The selected appearance is retained across refreshes and most supported navigation, helping create a more comfortable and consistent viewing experience.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is GoKollab Dark Mode?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-GoKollab-Dark-Mode?)
- [Key Benefits of GoKollab Dark Mode](#Key-Benefits-of-GoKollab-Dark-Mode)
- [Where Dark Mode is Available](#Where-Dark-Mode-is-Available)
- [How to Set Up GoKollab Dark Mode](#How-to-Set-Up-GoKollab-Dark-Mode)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is GoKollab Dark Mode?**

GoKollab Dark Mode is a web appearance option that changes supported interface surfaces to a darker color scheme while maintaining readable text, controls, and community branding. Members can choose the appearance that works best for them, while community owners can separately configure how their brand looks in Light and Dark Mode. This makes it possible to support different viewing preferences without relying on automatic color inversion.

---

## **Key Benefits of GoKollab Dark Mode**

- **One-click appearance switching:** Members can move between Light and Dark Mode directly from the GoKollab top navigation.
- **Independent brand palettes:** Community owners can configure Light and Dark color palettes separately so changes to one mode do not overwrite the other.
- **More comfortable viewing:** Darker surfaces can provide a more comfortable experience during longer sessions or in low-light environments.
- **Broad GoKollab coverage:** Dark Mode adapts Communities, Courses, discovery, onboarding, account surfaces, and other supported areas.
- **Persistent preferences:** A member's selected appearance is automatically restored after refreshes and across most supported navigation.
- **Existing community compatibility:** Existing communities continue to work without requiring a new Dark Mode configuration.

---

## **Where Dark Mode is Available**

Dark Mode is available across the supported GoKollab web experience, including Communities, Courses, account areas, discovery, onboarding, and other member-facing surfaces. Interface elements such as backgrounds, text, forms, menus, tabs, and controls automatically adapt to the selected appearance.

The selected appearance also carries into supported learning experiences, including course navigation, lessons, assessments, assignments, quizzes, and live-session surfaces. Members do not need to configure a separate appearance for Courses.

Dark Mode is available for GoKollab on the web. Appearance preference may not persist during navigation in some areas, including GoKollab Studio.

---

## **How to Set Up GoKollab Dark Mode**

Using the correct workflow ensures members can choose their preferred appearance while community owners maintain appropriate branding for both modes. Members only need to change their personal appearance preference, while owners can separately configure how the community looks when each mode is selected.

### **For Members**

1. Open **GoKollab** or a Community on the web.
2. Locate the **appearance switcher** in the top navigation.
3. Select **Dark Mode**.
4. Continue navigating GoKollab normally. Your selection will be remembered across refreshes and most supported areas.
5. Use the appearance switcher again whenever you want to return to Light Mode.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081340041/original/i6vc3JJkdcSKA29SbZlgnqJJ8OVtX1KhNQ.png?1789762009)**

### **For Community Owners**

1. Open the community you want to configure.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081340395/original/8X27qVzii3X-sX9UzZOF5IN39y8OW-oKZw.png?1789762315)
2. Go to **Settings**. Select **Appearance**.
3. Under **Color Mode**, select **Light** or **Dark** depending on the palette you want to configure.
4. Choose a Community Theme or use the available customization controls.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081340460/original/ShkGSnQ3TA2uES3JZJuSjN9S-TOIjFrM5A.png?1789762424)
5. Review the **Preview** to verify how the selected appearance will look.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081340482/original/8HNDS_oSoEWXQrwboEgGUMVD0GpUZ4Ds8g.png?1789762460)
6. Repeat the process for the other color mode if you want separate Light and Dark branding.
7. Click **Save changes**.

Changes made to the Dark palette do not overwrite the Light palette, and changes to the Light palette do not overwrite the Dark palette.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: If I switch to Dark Mode, will the appearance change for every community member?**  
No. Members select their own viewing appearance. Community owners configure how the community's branding looks when members use each available mode.

**Q: Can a community owner require every member to use Dark Mode?**  
No. The appearance switcher is a member-controlled preference, so each member can choose their preferred appearance.

**Q: Is Dark Mode available in the GoKollab mobile experience?**  
Dark Mode is currently available for **GoKollab on the web**. Mobile support for the same appearance controls is not currently available.

**Q: Will Dark Mode automatically recolor uploaded images or videos?**  
Dark Mode adjusts supported interface elements such as backgrounds, text, borders, forms, menus, tabs, and controls. Uploaded images and videos retain their original appearance.

**Q: Why does my appearance sometimes change when I navigate through Studio?**  
Preference persistence is not yet complete across every surface. Studio is a known area where the selected mode may not always remain applied during navigation.

**Q: What should I check if my community looks incorrect only in Dark Mode?**  
If your community uses custom CSS, review any styles that specifically affect Light or Dark Mode and test the community in both appearances.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Communities - Change your group theme](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002455)
- [How to Setup, Customize, and Manage Your Communities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000280)
- [Communities - How to Add Custom CSS/JS to Groups](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002165)
- [Manage Your Communities and Courses with GoKollab Studio](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005899)
- [Learning Tab (Courses)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001238)

- [Useful Links](#Useful-Links%E2%80%8B)

---

## **Overview**

Pipelines are visual workflow tools that show the progress of leads, deals, or customers from start to finish. Each opportunity moves through defined stages, helping teams understand what actions are needed and where items may be getting stuck.

> **Updated Pipelines Experience (Labs)**

> The Pipelines page now uses the HighRise design system for a cleaner, more consistent experience.

> To enable this update, go to **Sub-account → Labs**.

You can access Pipelines from:

**Sub-account → Opportunities → Pipelines**

---

## **Pipelines List View**

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064130331/original/cysN3cSv0IWbeH5dCWGnN-3t6S-7LDh5Nw.png?1770163033)*

This view displays all pipelines in the sub-account, along with the number of stages in each pipeline and the last updated timestamp.

---

## **Why Pipelines Matter**

Pipelines help you:

- **Improve visibility**

  Instantly see where every opportunity stands in your process.
- **Maintain consistency**

  Standardize how leads or clients move through your workflow.
- **Increase efficiency**

  Automate follow-ups, reminders, and task assignments based on stage changes.
- **Track performance**

  Monitor conversion rates, identify bottlenecks, and measure overall pipeline health.

---

## **Pipeline Stages**

A pipeline is made up of stages, with each stage representing a step in your sales or customer journey. Opportunities move from left to right as they progress through the pipeline.

Stages should be clearly defined and action-oriented so users know exactly when an opportunity should move forward.

---

## **Editing a Pipeline and Its Stages**

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064130340/original/qsA3sdj2jWZWMKEas_RxFvQrm4yaDWzO7g.png?1770163078)*

From this screen, you can rename stages, reorder them, control reporting visibility, add new stages, or delete existing ones.

---

## **Deleting a Pipeline Stage**

When deleting a pipeline stage, you can now **move all existing opportunities to another stage** instead of losing them.

### **How it works**

1. Navigate to **Opportunities → Pipelines**.
2. Open the pipeline you want to edit.
3. Click the **delete** icon next to the stage.
4. Select a destination stage to move existing opportunities.
5. Confirm the deletion.

All opportunities from the deleted stage are automatically transferred to the selected stage.

---

## **Example Pipeline Stages**

### **Example: Sales Pipeline**

- **Lead Capture** – New inquiries from forms, calls, or chats
- **Qualification** – Budget, need, and fit are confirmed
- **Appointment Scheduled** – Discovery calls or demos are booked
- **Proposal / Negotiation** – Offers are shared and discussed
- **Closing** – Opportunity marked as Won or Lost

### **Example: Service Business Pipeline**

- New Inquiry
- Discovery Call Booked
- Service or Package Selected
- Payment Collected
- Onboarding

> **Tip:** Keep stages action-oriented and define clear rules for progression.

> Example: Move an opportunity to *Appointment Scheduled* only after a meeting is confirmed on the calendar.

---

## **Best Practices**

### **Keep It Simple**

Limit pipelines to only the stages that matter most. Too many stages can slow down your workflow and reduce clarity.

### **Automate Smartly**

Use pipeline-based automation to reduce manual work:

- Send follow-ups when opportunities stay in a stage too long
- Assign tasks when deals reach key stages

### **Review Regularly**

On a weekly or monthly basis:

- Remove outdated opportunities
- Update stage definitions as your process evolves
- Review conversion data and performance trends

---

## **Data-Driven Optimization**

Pipelines are more than organizational tools—they provide insight into your business. Use pipeline reporting to answer:

- Where do opportunities drop off most often?
- Which stage takes the longest to complete?
- What is the win rate at each stage?

Use these insights to continuously improve your workflow and conversion rates.

---

## **Common Use Cases**

- **Real Estate**

  New Lead → Property Tour → Offer → Contract Signed → Closed
- **Coaching**

  Inquiry → Discovery Call → Program Selected → Payment → Onboarding
- **Agency Client Management**

  Lead → Strategy Call → Proposal → Agreement → Onboarded

These examples can be adapted to fit most industries.

---

## **FAQs**

### **Q: Do I lose opportunities when I delete a pipeline stage?**

No. When deleting a stage, you can choose another stage to move all existing opportunities to.

### **Q: Is the updated Pipelines experience required?**

No. The updated experience is currently optional and can be enabled from **Sub-account → Labs**.

### **Q: Did any pipeline functionality change?**

No core functionality changed. The update focuses on UI improvements and safer stage management.

### **Q: Do existing automations still work?**

Yes. All existing pipeline-based automations and triggers continue to function normally.

---

## **Useful Links**

- [Understanding Opportunities](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001983)
- [Creating a Pipeline](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001985)

###
